This study conducts a systematic review following PRISMA guidelines, using data collected from Scopus and Web of Science, combined with content analysis. The results identify 36 key risk factors, classified into groups including financial, technical, construction, environmental, economic, social, policy and management risks. In addition, notable differences are observed between developed and developing countries, with the latter being more affected by institutional, financial, and social factors. Based on these findings, the study proposes several implications to enhance risk management effectiveness for future HSR projects in Vietnam.

title: A Data-Driven Analysis on the Impact of High-Speed Rails on Land Prices in Taiwan
abstract: High-speed rail (HSR) networks boost inter-city accessibility across a country and stimulate economic growth in inner cities. These economic gains, however, can often be accompanied by sharp increases in land and property prices along the lines that raise governmental concerns. This study examined the effect of the introduction of HSR on land prices in Taiwan and how the extent of such an effect varied with the stages of economic, societal, and infrastructural developments in different cities in Taiwan. Based on extensive published data, an empirical study was conducted using an integrated methodology comprising system dynamics, multivariate regression, and principal component analysis to examine the interacting relationships between the presence of HSR transportation and other important dimensions of city development in determining land prices. The study found that while land prices correlated with the greater locational accessibility brought about HSR, the extent of land price increases depended significantly on economic, societal, and infrastructural considerations such as the unemployment rate, risk-free interest rate, population density, and the existence of free trade zones, etc. This understanding of system behavior will be helpful for policy makers in devising ways to curb the escalation of property price while enjoying the benefits of HSR.

title: Economic Loss, Strategic Gain: The Geoeconomic Logic Behind China’s Investment in the Jakarta–Bandung High-Speed Rail Project (JBHSR) in Indonesia
abstract: The Jakarta-Bandung High-Speed Railway (JBHSR) project, established by Indonesia and China is often perceived as an economic failure. The JBHSR project was initiated in 2015 as a pure business-to-business (B2B) project and was scheduled for completion in 2023. A series of problems have occurred in this project, such as construction delays, cost overruns, and low financial feasibility. Despite this, China continues the JBHSR project, which contradicts conventional economic logic, where investors choose to stop due to losses. China’s commitment sparks curiosity, leading to a question as the object of the author's analysis: why does China continue to invest in Indonesia in the Jakarta-Bandung High-Speed Rail (JBHSR) project, even though the project is experiencing short-term financial losses? The author uses a geoeconomic approach by identifying China's actions in converting financial risks in the JBHSR project into strategic leverage for the purpose of sphere of influence, particularly in the Southeast Asian region. This research uses explanatory qualitative methods and data collection techniques based on literature studies. The research indicates that the economic challenges in the JBHSR project did not stop China's involvement, but instead strengthened the structural ties between Indonesia and China through the restructuring of financing from Indonesian loans and technology transfer. The JBSHR represents an economic loss-strategic gain paradox, meaning losses are not a barrier as long as the project successfully delivers significant geopolitical and geoeconomic benefits.

title: Effect of Market Competition on Passengers’ Time Cost by Conventional Rail
journal: Hiroshima University Acedemic Information Repository (Hiroshima University)
abstract: Due to heavy deficits, the privatization of Japanese National Railways (JNR) was initiated on April 1, 1987 and was geographically divided into six different railway companies for transporting passengers. This paper investigates the impact of market competition on conventional rail (CR) passengers’ time cost by using a difference-in-differences (DID) approach and directional origin-destination (OD) pair level data in four periods: two years before JNR’s privatization (1976 and 1986) and two years after JNR’s privatization (1996 and 2006). It investigates the effect of market competition on passengers’ time cost in the regions where CR competes with high-speed rail (HSR), when comparing with monopoly region after JNR privatization. The result of this analysis shows that market competition leads to an increment in passengers’ time cost by CR in duopoly regions when comparing with the change of time cost by CR in monopoly region, but it is not statistically significant.

title: Design of an Iterative Hybrid Deep Learning and GIS-MCDM Framework for Predictive High-Speed Rail Alignment Under Spatiotemporal and Uncertainty Constraints
abstract: The alignment planning of HSR tracks should be intelligent, resilient to future uncertainties, and able to satisfy dynamic changes of the environment, city agglomeration, and the social-economy. The existing methods that mainly use deterministic static GIS-MCDM models and GIS-based spatial models subconsciously fail to draw several spatiotemporal variabilities and uncertainties linked with the expected long-term landscape evolution; that is, they are not predictive, they do not include unnecessary uncertainties, and they have weighted their criteria as fixed values; due to their lack of credibility in planning practices, their use probably may not be highly relevant for real-world planning scenarios. Mindful of the limitations mentioned above, the research proposes a hybrid framework integrating deep learning with GIS-analytical MCDM to optimally align the tracks of HSRs in a predictive mode. Land-use changes and environmental risks are envisaged through the ST-GCN by using historical satellite remote sensing imagery to facilitate the accurate prediction of future status in a multi-temporal manner. Subsequently, under diverse climate and urban growth scenarios, the probability distributions of risk maps will be created by the Conditional Variational Autoencoders (C-VAE), thereby providing measures of uncertainty with 1,000-plus plausible futures. The criteria involved in making decisions will vary with changing predictions by a Hybrid Spatial-Temporal Attention Mechanism that will enable GIS-MCDM layers to be reweighted in real-time based on the predicted evolution of hotspots. Using a reinforcement-learning scheme, Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) will further optimize the core alignment by learning the routing strategies that minimize risk exposure and maximize compatibility with future conditions. Its ever-so Multi-Fidelity Bayesian will integrate cadastral data with multiple sources into the complex process. Data Fusion is used for high/low-res data synthesis and provides uncertainty-enabled input maps to steer the DRL and MCDM processes. This proposal will increase alignment robustness by 30%. Sharpened the conflict score without changing the prediction uncertainty inside ±10% accuracy of the true value in the process. This is a step that leads to adaptive, data-informed, and resilient Design of HSR infrastructure for long-term spatiotemporal variability in the process.

title: Social Exclusion and High-Speed Railways: Evidence from China
abstract: Background: Despite their economic, social, and environmental advantages, HSRs are associated with some negative social impacts and controversy about their equitability. Gap: Very few studies have explored the relationship between HSR and social exclusion. Aims: This paper examines the relationship between HSR and social exclusion, and it focuses on China as a case study. Objectives: The objectives of the study are as follows; to identify the most important and favourable factors for choosing HSR from passengers' perspective; to reveal issues and reasons that inhibit passengers from using HSR and limit their accessibility to the service, and to propose some solutions and interventions. Methods: The study utilizes an online survey comprising a set of stated preference and revealed preference questions. A total of 3655 responses were collected, of which 3353 responses were complete and useful. Results: A key finding is that comfort is proven to be the most favourable factor for using HSR, followed by travel time and reliability. Another finding is that the economic exclusion followed by the geographical exclusion is prevailing across different age and monthly income groups of non-HSR users. Those who have the lowest income and the elderly experience the strongest levels of economic exclusion. Moreover, physical, time-based, and fear-based exclusions are also notable. Conclusion: To create a modal shift from other modes to HSR and allow more groups to access the service, HSR should be competitive in terms of affordability and accessibility. Possible solutions and policy interventions that may help to tackle categories of social exclusion in China are presented.

title: Temporal evolution and regional economic implications of the spatial structure of high-speed rail network in Western China’s urban agglomerations (2014–2024)
abstract: Abstract During the development of transportation infrastructure in China, the high-speed rail (HSR) network has been rapidly expanded, exerting a substantial impact on regional economic growth. While most existing studies on the HSR-economy relationship have focused on developed regions in eastern China, this study selects two major urban agglomerations in the relatively less-developed western region—the Guanzhong Plain Urban Agglomeration (GPUA) and the Chengdu-Chongqing Urban Agglomeration (CCUA)—as its study subjects. This study constructs a multi-layer network framework based on complex network theory and the gravity model, incorporating physical and operational HSR networks along with an economic network. By employing Social Network Analysis (SNA), the Mantel test, and the Time Exponential Random Graph Model (TERGM), we systematically examine the spatiotemporal evolution of the HSR network structure, its correlation with the regional economic network, and the associated mechanisms and effects. The results indicate that from 2014 to 2024, the density of the HSR network increased in both the GPUA and the CCUA. The GPUA maintained a single-core structure centered on Xi’an, while the CCUA exhibited a dual-core structure with Chengdu and Chongqing as hubs. The Mantel test confirms a significant positive correlation between the HSR operational network and the economic network. This correlation is stronger in the more economically developed and administratively concentrated CCUA—spanning just one province and one municipality—than in the cross-provincial GPUA. Further analysis by TERGM demonstrates the independent role of HSR in the development of economic networks and its transmission path. Correlation analysis further reveals that enhanced HSR connectivity and strengthened economic ties are not fully synchronized.

title: Effects of High-speed Rail’s Competition Strategies on Price and Share in the Transportation Market
abstract: While a variety of papers consider only the competition between the two transportation means: aviation and high-speed rail (HSR), we analyze the effects of competition between the three parties by distinguishing aviation from full-service carrier (FSC) and low-cost carrier (LCC).This paper investigates the effect of the high-speed rail's competition strategies (weight of welfare, rail speed and access time to transport terminals) on the equilibrium ticket price and market shares of each transportation mode with the use of an adapted Circular city model.The results show how the price and market share changes depending on the variation of the three variables.We further suggest implications from the perspective of each competitor based on the results.Finally, an empirical study on Korea's transportation markets is conducted to verify the proposed model and analyze the market situation.

title: Air Rail Links and Risk Analysis of Prague Airport Project
abstract: This paper describes the problems related to the integration of air and railway transport, which require building railway connections to hub airports, especially networks of long distance railways and high-speed tracks that link large cities with airport terminals. It presents and analyzes some solutions that have been implemented in Europe and focuses on a similar project which is currently being prepared in the Czech Republic at the dynamically growing international airport in Prague. For the final decision making process concerning the possibilities of a rail connection between Prague city and its airport a comprehensive comparative study, including risk analysis, was processed by the Czech Technical University in Prague, Faculty of Transportation Sciences.

title: High-Speed Railway Opening, Industrial Symbiotic Agglomeration and Green Sustainable Development—Empirical Evidence from China
abstract: In recent years, China’s transportation infrastructure has undergone significant changes. High-speed rail, as a new and favored mode of transportation, offers travelers convenience, efficiency, and punctuality, replacing many high-pollution transportation methods. Based on the characteristics of high-speed rail, this paper selects data from 30 provinces spanning from 1999 to 2019. It utilizes the double-difference method to evaluate the impact of high-speed rail opening on economic sustainability. It has been found that the introduction of high-speed rail contributes to economic sustainability during the examination period. The mechanism test also reveals that the opening of high-speed rail promotes green and sustainable development through the industrial agglomeration effect. In addition, the opening of high-speed rail (HSR) has a significant time lag effect and a spatial spillover effect on green sustainable development. The conclusion complements the theoretical framework regarding the impact of high-speed rail on the environment and regional economic sustainability. It also provides guidance for the efficient utilization of high-speed rail, which holds both theoretical and practical importance.

title: Study on the Interest Game of Intermodal Road-Rail Transportation Under Low Carbon Policy
abstract: Intermodal road-rail transportation (IRRT) integrates the advantages of railways and roads to achieve a win-win situation for all participants.However, the interest game problem of IRRT affects the enthusiasm of each sub-carrier to cooperate, which makes it difficult to show its advantages in the competition with the truck-only transport (TOT), and then retards the promotion process of the multimodal transport industry.In order to improve the competitiveness of IRRT, based on Stackelberg game and lowcarbon policy, the interest coordination problem of supply chain composed of road transport enterprises (RTE), railway transport enterprises (RWTE) and multimodal transport operators (MTO) is studied under the background of the TOT's competition.The RESULTS SHOW THAT THE active intervention of the local government has a significant promotion effect on the profits of the RTE and the RWTE under the decentralized decision mode, while the profits of the MTO show a trend of decreasing first and then increasing.

title: Appraisal of rail projects
abstract: Many difficulties surround project appraisal in the rail sector regarding the definition of the base case, the potentially large number of options available, the interaction of individual rail projects, and the effects on the appraisal of assumptions about future price and service levels. Sensible project appraisal requires a clear vision of the objectives of the company and of the future mix of services, fares and quality to which it aspires. What is needed in Britain is a transport infrastructure programme in which all modes are treated on a comparable basis regarding both appraisal and funding.

title: On ballastless track on railways
abstract: From the advantages and disadvantages of the ballastless track on railways,the structural classification of the ballastless track,the application of the ballastless track in China and the problems,the paper has the brief indication on the ballastless track,so as to have more accurate understanding of the ballastless track and to extend its application in passenger special lines and the express railways.

title: Ballastless track on railway bridges
abstract: This study focuses on problems related to the application of ballastless track on railway bridges. The different kinds of this track are presented, along with their advantages and disadvantages. Special attention is given to the generated vibration and noise by moving trains and their influence on the behaviour of the bridge structure. Methods of dumping are presented too. Transfer of longitudinal forces in the lateral and longitudinal directions is given. The interaction between the continuous welded rail and the bridge structure is written. Longitudinal resistance of the fastening system for ballastless track is also given. The use of a sealing layer between the track and the bridge deck is considered. Problems relating to the uplift of the girder ends are given. Cracks in the concrete elements of ballastless track on the bridge structure are considered. Some of the solutions to the problems mentioned above are given in general design rules produced by different organizations, and some are or will be given in current or prepared standards.

title: Design of Ballastless Track of Suining-Chongqing Railway
abstract: Research purposes:The purposes are to solve the tough technical problems in laying ballastless track by unified section through making design of the ballstless track of Suining-Chongqing Railway for the purpose of providing reference to design and construction of ballastless track of high-speed railway. Research results:With the advanced concept,the designs of the structures,materials and reinforced concrete cracks of slab track and double slab ballastless track are made in details and the methods of solving the tough technical problems in laying ballastless track are presented.

title: The technique economy of the high-speed railway ballastless track
abstract: As the new Guangzhou station experiment stage on Wuhan-Guangzhou passenger special line and experiment of track-laying on Qinhuangdao-Shenyang passenger special line for example,this paper gives a comparative analysis to the traditional ballasted track and ballastless track at technique and economy.The comparing analysis of the application situation of the ballastless track is given in general structure property,manufacturing and construction,track maintaince and other aspects.To guide the type selection and design of high-speed railway traditional ballastless track.

title: ANALYSIS OF BALLASTLESS RAILWAY TRACK STRUCTURES OVER SOFT CLAYS
abstract: Railway developments in Egypt have gained much interest recently. This development was in many fields one of which is railway speeds and the term high speed trains “HST” was introduced as an alternative on Egyptian national railways. HST has many challenges from a geodynamic perspective; such as the case of HST operating in areas with soft soils such as soft clays in Delta area in Egypt. In this paper, the problem of HST over soft soils was considered from a dynamic response point of view and ballastless tracks was investigated and compared with the traditional ballasted track. A track concept was introduced recently as a solution for this problem called “Deck track” but very few literature studied this idea. This track concept was studied and further modified into two other types. These tracks were dynamically analyzed using 3D finite element modeling constructed. Results of the ballastless track models will be compared with the Ballasted track model in order to observe if it mitigates the effects of HST over soft clays or not and also to show if the modified tracks is performing better than the Deck track or not. Dynamic response results of the models were displayed and comparisons were made for all track structures.

title: Discussion on Accurate Adjustment of Ballastless Track of High-speed Railway
abstract: This paper introduces the significance and relevant concepts of accurate adjustment of ballastless track of high-speed railway,discusses the standards,procedures,methods and notes of static accurate adjustment and dynamic accurate adjustment of tracks,analyzes main factors influencing the track precision,and puts forward some main measures for improving the track precision.

title: Precisely survey for ballastless track in the passenger dedicated railway line
journal: Journal of Railway Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on the control survey network of CPⅢ Resectionin ballastless track,survey technology of precise decided track was analysed.Firstly,the method of free station overlap positioning with total station actively,theory study,error analysis and design were described,and then the results from simulation experiment and field testing were compared and confirmed.It is helpful and valuable to precise survey of the passenger dedicated railway line and regional inter-city railway.

title: Construction Safety Management of High-speed Railway Ballastless Tracks
abstract: In the construction safety management of high-speed railway ballastless tracks,there should be the idea of standards for everything,for everybody in every part to achieve the goal of safety management through the all-part,all-process and all-weather management mode.

title: Quality Acceptance of Railway Track Engineer on Ballastless Track System
journal: DEStech Transactions on Social Science Education and Human Science
abstract: The Supervision Management team and Organization, in accordance with the regulations, rules, codes and standards issued by the MOR, in order to improve the supervision level and standardize the supervisory practice in ballastless system construction shall: Establish the leading group; Clarify the responsibility; Establish Document Management system; Train and Tests of personnel.This document clarifies all these aspects according to the client requirement for the Ballastless track system construction process. The Supervision organization shall check technical control system and quality management system of the contractor that mainly included: Organization Structure of technical management and quality management System; Technical and quality management system; Full time quality management personnel and their presence on site; and Train, Tests, Qualification certificate and Work License of special staff.

title: The study on slab ballastless track system for High speed railway in China
abstract: The CRTS III slab ballastless track system on high-speed railway in China is a new high-speed railway which has a completely independent intellectual property rights of the ballastless track structural system. Because the operational time is shorte r to the CRTS III slab ballastless track system on high-speed railway in China, the maintenance experience for the CRTS III slab ballastless track is relative lacking. It is important to form a more perfect for high-speed railway slab ballastless track structure damage maintenance repair technology. This paper have carried on the reason analysis which may produce wound disease, proposed high-speed railway CRTS III type ballast less track maintenance and repair advice to perfect Chinese ballastless track maintenance and repair technology. It has an important realistic significance to show the CRTS III slab ballastless track system to the world.

title: Construction Techniques for Ballastless Slab Track for High-Speed Railway Bridges
abstract: The key construction techniques for a new type of track structure, the ballastless slab track for highspeed railway bridges are presented, which includes construction of track salb, proportioning and grouting of CA mortar, and setting of the filledin pad plates, and are of reference and practical values to still wider use of the techniques for construction of urban lightrail transit viaducts and highspeed railway bridges.

title: The Ballastless Track Construction Technology within the High-speed Railway Tunnel
abstract: Taking the Zhengzhou -Xi’an high speed railway as the example, this paper introduces in detail the technical principles and construction procedures of the ballastless track construction on the bridge within high -speed railway tunnel by using Zublin construction machinery.

title: Dynamic Simulation of Ballastless Railway Track System with Local Invalid Sleepers
abstract: Considering local sleepers supported invalidly, the dynamic analysis is presented for ballastless railway track system subjected to moving loads. The track is modeled as an infinitely Euler-Bernoulli beam with Kelvin viscoelastic foundation. The restrain conditions of system change suddenly at unsupported sleepers. Numerical simulating was carried out by the finite element discrete and Newmarks-method. Dynamic responses of system were analyzed in the case of single or multi-sleeper to be not working properly. Results show that the maximum value of displacement of track is going up 50% approximately due to an invalid sleeper occurring. The amplitude of vibration is two times increase when three sleepers to be hung up. Hence, there would be a bad effect on the vibration control of ballastless railway track system as some sleepers lose efficacy continuously.

title: Settlement calculation method analysis of foundation under ballastless railway track
abstract: It introduces the calculation method of foundation's total settlement and settlement after construction,and points out that settlement empirical coefficient given in Code For Design Of Building Foundation may not be applicable to foundation under ballastless railway track.

title: Longitudinal Section Design on Ballastless Track Subgrade of Passenger Dedicated Railway
abstract: Research purposes: In order to effective control of the settlement and stiffness differences of the subgrade connecting to bridge and tunnel,it is necessary to carry out the longitudinal section design of subgrade.This paper presents the function and significance of the longitudinal section design of subgrade and discusses its main contents and technical gists.Research conclusions:The longitudinal section design of subgrade shall be carried out for the passenger ballastless track railway.Its content include the inspection and treatment of connected stiffness differences and settlement differences as well as engineering interfaces.For the design of passenger ballastless track railway,the principle of  Longitudinal priority  shall be carried out: firstly the longitudinal section design of subgrade works and then aided design of the transversal section based on its longitudinal section design shall be performed.The quantity of the transversal section of subgrade can be appropriately reduced.

title: Construction of spray polyurea of special passenger railway lines with ballastless track
abstract: With the construction of spray polyurea of special passenger railway lines with ballastless track as the research content,through every procedure of spray polyurea is discussed,the materials properties,construction technology,control points and test methods of spray polyurea are analyzed emphatically,which has certain guiding significance for practical construction.

title: Design of Bi-block Sleeper for Ballastless Track of Hefei-Wuhan Railway
abstract: Research purposes: The Pandrol fastening is a kind of elastic divided fastening without shoulders,and its application in Heifei-Wuhan Railway was the first time for China to use.No Bi-block sleeper for the Pandrol fastening has been designed or produced in China before.This paper introduces the design of Bi-block sleepers for the Pandrol fastening to provide the reference to the design of ballastless track.Research conclusions:The Pandrol fastening is largely different from the other fastenings in matching rail with sleeper,anchor mode,isolation system,fixing systems for fastening and base plate,so during the design of bi-block sleeper,the factors such as the moulds manufacture,the stripping technique,size accuracy,storage of finished products,conveying,connection with track bed and the durability of ballastless track structure should be considered together.

title: On exploration for CRTSII type ballastless track layout measurement technique of express railway
abstract: Combining with the constructing characteristics of ballastless track project,the paper taking Shijiazhuang-Wuhan railway project as the example,introduces CRTS Ⅱ type ballastless track layout measurement technique of express railways,including CP Ⅲ control network layout measurement technique,GRP layout measurement technique,and track plate layout measurement technique,so as to accumulate the precious experience for similar ballastless track construction measurement work.

title: Research on crack control technology of ballastless track of high-speed railway
abstract: This paper studies various cracks features and occurring causes of current ballastless track structure of high-speed railway,puts forward crack-preventing methods from materials,design and construction three aspects,simultaneously introduces modification methods adapting to different width cracks such as open-tank process,low pressure grouting method,and surface coverage method and so on,with a view to provide guidance for engineering application.

title: Dynamic response of railway ballastless track-bed under various saturated conditions
journal: Journal of Engineering and Applied Science
abstract: Abstract Localised saturated zones formed within ballastless railway subgrades owing to rainfall infiltration and moisture accumulation may significantly alter the dynamic response of the track-bed under moving train loads. This study numerically investigates the influence of different saturated conditions on the dynamic response of a ballastless track-bed using a three-dimensional FLAC3D model. The numerical model considers one unsaturated reference condition and six cases containing localized fully saturated zones with different depths and thicknesses in the subgrade bottom layer. Under train-induced cyclic loading corresponding to a train speed of 100 km/h, the variation of dynamic soil stress, vibration velocity, and vibration acceleration along the depth and transverse direction of the track-bed were systematically analysed. The results show that the presence of saturation zones substantially increases the dynamic response of the track-bed compared with the unsaturated condition. Increasing the thickness of the saturation zone leads to greater increases in dynamic soil stress and vibration responses, while saturation zones located closer to the track surface produce more pronounced effects than those at greater depths. For example, at the top of the saturation zone, the vertical dynamic soil stress increases by up to 8.90%, whereas the vibration velocity increases by up to 18.88% compared with the unsaturated condition. The findings enhance the understanding that both the depth and thickness of saturated zones govern the dynamic response of ballastless track-beds. Under the investigated loading and material conditions, shallow and relatively thick saturated zones produced the greatest increases in the predicted dynamic response of the ballastless track system, underscoring the importance of effective drainage and moisture management in the design and maintenance of high-speed railway substructures.

title: On double-block ballastless track construction technology of Chang-Da railway tunnel
abstract: The paper illustrates the construction technology of double-block ballastless track of Chang-Da railway tunnel,mainly researches the construction problems,including the size control and the logistic control of the ballastless track construction technology in the curve section of Chang-Da railway tunnel,and ensures the accuracy and speedy construction of the ballastless track of Chang-Da railway tunnel.

title: Analysis on ballastless track structure lectotype of central south railway in Shanxi province
abstract: The paper describes the features of central south railway channel in Shanxi province,analyzes several ballastless track structure composition of domestic passenger-goods transportation railway line,carries out performance comparison,and finally points out ballastless track structure in the tunnel which is fitting for central south railway channel.

title: Monitoring and Research on Subgrade Settlement of Ballastless Track of High-speed Railway
abstract: Research purposes:High speed railway needs a very strict control of post-construction subgrade settlement.The post-construction subgrade settlemen mainly refers to the residual subgrade settlement after the track is laid.The design speed of the Shijiazhuang-Wuhan high-speed Railway is 350 km/h with the ballastless track.During the construction,the monitoring and research were done on the subgrade settlement in the tested section in order to research the scientificness of reinforcing subgrade. Research conclusions:The pile + plate structure and CFG pile composite foundation was used for reinforcing the deep soft soil foundation along with the heap pre-loading.The settlement volume during construction was up to the 72%-85% of the total settlement volume,so the post-construction settlement was effectively controlled.The vertical settlement of the foundation in the whole section was even and it met the demand of laying the ballstless track and proved the reinforcement measures were feasible.

title: Measurement of CPIII Control Net for Ballastless Track of High-speed Railway
abstract: Research purposes: According to the construction of Ballastless ride request,studying network layout and survey methods of CP Ⅲ control for meeting the construction requirements for.Studying to meet the construction requirements of the CP Ⅲ control network location accuracy requirements and CP Ⅲ Control Network relative error and repeatable measurement error precision control indicators,which explicitly CP Ⅲ Control Network error,and ultimately to meet the non-ballast track construction on the smoothness requirements Measurement of protection provided.Research conclusions:(1) CP Ⅲ control network is installed evenly along the railway and the multiple-direction intersection in rear is adopted in the measurement.This is crucial to control of the relative error between measurement spots of CP Ⅲ control network.(2) The relative error between measurement spots ofCP Ⅲ Control Network and the repeatable precision control of the measurement error can meet meet the requirements of the track regularity.

title: Application of Helmert Variance Component Estimation to Ballastless Track Railway Control Network
abstract: The relative accuracy of two adjacent points in the network of ballastless track railway must be controlled within 1 mm,which means that it should be assessed reasonably and reliably.In adjustment problems,the improper stochastic model affects the adjustment results and their accuracy evaluation.This paper presents an introduction to the construction process of the first ballastless track railway from Beijing to Tianjin in China.Then,the Helmert variance estimation method is employed to reasonably determine the weights of directions and sides in adjustment processing,thus achieving the reliable adjusted coordinates and their accuracies.

title: Research on Linear Monitoring Technology for Bridges on Ballastless Track High-speed Railway
abstract: The bridges on high speed railway which adopted ballastless tracks has strict demand on the elevation and smoothness of the beam's top surface.So,the linear monitoring method for the beam's top surface elevation of bridges on the ballastless track high speed railway was introduced,and the formula of the beam's top surface elevation after concreting was put forward.The grey system and self-adaptive control method were both applied to the linear monitoring of Beijing 4th ring road bridge at Beijing-Tianjin express passenger line,and the vertical deflection and precamber were forecasted for this bridge.The linear results indicate that this two construction control methods and the beam's top surface elevation control methods are suit for the construction control of the bridges on ballastless track high speed railway.

title: BALLASTLESS TRACK APPLICATION IN EXISTING TUNNELS - EXPERIENCE GAINED ON AUSTRIAN FEDERAL RAILWAYS
abstract: A great number of ballastless track applications can be found in tunnels. These ballastless tracks, built during the past three decades, were mainly laid in new or short tunnels and in high-speed line applications. However, on Austrian Federal Railways (OBB) more than 10 km of ballastless track has been installed in two existing long tunnels. This article looks at the ballstless track in the Tauern tunnel, a classical summit and base tunnel running through the Alps with a total length of 8,550 m. The construction of the tunnel was completed in 1909.

title: Dynamic Design of Stiffness Transition of Turnout in Ballastless Track of Suining-Chongqing Railway
abstract: Research purposes: The main purposes of research are to clarify the stiffness characteristic of block section and turnout area in integral trial section for ballastless track on Suining-Chongqing Railway.In order to improve comfortableness and prolong the service life of the track structure,the stiffness transion should be set between block section and turnout area.And this paper proposes the transition design between block section and turnout area on Suining-Chongqing railway.Research methods:Based on a theory of train-track coupling dynamics model,the stiffness characteristic of ballastless track in block section and in turnout area in the SuiningChongqing Railway is analyzed.Research results:There are more track stiffness difference between block section and turnout area.Results obtained from the paper show that track stiffness in turnout area is 2~3 times as track stiffness in block section of integral trial section for ballastless track on Suining-Chongqing Railway.Track stiffness transitions should be set there.Research conclusions:The method of the hierarchical track stiffness can be applied in the stiffness transition section of the turnout,and the stiffness is set about 18 sleeper spaces per grade.When the dynamic slope of the deflection of rail is less then 0.3 mm/m,the dynamic performance of the stiffness transition of turnout is satisfactory.

title: Modeling of anisotropic base plate of a ballastless railway track under dynamic influences
abstract: Introduction. Due to dynamic loading, the upper structure of the railway track is subject to deformation over the entire construction and operation period. This paper focuses on the development of a mathematical model of the base plate of a general-type ballastless railway track structure without relying on specific existing technological solutions used for such elements. The effect of the actually given vertical component of the rolling stock velocity arising from the deviation from the design position of the long-welded rails on the dynamic deflection of the plate and the contact force of cylindrical anisotropy and the initial rate of dynamic interaction is studied. The proposed model makes it possible to take into account the effect of elastic waves originating in the contact area between the wheel and the rail that move at their final speeds after contact. The actual issue researched in this paper is the reinforcement of the ballastless railway base plate for the prevention of severe damage in the base plate. Materials and methods. A mathematical model has been developed to describe the dynamic behavior of a reinforced concrete plate of a ballastless railway track taking into account the specifics of load application from rolling stock wheel sets. Results. Detailed presentation of the research results in the form of analytical expressions and dependence diagrams of dynamic and kinematic parameters of the structure behavior can have practical application when designing rapid transit and high-speed railway lines both in Russia and abroad. Conclusions. The obtained results can be used for carrying out full-fledged research of dynamic behavior of the track bed under mobile loading, for checking the local durability of plates under shock impact, for researching and selecting optimal rigidity parameters for the track bed.

title: Discuss on the Column-Net Structure of Ballastless Track in Sui-Yu Railway Line
abstract: Research purposes: The exploration is made on issues of design calculation theory for Column-Net Structure technology of foundation treatment of Ballastless Track in Sui-Yu Railway Line.Research methods:The article reviewed the present situation of construction of Ballastless Track in the Passenger Transportation Line in China.Based on experimental section of Unballasted Track on soil subgrade in Sui-Yu Railway Line,design calculation theory of Column-Net Structure has been carried on detailed explanation,including the constitution research,the flexible arch research,bearing capacity research and settlement research.Considered to the interaction complexity of the column,net and soil under the train cyclic load,the paper detailed describes indoor large scale model testing,field dynamic testing and numerical calculation method about the Column-Net Structure.Research results: The method of design calculation for Column-Net Structure has been carried on the summary.And the paper describes the developed research in experimental section.It hopes that these can provide more experiences for further research.

title: Analysis on the Noise Reduction Effect of the Sound Absorption Panels for Railway Ballastless Track
abstract: The noise radiation of railway ballastless track is more severe than that of the ballast track.The common way to reduce the impact of the wheel/rail noise on the surrounding environment is to lay sound absorption panels on the surface of the ballastless track.In order to control the wheel/rail noise radiation of the railway ballastless track,a model was developed based on the sound absorption theory of micro-perforated panels to calculate the absorption coefficient of the porous sound absorption panels.Then the calculated sound absorption coefficient was input into the wheel/rail noise prediction system to obtain the fre-quency spectrum and equivalent sound level of the wayside noise.The influence laws of the material porosity,the plate thickness and the micro-porous diameters on the reduction effect of the wheel/rail noise were analyzed.The results show that,the greater is the material porosity of the porous sound absorption panel,the better is the wheel/rail noise absorption.However,too much of the material porosity can reduce the sound absorption of the middle and high frequency wheel/rail noise.It is proposed that the material porosity should be controlled within the range of 0.4%～0.6%.The greater is the thickness of the porous sound absorption panels,the better is the wheel/rail noise absorption,but too much of the panels thickness will give rise to other train running safety problems.Accordingly,the thickness of the panel should be controlled under the limit values which can effectively reduce the noise as well as guarantee the running safety. The greater is the micro-porous diameters of the sound absorption panel,the worse is the wheel/rail noise absorption effect.

title: CRTS II Ballastless Track Construction in Railway Bridge Section
abstract: CRTS Ⅱ ballastless track is the structure for a new-type passenger line rails with the characteristic of stability and adaptability,which needs less maintenance and has a long life.The construction technology,methods and processes of CRTS Ⅱ bridge slab ballastless track is introduced with the purpose to provide reference for similar projects.

title: Analysis on Innovative Methods for Reinforcing Structure of Steep Slope Subgrade of Ballastless Track Railway
abstract: Ballastless track railway has very strict demand for ride comfort,stability and durability. When it is constructed on steep slope section as subgrade,rational reinforcing structure should be selected to resolve the problems such as uneven settlement of subgrade fillings and foundation soil as well as excessive horizontal deformation of reinforcing structure. Innovative thinking and approach can be used to overcome the mind-set,thereby to ensure more systematic and scientific selection of the scheme of reinforcing structure. By adopting innovative approach,the following conclusions are obtained: excessive lateral differential settlement is the core issue for steep slope subgrade of ballastless track railway; its conflict area is steep slope fillings; chair-shaped pile board structure is a better reinforcing structure for the steep slope subgrade of ballastless track railway under the present technical conditions.

title: Experimental Research on Pile-Mesh Structure Subgrade of Ballastless Track of Suining-Chongqing Railway
abstract: Research purposes:In order to realize the strict control of the post construction settlement of railway subgrade of ballastless track,the pile-mesh structure subgrade is adopted in the ballastless track integrated experimental section of Suining-Chongqing Railway for the first time,so it is necessary to do the research on mechanism and load bearing characteristic of pile-mesh structure.Research methods:The experimental researches are done on the load bearing characteristic and mechanism of the pile-mesh structure subgrade of ballastless track by adopting numerical calculation analysis,centrifuge model test,indoor cyclic loading dynamic model test and in-site test and etc.Based on the research results,the definition,working principle and design technology of the pile-net structure subgrade are discussed.Research results:The definition,working principle and design technology are presented according to the outcomes of test and research.Research conclusions:As the pile-mesh structure subgrade has the merits of less deformation due to vertical settlement and less deformation-stable time,so the pile-mesh structure can be used for strengthening the deep,soft and weak subsoil of ballastless track railway,completed embankment and the special subsoil,such as in the turnout area of ballastless track.

title: Design of and Thoughts on Ballastless Track Bridge of Zhengzhou-Xi'an Railway Passenger Dedicated Line
abstract: Research purposes:Zhenzhou-Xi'an Railway Passenger Dedicated Line is the first ballastless track passenger line built in collapsible loess area in China.The researches are done on and the analyses are made of the key technologies for design of the ballastless track bridges in the section between Mianchi and Lingbao of the line for the purpose of solving the problems of design of ballastless track bridge of passenger dedicated line in collapsible loess area. Research results:Through making analyses of the key technologies for design of ballastless track bridge in the section between Mianchi and Lingbao of the line,the sampling principles of collapsible depth and negative friction of collapsible loess,the calculation method and control principle of subsidence,the control method of lateral rigidity of pier and the control principle of vertical linear rigidity of adjacent pier are pointed out,and the important issues for attention in construction of the bridges on the line are also mentioned.

title: Preliminary study of concrete with manufactured sand in high-speed railway ballastless track slab
abstract: Abstract The use of manufactured sand (MS) in concrete has become an inevitable choice in some regions in China with the increasing depletion of natural river sand. However, the study on the cracking resistance of ballastless track slabs prepared with manufactured sand concrete (MSC) is insufficient due to the complexity of chemical composition and mechanical properties. In this paper, the influence of manufactured sand lithology, that is, basalt, tuff, granite as well as limestone and stone powder (SP) content, at 5%, 10% and 15%, on the static mechanical properties of concrete was first investigated. A static load experiment for China Railway Track System Ⅲ ballastless track slab prepared with MS was then conducted. The crack distribution and damage factor of MSC track slab were analysed by the finite element analysis method. The bending moment of MSC track slab was further evaluated by considering train loads, temperature loads and subgrade settlement. Results show that the compressive strength and elastic modulus of MSC are generally higher than those of river sand concrete, which can be attributed to the sharper edges of MS particles. The static cracking resistance of the MSC track slab meets the required standards when qualified MS is used. However, the SP content in MS exhibits a dual effect on prestressed concrete track slabs and is recommended to be limited to within 10%. This study demonstrates a feasible approach for applying MS in high-speed railway ballastless track slabs.

title: Construction technology of double-block ballastless track on subgrade for passenger railway of Wu-Guang
abstract: This paper introduces the constructive components of doubleblock ballastless track on subgrade,the character of structure,the construction method and process and quality control,the attention of construction.And point out that the double-block ballastless track applied on passenger railway is a new track structure.It is a low maintenance durable track structure with high stability,high geometric regularity and uniform track stiffness.

title: Exploration on the Surveying and Data Processing of Control Network for Ballastless Track of High-Speed Railway
abstract: Research purposes: Construction of the ballastless track of high-speed railway needs control network III(CPIII) for precise survey and control.For such control networks with high accuracy,the modern precise surveying devices should be adopted along with the optimum surveying scheme and reliable data processing for control of quality.This paper discusses the construction procedure and surveying scheme of CPIII and the corresponding data processing method for the first ballastless track high-speed railway from Beijing to Tianjin in China for providing the reference to the similar projects in future.Research conclusions:The ballastless track control network based on free station and linear-angular intersection for high-speed railway is better than the general network in precision and network stability,which can satisfy the precise requirement of high-speed railway construction.The study and analyses of the surveying and data processing of CPII and CPI show the network with one surveying spot very 60m can satisfy the requirement of the track regularity and the control spot is restrained one time about very 500 m can save money.

title: Key Construction Technologies of Ballastless Track of Railway Passenger Dedicated Line and Their Economic Analysis
abstract: Research purposes:The purposes are to more deeply know the structural form,key construction technologies and construction cost of ballastless track of railway passenger dedicated line for meeting the requirements of construction of railway passenger dedicated line with high standard. Research results:Through giving the introductions to the structural form,key construction technologies and construction cost of the ballastless track of passenger dedicated line and making the comparisons of the construction costs among foreign countries,the brief economic analyses of the construction cost of passenger dedicated line in China are made in combination with the construction example of passenger dedicated line.

title: STUDIED ON THE DAMAGE OF SLAB BALLASTLESS TRACK STRUCTURE AND MAINTENANCE TECHNIQUES FOR HIGH-SPEED RAILWAY
abstract: Slab ballastless track is the main mode of the high-speed railway in China. Different damages most likely occur with complex operating environment,operating conditions,loading conditions and differences in climatic conditions. Three main damages are found in the research of slab ballastless track such as gap of mortar layer and track slab,damages of mortar layer and concrete injuries. Based on the research of the causes of different damages,different maintenance techniques and materials are discussed which provides technical support for the maintenance and the design of ballastless track.

title: On precast construction of CRTSI ballastless track panel of Guangzhou-Zhuhai inter-city railway
abstract: The paper introduces the general design for the precast of the CRTSⅠ ballastless track panel of Guangzhou-Zhuhai inter-city railway,illustrates the precast construction technique,the construction methods and the supervision points of the track panel,so as to provide the theoretic direction for improving the precast quality of CRTSⅠ track panel products.

title: IMPROVEMENTOF BALLASTLESS TRACK DESIGNS FOR TURNOUTS: EXPERIENCE GAINED ON AUSTRIAN FEDERAL RAILWAYS (OBB)
abstract: The article describes the study Austrian Federal Railways began in the late 1980s of the ballastless track concept, which was, subsequently, used as the standard type of construction for tunnel sections. It was later determined that each project had to be viewed as an individual undertaking, and that different designs had to be created for open areas, for bridges, and for turnouts.

title: Construction Technology of Slab Ballastless Track Foundation of Turnout Area on Subgrade of High-Speed Railway
abstract: Slab ballastless track was laid in turnout area of the main line of Beijing-Shanghai High-speed Railway,and the foundation of the slab ballastless track included three parts: the cushion,concrete base and the turnout plate.Taking Zaozhuang West Station of the guide section of Beijing-Shanghai High-speed Railway as an example,this article introduces the construction technology of the slab ballastless track foundation of turnout area and the key quality control measures in detail.

title: Key Points for Design of Ballastless Track Fastening of High-speed Railway
abstract: Research purposes:The fastening is an important part of track structure.For assuring the absolute traffic safety and riding comfortableness,it is required that the rail fastening has features of enough fastening and compression force,perfect insulation property,low rigidity,less maintenance and consistent rigidity of all nodes.Therefore,the fastening technology is the key technology for ballastless track structure and making the better design of fastening is an important part of the design of high-speed railway.Research conclusions:The fastening not only has the enough strength and fastening and compression force,but also has the good elasticity and certain adjustable capacity.As there are various types of fastenings with the different applicable ranges,in design,the fastening should be chosen according to the property parameters of fastening,design principle the points mentioned above for making full use of fastening property and achieve the goals of money-saving,reasonable usage and assuring the traffic safety.

title: Optimum Design of Plane Control Net for Construction of Ballastless Track of Passenger Dedicated Railway
abstract: Research purposes: The method of distributing plane control net and principles of precision design are presented in this paper through doing the researches on the design of plane control net for construction of ballastless track of passenger dedicated railway.Research methods:By doing the simulation tests and making theoretical analysis of error,the inverse calculation was done for the precisions of control nets at all levels and the researches were done on the method of distributing control net and the principle of precision design.Research results:The method of distributing plane control net and principles of precision design are presented.Research conclusions:The limitation value of long deformation of coordinate projection of the control net for construction of ballastless of passenger dedicated railway should not be over 10 mm/km.A pair of inter-visible GPS spots far away of approximate 1km should be laid out within the range of 5 km along the railway for the control net.The extending auxiliary facilities with approximate values and conducting wires should be installed between the GPS spots and the side length of the wire should be between 400-600 mm.The angle error caused by the error of any three adjacent control foundation pile spots should not be over 8 minutes.

title: Overall Design of Bridge and Culvert in Integrated Experimental Section for Ballastless Track of Suining-Chongqing Railway
abstract: Research purposes:The purposes are to develop complete set of technologies of ballastless track on bridge with self-intellectual property and accumulate the experiences in design and construction of ballastless track on bridge. Research results:Based on the design characteristics of bridge and culvert in the first ballastless track integrated experimental section in China,the researches,analyses and summary are made on the technical problems related to the design of ballastless track bridge and culvert for providing the reference to the design of ballastless track bridge and culvert of railway passenger dedicated line.

title: The Displacement Limit at the End of an Approach Slab for a Railway Bridge with Ballastless Track
journal: Journal of the Korean society for railway
abstract: The transition area between a bridge and an earthwork is one of the weakest area of track because of the track geometry deterioration caused unequal settlement of backfill of abutment. In case of a ballastless track, the approach slab could be installed to prevent such a phenomenon. But, if there is occurred the inclined displacement on the approach slab by a settlement of the foundation or formation, the track is also under the inclined displacement. And this defect causes reducing the running stability of a vehicle, the riding comfort of passengers, and increasing the track deteriorations by excessive impact force acting on the track. In this study, parametric studies were performed to inves- tigate the displacement limit on the approach slab to avoid such problems. The length and the amount of unequal set- tlement of approach slab were adopted as parameter for numerical analysis considering vehicle-track interaction. Car body accelerations, variations of wheel force, stresses in rail, and uplift forces induced on fastener clip were investi- gated. From the result, resonable settlement limit on the end of an approach slab according to slab length was sug- gested.

title: On technical and economic comparison between edge sealing scheme of ballastless track plate on express railways
concepts: Enhanced Data Rates for GSM Evolution
abstract: Combining with the fact of the ballastless track plates along Beijing-Shanghai express railway,the paper explores the sealing scheme for the gap edges between the track plate and the bottom plates,compares and analyzes the angle scheme and mortar scheme of the edge sealing from the technical and economic aspects,and selects the angle steel edge sealing scheme,so as to provide certain direction for the future ballastless track construction along express railways.

title: Comprehensive Grounded System in Ballastless Track Tunnel on Yichang-Wanzhou Railway
abstract: 因无砟轨道内铺设了大量钢筋,对轨道电路一次参数产生影响,为了减少无砟轨道区段时轨道电路的传输衰耗,轨道结构中的钢筋作绝缘处理,以满足ZPW-2000A轨道电路信息在轨道电路中的传输距离要求.宜万铁路无砟轨道设置综合接地系统,各专业接地系统实现等电位连接,保证无砟轨道隧道结构本身、人员、设备和列车安全运行.通过综合接地系统的实施,宜万铁路无砟轨道ZPW-2000A轨道电路一次参数及道床漏泄电阻测试数...

title: Application of CFG Pile in Ballastless Track Integrated Experimental Section of Suining-Chongqing Railway
abstract: Research purposes:The research is done on the application of CFG pile in ballastless track integrated experimental section of Suining-Chongqing Railway for the purpose of learning more about CFG pile design and design. Research results:The strength of pile body can be designed to 5 MPa for CFG pile composite foundation and the beating capacity of CFG pile composite foundation is between 220 and 250 kPa in general,which can satisfy the design requirement.The one-month's post-construction subsidence of CFG pile composite foundation of embankment is becoming stable and stable with subsidence volume of 10～25 mm in general.

title: Stiffness measurement approach of track fasteners for high-speed ballastless railways in cold regions
journal: Journal of Rock Mechanics and Geotechnical Engineering
abstract: This study systematically investigates the stiffness measurement techniques and dynamic characteristics of fasteners in high-speed ballastless railway tracks in cold regions, exploring the effects of temperature, frequency, preload, and subgrade conditions on static and dynamic stiffness. A custom polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF) film constant-temperature sensor was developed, achieving seamless integration with the baseplate (thickness of 1.04 mm) through a "polarization–edge depolarization" process and layered bonding method. Experimental analysis of the piezoelectric properties of PVDF, combined with Hopkinson bar calibration, confirmed the sensor's stability and high-precision measurement capability over the range from –30 °C to 25 °C, significantly enhancing data reliability in freeze-thaw environments. Experiments used a laboratory compressor and a full-scale high-speed rail test model to measure fastener static stiffness, environmental static stiffness, dynamic stiffness, and environmental dynamic stiffness, revealing the effects of different boundary support conditions (rigid support and subgrade coupling), temperature, mean dynamic pressure, and frequency on baseplate stiffness. Concurrently, one million cycles of M-wave loading were applied to the full-scale high-speed rail test model. Results indicate that subgrade soil settlement varies with moisture content and that large-cycle loading increases the environmental dynamic stiffness of fasteners, thereby demonstrating the subgrade–baseplate coupling effect. The study provides a theoretical basis and experimental data for optimizing fastener design in cold regions to enhance track durability and reduce vibration.

title: Research on the Dimension of Ballastless Track Transition Section in High-speed Railway Based on UM Simulation
journal: Advances in Engineering Research Possibilities and Challenges
abstract: Based on the vehicle-track coupled dynamics theory, this study establishes a dynamics analysis model for a Chinese standard electric multiple unit (EMU). Aiming to systematically analyze the dynamic performance of high-speed trains passing through subgrade-bridge transition zones from the perspective of opera-tional safety, simulation calculations were conducted using UM software under identical track irregularity excitation conditions. These simulations modeled the dynamic responses of the vehicle-track system in ballastless track transition zones of high-speed railways under various structural dimensions and operating speeds. Key dynamic performance indicators, including wheel-rail forces and car body accelerations, were selected to evaluate train operational safety and ride comfort. The research findings provide an important theoretical basis for the optimized design and construction of high-speed railway subgrade-bridge transition zones.

title: Construction Technology and Equipment Innovation for Ballastless Track of Beijing-Tianjin Intercity High Speed Railway
abstract: The Beijing-Tianjin intercity high speed railway with a speed of 350 km/h is the first one in China.It is characterized by high technical standard,new construction technology and advanced construction equipment,etc.Basing on the lack of experience for constructing the ballastless track of high speed railway,China Railway No.2 Engineering Group Corporation Ltd.combines the Beijing-Tianjin intercity high-speed railway construction,follows the technical line of Indraught,Assimilation,Absorption and Reinnovation and carries on in-depth and systematic research on construction technology and key equipment of Type CRTSⅡslab ballastless track.The joint research together with the famous research center,university and manufacturer forms the technical innovation achievement of five construction technologies and five key equipments,which boosts the technical development of high speed railway construction in China.

title: On construction experience of passenger special line Rheda ballastless track in railway from Wuhan to Guangzhou
abstract: Based on the analysis of file on Rheda2000 ballastless track from overseas,the paper sums up experience from the aspects of measuring,installation of trock board reinforcing steel bar,concrete project,logistic organization and so on,combining with the factual situation of the passenger special line of railway from Wuhan to Guangzhou,and points out some substantial suggestions,so as to provide reference for upcoming Rheda 2000 ballastless track construction.

title: Rapid Survey Technology for Construction of Monolithic Track Bed of Bi-block Ballastless Track in Curved Sections of Double-track Railway Tunnels
abstract: The survey of the monolithic track bed is one of the key working procedures of ballastless track construction.Therefore,advanced foreign survey technologies and equipments for ballastless track bed construction are introduced to China and re-innovated to achieve smooth and precise geometric linear parameters and rapind construction survey of tracks.The practice of construction survey for the ballastless monolithic track bed in Feiluan tunnel on Wenzhou-Fuzhou railway is given in this paper.The survey staff,survey equipments and rough adjustment survey control method by simple track panel are presented.The fixed survey procedure combined with track detection car and construction survey control process of ballastless track and the attention items are determined.All of the above ensures the precision requirements of ballastless tracks in long tunnels and the rapid construction.

title: Study on railway subgrade stability of ballastless track in seasonally frozen regions under train loads
abstract: Abstract Railway subgrades situated in seasonally frozen zones frequently encounter the simultaneous impacts of freeze–thaw cycles and the dynamic loads imposed by passing trains, thereby rendering the stability concerns of these subgrades highly significant and far from being overlooked. Based on the engineering background of the ballastless track subgrade at the entrance of the Limin Tunnel along the Harbin-Mudanjiang Passenger Dedicated Line, this study investigates the subgrade stability of ballastless tracks in seasonally frozen regions under train loads using a thermo-mechanical indirect coupling method. The research findings indicate that: Under single-track and double-track train loads, both the stress peak and stress fluctuation amplitude during the thawing period are greater than those during the freezing period; The displacement peak and displacement influence range during the thawing period are larger than those during the freezing period under both single-track and double-track train loads, with double-track train loads inducing greater displacements than single-track loads for subgrades in different states; The vertical displacement under train load gradually decreases with the increase of depth, mainly affecting the depth from the surface layer to the bottom layer of the roadbed, that is, within the range of 0 ~ 5.6 m; When a train operates at 250 km h −1 on this subgrade section, the acceleration frequency under single-track train loads during freezing and thawing periods is concentrated between 10.6~17.7 Hz; The additional settlement deformation caused by long-term repeated train loads over 30 years is 1.708 mm, which meets the dynamic stability requirements for high-speed railway subgrades.

title: Early Warning of Foundation Settlement Deformation for Ballastless High-Speed Railway Tracks
journal: World Journal of Engineering and Technology
abstract: There has been rapid development of high-speed railway lines, especially passenger-dedicated railway lines, in China. Trains are traveling at speeds exceeding 250 km per hour and they require highly smooth tracks to ensure safety. However, there have been no in-depth studies on the early warning of the settlement of high-speed railway lines in China or abroad. Most methods use a simple model based on data processing and decision rules. The core issues of early warning lie in the science and rationality of decision rules. The present paper therefore investigates novel and critical indexes for the warning of settlement under high-speed railway lines according to existing norms and field data, and several essential indexes of deformation warning are suggested through theoretical and experimental analysis.

title: Thoughts on Waterproofing and Drainage System of Subgrade Engineering concerning Ballastless Track of Passenger Dedicated Railway Line
abstract: Research purposes: The establishment and key technical index or parameter has been studied for waterproofing and drainage system of subgrade engineering concerning ballastless track of passenger dedicated railway line and the preliminary frame and technical characteristics have been put forward of waterproofing and drainage system of subgrade engineering concerning ballastless track of passenger dedicated railway line in China.Research conclusions:The establishment of waterproofing and drainage system of subgrade engineering concerning ballastless track of passenger dedicated railway line has been put forward as well as four key technical problems which need to be further studied and resolved have been pointed out such as detection standard for water stability of subgrade filling,technical condition for asphalt concrete waterproof layer of subgrade surface,subdrainage structure and its maintenance and system optimization of waterproofing and drainage system for subgrade.

title: Prediction on Red Clay Foundation Settlement of Ballastless Track of High-Speed Railway
abstract: Prediction on red clay foundation settlement was put forward, using hyperbola method, exponential curve method and Hushino method, based on field data. Furthermore, Verhulst model, Gompertz model, Logistic model and Weibull curve were adopted in foundation settlement prediction. Subsequently, variable weight combination method and optimized combination model was studied to get more accurate prediction results. Finally, red clay foundation prediction of high speed railway was proposed.

title: Probe into the Construction Technology for CRTSISlab Ballastless Track in Shanghai-Ningbo Intercity Railway
abstract: This paper researches the technologies of the establishment of surveying control network,accurate adjustment of track slabs,and grouting of CA mortar,etc.of CRTSⅠslab ballastless track,and by using GRP precise engineering control network and high-precision quick-adjustment frame,ensures the precision of geometric position and the good smoothness of track slabs,and puts forward the effective maintenance measure of adding the P-emulsion into CA mortar for ensuring the quality of mortar grouting under the low temperature environment.

title: Spatial dynamic response laws of the ballastless track structure in high‐speed railways under vibration loads
abstract: Abstract The ballastless track in a high‐speed railway (HSR) is the primary structure that directly bears the load of high‐speed trains and its dynamic responses directly reflect the operation state of HSRs. However, there are few field test results about spatial dynamic responses of HSR ballastless tracks in previous research. Taking a prototype of an HSR ballastless track as the research object, dynamic response data of the HSR ballastless track were measured by arranging acceleration sensors thereon and applying vibration loads at different positions. The spatial dynamic response laws of the HSR ballastless track were explored in detail. The research results show that in the vertical, transverse, and longitudinal directions, the maximum accelerations all occur near the exciting points; the acceleration in the longitudinal direction is attenuated mainly in the supporting layer and has become very small after being transmitted to the top of the subgrade. The research findings provide guidance for the monitoring of dynamic responses of HSR ballastless tracks.

title: EXPERIMENTAL STUDY ON MICRO-EXPANSION MECHANISM OF ROADBED FILLER FOR HIGH-SPEED RAILWAY BALLASTLESS TRACK
abstract: This paper aims to find out the interaction mechanism between the expansive component and the aggregate in the coarse-grained filler of the high-speed railway subgrade. We select some sections of the ballastless track of the Westem China Passenger Dedicated Line. These sections are deformed by arches. In some of the work sites, the packing of the bed part is collected for sampling analysis, and the expansion test with the porosity-montmorillonite content as a variable is carried out. The variation law of filler expansion rate under the combined action of montmorillonite content and filler porosity is analyzed for the expansion mechanism of this micro-expansion filler. The test results show that the filler expansion rate is positively correlated with the content of expansive minerals(montmorillonite) and negatively correlated with porosity. After further analysis of these data, the parameter β is proposed and defined as the ratio of montmorillonite content to filler porosity for the index of ductility expansion of the roadbed filler. When the bed group A of the structure β=0.365, the expansion property of the group A filler reaches the critical index of the high-speed railway. Conversion of parameter β to expansion rate and numerical simulation proves the incompatibility of the current regulations with the design calculation of the high-speed railway.

title: Geological Survey for Ballastless Track Comprehensive Experimental Section of Chongqing Railway Terminal
abstract: Research purposes:The purposes are to make a full and efficient use of all kinds of prospecting means to find out the geologic conditions of the foundation for providing the real geological parameters to the design.Research methods:The different prospecting means are adopted to find out the geological conditions of each experimental section according to the different geological conditions.Research results:After analyzing and studying the same geological investigation data,relevant specifications,standards and study results at home and abroad,the various kinds of geological surveying methods are adopted to make geological survey,and the results of survey are real,accurate and reliable,which meet the design requirements and reach at the expected target.Research conclusions:In order to satisfy the strict requirement of ballastless track for subsidence control,the accuracy of geological investigation must satisfy and surpass existing specifications to reach and meet engineering requirement.

title: Application of Ballastless Track CP III Control Network Measure Method in the Building of High Speed Railway
abstract: In the process of building the ballastless track of the high speed railway from Wuhan to Guangzhou, the measuring method of the CPⅢ control network has played an extremely critical role. In this article, the form layout, measuring method, precision requirements and some other contents of the high speed railway ballastless track CP Ⅲ have been proposed. It has been proved that this control network has reliable technology basis and meets the construction requirements, which is available for other similar engineering.

title: Research on Structure Design of Slab Ballastless Track on Subgrade of Suining-Chongqing Railway
abstract: Research purposes: The mainly purposes of the research are to determine the structure parameters of slab ballastless track on subgrade(rigid subgrade,soil subgrade) in integral trial section for ballastless track on Suining-Chongqing railway.Research methods: By using Finite Element Model,the paper analyzes mechanics performance of each layer of slab ballastless track and top-layer of subgrade bed under various working conditions,such as slab ballastless track on rigid subgrade,soil subgrade,inserting HGT layer or not below supporting structure,aligning the expansion joints between track slabs and supporting structure or not,and so on.Research results: It is not necessary to insert the HGT layer below supporting structure.And if the expansion joints between track slabs and supporting structure do not be aligned,it is advantageous to track structure bearing force.Research conclusions: On the rigid subgrade and soil subgrade,it is not necessary to install the HGT layer below supporting structure.When designing the slab ballastless track on soil subgrade,the number of expansion joints of supporting structure should be cut down as fully as possible,and the expansion joints between track slabs and supporting structure do not be aligned.When designing the slab ballastless track on rigid subgrade,determining whether the expansion joins be even or not.Under the same conditions,there are very low change of stress of each layer of the slab ballastless track when the thickness of top-layer of subgrade bed is increased from 400 mm to 700 mm on soil subgrade.

title: On construction technique of formwork erection grouting method of supporting layer on ballastless track along express railway
abstract: Taking supporting layer project of some straight line along Beijing to Shanghai express way as an example,the paper from the craft process,the craft survey,the construction organization and the quality standard,introduces the construction technique of the supporting layer on ballastless track along express railway,so as to accumulate precious experience for similar supporting layer construction on the ballastless track in future.

title: General Introduction to the Construction Measurement Method of High-speed Railway Ballastless Track
journal: Journal of Shijiazhuang Institute of Railway Technology
abstract: The measurement of track skeleton frame construction of double-block ballastless track needs to be highly precious, and the measurement method should be advanced. By introducing the measurement principle, methods of gross and accurate adjustment and the attention points of track skeleton frame method, the article accumulated valuable experience for the measurement of track skeleton frame construction of ballastless track and can be referred to by the similar project construction.

title: Vertical vibration of ballastless track slab on Beijing-Shanghai high-speed railway
journal: Journal of Changsha University of Science & Technology
