title: Strategic Business Diversification and Competitive Positioning in Railway Infrastructure Maintenance
abstract: The growth of the national railway industry, the expansion of rail networks, and the increasing safety standards have driven the need for more modern, integrated, and sustainable railway infrastructure maintenance services. These conditions create opportunities to diversify into the railway infrastructure maintenance business. This study aims to formulate appropriate strategies for the company to enter the industry competitively. The research uses a descriptive qualitative approach supported by quantitative analysis. This research integrates the PESTLE framework, Porter’s five forces, VRIO, SWOT–TOWS, and the quantitative strategic planning matrix. Data were collected through expert interviews, questionnaires, and document analysis. The results show that the track maintenance industry has high entry barriers, significant dependence on OEMs, strong buyer power, and complex technological and certification requirements. However, opportunities emerge through long-term Public-Private Partnership (PPP) contracts, urban/HSR projects, maintenance digitalization, and technical specialization in track and slab-track segments. The priority strategies derived include forming OEM alliances, strengthening equipment capacity, establishing an internal certification academy, and adopting predictive maintenance to improve tender scores and SLA performance. These findings provide strategic direction to expand its portfolio and strengthen competitiveness in the railway maintenance sector.

title: Arc welding maintenance of railway components
abstract: The service performance and life of rail components are subjected to the following wear mechanisms: metal to metal or adhesive wear; fatigue; plastic flow and defects in rail and welds. Standard and head hardened rail grades made of high carbon steel as well as crossing made of austenitic manganese steels require permanent in field as well as workshop maintenance. Arc welding has been widely used for the repair and maintenance of rail components. This paper focuses on repairs of railway components using flux cored arc welding as a process with higher productivity, reliability, quality and increased service life of the repaired components. The paper addresses metallurgical aspects of the rail components welding, development of welding procedures, welding filler materials selection, heat input and temperature control, dilution and distortion control, weld, heat affected zone and parent material properties.

title: The Management Of Railway Fixed Installations Maintenance
journal: WIT transactions on the built environment
abstract: The paper deals with an important project, which is going to be carried out by the Italian Railways (FS), for the computerized management of the maintenance and all other works done by the personnel on the electric installations. From a strategic point of view it will be possible to elaborate and simulate plans of activities, helping the negotiation of essential resources and personnel requirements, while from an operating point of view daily and weekly working programmes will be assigned to the maintenance staff, whose activities will be regularly controlled to improve the productivity, measure the results and update health and operating conditions of fixed installations.

title: DESIGN, LAYING, MAINTENANCE AND REPAIR OF CONTINUOUS WELDED RAILS ON THE USSR RAILWAYS
abstract: Use of continuous welded rails is winning increased acceptance all over the world. This paper sketches the history of the welded rails on USSR Railways and describes the design, laying, maintenance and repair, along with the machines and methods used for laying and welding of continuous strings.

title: Research on the Rail Grinding in the Rail Maintenance of Daqin Railway
abstract: Along with the continuous increase of the carrying capacity and axle weight,the rail failure is more and more serious.The rail grinding can solve the fatigue damage of the rail effectively.Therefore,this paper makes the research on the rail grinding in the light of the fatigue damage because of the rolling contact of the rail of Daqin Railway,expounds the present situation of the rail grinding of Daqin Railway,and puts forward a set of testing programs of the rail grinding.

title: Some Features of Railway Construction and Maintenance in Western Australia
abstract: The history of the Government Railway System of Western Australia dates back to the year 1879. Previous to this, in 1871, a private timber company had built a line from a jetty at Lockeville, about 6 miles north of Busselton, the line running 12 miles inland, and it was on this railway that the first locomotive in Western Australia was used. One or two other small timber lines were also constructed about the same time.

title: The maintenance of rails is a minor factor contributing to the extension of the service life of the railway track
abstract: This article discusses the defects that arise in rails, which are one of the main components of railwayinfrastructure, and their current maintenance. All measures related to the maintenance of railways areprimarily aimed at improving the interaction between the rolling stock and the track. Irregularities in thetrack cause vertical and horizontal dynamic forces, which in turn increase the impact transmitted fromthe vehicle to the track and lead to the accumulation of residual deformations. This necessitates regularcorrection of the track in both the longitudinal and transverse profiles.In this regard, studying the railsand their operating conditions is considered a highly relevant issue. Today, many innovations andopportunities are being introduced in the transport sector of our country. Therefore, conducting scientificresearch using modern methodologies and reliable scientific foundations is highly appropriate.Thisarticle presents the scientific basis for the maintenance methods of rail defects.

title: LAYOUT AND MAINTENANCE OF RAILWAY TRACKS
abstract: After a brief review of the development of layout techniques, the author describes the difference between the reactions measured on vehicles and results from the mathematical model used as a basis for the layout. From the random association of factors affecting the quality of the track, he determines the difference between regular and limit values for defining the layout. Defective areas recorded during acceleration measurements with a testing vehicle are mostly connected with forced critical points. The author concludes by deducing rules for the construction of new tracks from the results and measurements.

title: MAINTENANCE OF RAILWAY TRACK BEDS
abstract: Continuous progress in the field of superstructures means that tracks are equipped with more efficient and uniform elements and the bed itself is thus improved and also more uniform. The article analyses maintenance organization, conventional track bed techniques and full drainage operations.

title: Operation and Maintenance Modes of Qinghai-Tibet Railway
abstract: In order to guarantee safe and stable operation of QinghaiTibet railway, it is required to seek operation and maintenance modes and safety measures suitable to QinghaiTibet plateau. Based on the current modes and specialty of QinghaiTibet railway, operation and maintenance modes and the development tendency during operation of QinghaiTibet railway in the future are analyzed. Finally, the authors put forward the reasonable operation and maintenance modes and safety measures.

title: REPAIRS TO AND MAINTENANCE OF THE PRETORIA EASTERN RAILWAY. (INCLUDING APPENDIX AND PLATE AT BACK OF VOLUME).
journal: Minutes of the Proceedings of the Institution of Civil Engineers

title: Maintenance of Low-Intensity Railways in Modern Conditions
abstract: The article is devoted to clarification of the structure of maintenance of low-intensity railways by optimising infrastructure maintenance operational personnel using the example of Mikunsky infrastructure section of the Northern Infrastructure Directorate of Russian Railways. As an example of the distance for operation of infrastructure, the article considers Berlin section of infrastructure of German railways. The task of organising the activities of the infrastructure linear enterprise of the track complex, including track section workers (PC), signalling, centralisation and blocking (SCB) maintenance section personnel working within enlarged teams and emergency repairs teams equipped with service trains and KamAZ vehicles, is considered. For the analysis of information uncertainty, an information model is proposed, for which the risk is considered in the form of determining losses. At the stage of preliminary calculations, a change in the number of maintenance personnel will make it possible to obtain a reduction in operating costs.

title: EFFICIENCY OF THE ORGANIZATION OF THE MAINTENANCE POINT AT THE RAILWAY STATION
abstract: Background. The article is devoted to the description of the design modeling of the brake testing point with its further modernization into a maintenance point at a passenger station in the St. Petersburg transport hub. Materials and methods. Materials from open Internet sources, logistics theory, systems theory, systems approach, project modeling, economic justification, comparison “as is” and “as will be” were used. Results. Based on the results of the analysis of the average downtime of one train during maintenance at the service station, the economic effect was determined. Conclusion. Based on the results of the study, a solution was proposed for the organization of a maintenance point at the St. Petersburg – Finlandsky railway station with an appropriate feasibility study. With the application of the proposal, it is possible to improve the quality performance of the railway and optimize costs. It has been established by calculation that the presence of a technical service point at the St. Petersburg – Finlyandsky railway station will allow trains to move along a given route without the need for a secondary technical inspection at the St. Petersburg – Sortirovochny – Moskovsky station.

title: Research on Maintenance and Repair Technology of the Continuous Welded Railway in Plateau Permafrost Region
abstract: In practice of maintenance and repair project in the western plateau railway as the background, from maintenance and repair mechanism, detection method, line disease effect and other aspects, this paper studied the characteristics of the CWR in plateau permafrost region in-depth, analyzed the key problems of CWR maintenance and repair in permafrost region systematically, and put forward the corresponding solutions to meet the CWR maintenance requirements in plateau permafrost region.

title: Maintenance System Required for the Railway Handling Sector
abstract: The paper puts forward some suggestions for the maintenance system reform following the overall comparisons and analysis of the currently adopted maintenance system in the railway handling sector with the planned preliminary maintenance system and the maintenance based on the status with the idea that only when the principles of seeking truth from the facts and advancing with the times are adhered to, can the equipment maintenance system be sought to truly adapt to the characteristics of the railway handling sector of the new age.

title: Track Degradation Analysis İn The Scope Of Railway İnfrastructure Maintenance Management Systems
journal: Sakarya Üniversitesi Kurumsal Açık Akademik Arşivi
authors: Sakarya Uygulamalı Bilimler Üniversitesi/Teknoloji Fakültesi/Makina Mühendisliği Bölümü
abstract: The condition of railway infrastructure elements is the key factor influencing the traffic safety, infrastructure availability, total maintenance and renewal costs, and revenues. The measurement and analysis of the condition of railway infrastructure elements is the only correct approach enabling an efficient monitoring of their behaviour and proper planning of maintenance activities. An optimum structure of the railway Maintenance Management System - RMMS is presented in the paper, with a special emphasis on the utilization of deterioration models, as one of the RMMS's key components.

title: DISCUSSION. DESIGN, INSTALLATION, AND MAINTENANCE OF LONG WELDED RAILS. RAILWAY ENGINEERING DIVISION.
journal: The Institution of Civil Engineers Engineering Division Papers
abstract: Keywords LONDON PASSENGER TRANSPORT BOARD, LONDON & NORTH EASTERN RAILWAY MACHINERY, DESIGN, INSTALLATION, MAINTENANCE, LONG, WELDED, RAILS, LATERAL, RESISTANCE, TRACK, WELDING, JOINTS, INSTABILITY, MACHINES... Show All

title: Exploring the paradigm of railway predictive maintenance
abstract: Sensing systems and Artificial Intelligence (AI)-based data treatment are becoming increasingly important, fostering a new paradigm of predictive maintenance that enables timely maintenance to prevent costly breakdowns and downtime. This poses new challenges when authorities need to choose the optimal maintenance/renewal (M/R) strategy. Consequently, the objectives of this study were to investigate the optimal maintenance strategy under various hypothetical scenarios, including degradation curves and the cost of implementing predictive maintenance through sensing systems. To this end, this study analysed actual M/R costs, established theoretical degradation curves, and inferred predictive maintenance economics. The methodological novelty lies in setting up an objective function (present value) that has an intrinsic and quantitative relationship with the mortality curve (i.e. cumulative defect occurrence), implying that the solution (maintenance time and type) is tailored based on the characteristics of the given family of degradation curves (convexity). This allows for a rationale-based choice of the maintenance strategy, where ‘more frequently’ is not necessarily ‘better’. Notably, the quantitative and parametric model allows for assessing when Sensing/AI costs are convenient, resulting in the outcome that this occurs when the cost of the sensing system per year and km is about 3%–9% of the construction cost per km.

title: EFFICIENCY ENHANCEMENT IN THE MAINTENANCE OF RAILWAY INFRASTRUCTURE SYSTEMS
abstract: One of the many objectives of the former European state railways that have been transformed into independent companies is to implement customer oriented transit services while enhancing economic viability. The article looks at the challenge that the maintenance of railway infrastructure systems gives to the considerable reduction of maintenance financing. Described are the implementation of the maintenance efficiency enhancement approaches that are expected to lead to a clear reduction in travel times to the worksites and to shorter waiting times. The approach described has resulted in an overall increase in maintenance productivity of 20-30% and, as a result, a reduction in maintenance costs of 10-15%.

title: Maintenance of TMIS Equipments in Railway Stations and Depots
abstract: With the implementation of TMIS, tremendous effects have been taken place on railway transportation .It was introduced the present situation of maintenance for TMIS equipments in the railway stations and depots,discussed the measures for improvement.

title: Improving the Efficiency OF Railway Track Maintenance Enterprises
abstract: Railway infrastructure plays a critical role in ensuring the sustainability and competitiveness of transport systems. However, the efficiency of track maintenance enterprises remains a key challenge due to rising operational costs, technological requirements, and the need for safety. This study explores methods for enhancing the efficiency of railway track maintenance enterprises through organizational, technological, and economic measures. The findings suggest that digital monitoring systems, preventive maintenance strategies, and optimized resource allocation significantly improve performance indicators, reduce downtime, and increase cost-effectiveness.

title: Expert System for Railway Fleet Maintenance Management
abstract: Fleetguard is an expert system software developed by Lynx Engineering that manages the structural maintenance of railway fleets. This expert system consists of several modules and uses a data base listing the parameters of each car in the fleet. Measured data, combined with statistic, probabilistic, and theoretical models are used to assess the structural condition of each car in the fleet. The program assists the fleet operator in selecting cars that need maintenance at a given time. The precision structural maintenance management that Fleetguard offers can cut periodic maintenance costs and significantly decrease the risk of unexpected structural failures. Servicing and repairing only those cars that require maintenance is the ultimate goal of any railway operator, as it reduces the overall operating cost and ensures the safety and efficiency of the rolling stock operation. The Fleetguard program continuously monitors each car's structural 'health' so that the fleet operator can plan the optimal maintenance and repair schedule. Fleetguard is being used successfully by major West Australian railway operators.

title: Discussion on the Practical Significance of Maintenance and Operation Systems of Shenshuo-Huanghua Railway
abstract: Research purposes: Through making analyses and summary of maintenance and operation systems of railways at home and abroad,the discussion is made on the practical significance of maintenance and operation systems of Shenshuo-Huanghua Railway for the purpose of making the proposals for improving the railway maintenance and operation levels in China.Research methods:The researches are done on the maintenance and operation systems of Shenshuo-Huanghua Railway and railways at home and abroad by adopting analysis and summary methods.Research conclusions:The maintenance and operation systems applied in Shenshuo-Huanghua Railway satisfy the investment requirements and its management mode has reference significance to the railway reform in China and is worth being used widely.

title: Development and Application of RCM Process for the Optimized Maintenance of Railway Vehicle
abstract: 최근 신뢰성을 기반으로 한 기법을 철도차량 유지관리에 도입, 적용하기 위해 많은 계획을 세우고 정착시키려는 업무가 진행되고 있으나 시간 및 비용대비 성과에 대해 기술적인 향상이 필요하다. 신뢰성기반의 유지관리 활동은 군수분야에서 시작하여 원자력, 항공 분야 등에서 가장 활발히 추진중이지만 국내철도 현장에도 접목하려는 연구를 본 논문에서 제시하였다. 철도 운영기관에서 신뢰성관련 업무를 도입하거나 적용하기 위해서는 우선 내부의 유지관리 환경을 검토할 필요가 있으며, 이러한 검토결과를 기반으로 각종 신뢰성 기법들을 철도현장에 맞게 적용하고, 특화된 신뢰성프로세스의 정립과 주요 대상 시스템을 선정하여 RCM (Reliability Centered Mainteinance)기법을 적용하여 적정성을 검토하였다. 그 결과 철도차량 유지관리를 보다 체계적이고 합리적인 방법으로 시행하기 위한 절차를 제시하였다. Recently, RCM(reliability centered maintenance) process is introduced and applied for the planning and implementing efficient and effective maintenance system in terms of optimal rolling stock maintenance. Particularly, cost-time benefits analysis associated with the implementation of RCM for rolling stock maintenance is necessary and required for railway operator in advance. The RCM process was primarily starting from military, airplane and nuclear industries and is now adapted in railway industry for local railway operators. This paper focuses on suggesting the way of connecting the RCM process with railway maintenance activities in the railway operation field. Thus, in order to introduce and establish reliability activities, it needs to review and evaluate the maintenance environment in the organizational point of view. Based on these reviews and evaluations, various maintenance methodologies are reviewed for customizing local railway field situations and establish specific process in the application of major systems on the reliability technology. In this paper, the railway RCM process is proposed for the establishment and construction of the systematic and optimal maintenance system.

title: ASPECTS OF TRACK MAINTENANCE AND RENEWAL ON THE BELGIAN RAILWAYS
abstract: The compact network of the Belgian National Railways has high traffic density which is a major consideration in the planning of track maintenance. Maintenance has been mechanized progressively, welded rail use is growing and maintenance standards are changing.

title: On wrapping core construction technique of silt roadbed in maintenance project of Angora railway
abstract: Combining with the maintenance project of Angora railway,the paper according to the engineering features of the roadbed fillers,sums up the construction craft for the silt roadbed,indicates the silt and roadbed construction of the broadening part,and provides a series of technical measures,so as to achieve better construction and economic effect.

title: Productivity Improvement in Track Maintenance in Queensland Railways
abstract: This paper sets out current proposals for mechanised maintenance of track in Queensland Railways. Results of a trial of the proposal are outlined. Staffing and management methods are discussed. The role of computerised track recording in programming maintenance work is also discussed.

title: TRACK MAINTENANCE AS AN ELEMENT IN THE PROGRESS OF THE RAILWAY AS AN ENTERPRISE
abstract: Competition among the different modes of transport means that the railway offer must be attractive. One important factor is a stable track which demands minimum maintenance. By studying the technical and economic criteria for track renewal and replacement, one can develop a suitable and economic system of track maintenance.

title: Development of maintenance MIS for permafrost railway roadbed
abstract: Based on the characters of permafrost railway roadbed and the requirement of qinghai-tibet railway company, maintenance MIS for permafrost railway roadbed was developed in this paper. After summarizing the system requirement, the design principle and the framework were introduced, the data management became dynamic and visualized, evaluation system and prediction model were created. Based on its performance in the testing runs of qinghai-tibet railway company, the system indicated its practical application in the future.

title: Studying the Layout Centralization for Railway Vehicle Maintenance
abstract: The reasonable layout of railway vehicle maintenance is of greatimportance for lowering repair cost and increasing vehicle turn-round efficiency,etc. Regarding the current situation that the maintenance workload in railwaysystem is decreasing and that each maintenance unit has surplus capacity,combining with an analysis to the characters and structure of vehicle maintenancecost, the paper illustrates the rationality of vehicle centralized maintenance byTheory of the Firm. The paper also defines the limits of centralization layout forvehicle maintenance.

title: On curve maintenance of special lines of coal railways
abstract: According to the analysis of the common diseases in the special lines of coal railways,the paper indicates the adopted measures for the adjustment of the curve geometry sizes,the technical prevention,and treatment of diseases,and points out the suggestions for improving the maintenance effect of the special line of coal railways,so as to achieve the aims of enhancing the curve quality.

title: Application of Reliability Centered Maintenance in Railway Tracks
journal: Journal of International Crisis and Risk Communication Research
abstract: Rail transport has played a significant role for a long time in the U.S. history. As other alternative transport modes have been developed, rail transport has increasingly faced more challenges to stay competitive. While heavy use of the rail, shortened service life and the need to meet consumer expectations have placed challenges, maintenance has become an integral part of the railway industry to assure efficacy and reliability of rail transportation. For this reason, there is a constant need to improve maintenance for a number of purposes, such as safety, quality, capacity, reliability, availability, punctuality, etc. In addition, optimizing maintenance strategy is also contributing to a reduction in management costs and track maintenance and renewal costs, which are extremely expensive cost elements. It also contributes significantly to increasing the life of track components. This research starts with a thorough review of how reliability-centered maintenance (RCM) approaches are applied to rail transportation, their results, analysis, and summary of benefits and limitations of the applied method in railway transport. The objective of this research is to propose recommendations for best practices to improve maintenance and RCM plan with respect to maintenance and operational costs, technology and supporting systems, component life cycle and other related aspects to be considered when designing a maintenance strategy. This research outlines all of the planning processes involved in RCM so that it can be applied comprehensively to match the objectives of different organizations.

title: New Southern railway (airport line): a maintenance case study
abstract: The New Southern Railway (Airport Line) was constructed to link the existing East Hills Line at Turrella to the Sydney Central Railway Station via the Sydney (Kingsford Smith) Airport at Mascot. The Airport Line is a double track railway in a single tunnel that encompasses four underground railway stations (Green Square, Mascot, Domestic and International Station) and Wolli Creek Interchange Station, which is the open station at the junction of the Illawarra and Airport/ East Hills Lines. The Tunnel commences at the Prince Alfred Park Portal at 0.666 km and finishes at the Wolli Creek Portal at 9.700 km; resulting in a tunnel length of 9.034 km. The boundaries of the Projectrs track activities are 0.450 km (Up Track) and 0.366 km (Down Track) on the Sydney End and 10.432 km (both tracks) on the Country End. The new Line was constructed as the Tunnels + Tracks (T + T) Design & Construct (D&C) Contract, in a Joint Venture between Transfield Construction Pty Ltd and the French Construction Company, Bouygues SA. The Joint Venture was known as the Transfield Bouygues Joint Venture (TBJV). Construction of the Airport Line commenced in 1995 and finished in November 1999. Through great fanfare, the first train rolled through the Airport Line on 21 May 2000, months before the opening ceremony of the Sydney Olympic Games.

title: GOOD TRACK MAINTENANCE BASIC TO A COMMERCIAL RAILWAY
abstract: The DB's objectives, consistent with the requirements of a commercial railway, imply maintaining the permanent way in good condition. Renewal, replacement and maintenance of track and switches are planned on the basis of priority criteria: Safety, productivity, profitability. The effective application of economic criteria ensures that the cost of maintenance is as economical as possible. This is obtained by using more competitive materials and by adopting improved production methods and work standards.

title: Application of AHP method in appraising and analyzing mechanized maintenance modes of Qinghai-Tibet railway
abstract: According to climate and geographic conditions of Qinghai Tibet railway the analytic hierarchy process (AHP) is applied in appraising and analyzing the mechanized maintenance modes of Qinghai Tibet railway in order to acquire reasonable mechanized maintenance mode for railway.

title: Studying the Railway Freight Transport Pricing Strategy
abstract: Transport price is an important factor for consignees in choos-ing transport mode. In railway transport price, there exists the problem ofmismatch between transport pricing policy/transport pricing managementsystem and market. By means of railway freight transport price theory, byreferring the strategy of American transport price, the paper suggests thatChina railway freight transport pricing shall be based on an unified pricestipulated by the government, that the transport enterprises have the right toapply certain floating price adjustment according to the relationship of sup-ply/demand, and that multi-form of transport price can be implemented.

title: The Influence of Railway Freight Transport on Logistics Costs
abstract: The majority of the costs involved in logistics come from freight transport expenses, which are affected by various factors in today's world of economic deregulation. This study seeks to investigate the effectiveness of railway freight as a way of controlling logistics costs under the current conditions faced by major shippers. Models to express the compositive mechanism of truckload freight rates (i.e., transport expenses per ton-kilometer) based on a mileage system are introduced to enable case analysis. The suitability of each model and the availability and explanatory power of each constituent factor are then discussed in details. Finally, the degree of influence on the logistics expenses incurred by shippers using railway freight transport is derived.

title: Briefly Discussing the Marketing of Railway Freight Transport
abstract: Under the system of market economy,there were some problems existing in current marketing of railway freight transport in the aspects of concept,institution and organization,construction of marketing team,service quality,marketing tactics,etc. Current railway freight marketing behaviors can not meet the need of real marketing. In order to help the railway freight sectors extricate from a predicament,the marketing should be improved by starting with emancipating the mind, changing the concept,increasing the investment on marketing,enhancing the promotion. The marketing institution should be perfected by improvement on information processing,ensuring transport capacity,price management,quality controlling and incentive restrain system. Also,the construction of marketing organization should be emphasized,the ways of service should be improved in order to raise the service quality and coordinate the relationship among the Railway Administration,Sub Administration,stations and depots. Their scopes of responsibilities should be identified respectively. Thus,the railway freight transport sector can develop.

title: Countermeasures on Improving Safety of Railway Freight Transport
abstract: The current situation of railway freight transport is analyzed in terms of operation process, safety management system, employees' ability and external environment of railway freight transport. Coun- termeasures are put forth to improve safety of railway freight transport including utilizing modern manage- ment tools, boosting construction of five basic safety systems, improving technical training, optimizing talent team, strengthening cooperation with public security organs and creating sound environment for the safety of railway freight transport.

title: INNOVATIVE APPROACH TO THE SERVICE QUALITY IN RAILWAY FREIGHT TRANSPORT
abstract: This article describes the results of research focused on service quality after transportation by railway freight transport. Importance of these services completes final quality of services and it has crucial importance in customer considering on the future use of railway transport. Processes filling the customer demands and output quality assessment were defined as a part of the research. In this contribution is introduced the map of quality planning and the algorithm of applied methodology.

title: Research and Development of the Management Information System of the Railway Freight Transport
abstract: Railway freight transport information management is the tendency of the development of market economy.It's also the essential condition for railway freight transport industry to transfer to modern logistics.The article discusses the importance of information management of railway freight transport industry's transformation to modern logistics,analyzes the intension and extension of railroad freight transport information system,Finally this article demonstrates the characteristics and commonness of network structure B/S and C/S model and brings forward the countermeasure on the ultimate realization as well as the subsistent question of information system.

title: Organization of railway freight transport between Slovakia and Ukraine
abstract: Railway freight transport is well suited to the mass transport of goods over long distances. In Eastern Europe a considerable volume of goods is usually carried by rail. On the Ukrainian border side is the Chop railway station, the largest entry/exit rail point. On the Hungarian border side is the Zahony railway station, and on the Slovakian border is the Cierna nad Tisou railway station. The Cierna nad Tisou railway station is on the TENT-T as part of the Rhine – Danube Core Network Corridor. There is also the wide-gauge Mat'ovce exit border station on the Uzhhorod–Kosice line. The Mat'ovce railway station has a connection to the TEN-T. Total railway freight between Slovakia and Ukraine is around 16 million tonnes per year, which amounts to about 40% of the entire railway freight transport in Slovakia. The most frequently transported goods are iron, coal and metal. Around 247, 000 freight cars are used yearly for transport between Slovakia and Ukraine. The most important organizational aspect of transport is the existence of two different procedures. In Slovakia, transport is organized according to the Convention concerning International Carriage by Rail (COTIF), and in Ukraine transport is organized according to the Agreement on International Goods Transport by Rail (SMGS). Today all procedures are done completely manual. This means that transport documentation is rewritten from SMGS to COTIF, or vice versa. This process is very labour- intensive and time consuming. This paper analyses the current situation regarding the organizational aspects of railway transport between Slovakia and Ukraine. Following the analysis we performed a case study of the technological process of transport of methodology at the Cierna nad Tisou railway station with a proposed solution for electronic data exchange between the rail and customs authorities of Slovakia and Ukraine.

title: The Approach to Apply Price Policy to the Marketing of Railway Freight Transport
abstract: Price is important factor of marketing combination.How to apply the price system of railway freight transport directly decides the attracted transport volume and the profit of the railway transport enterprise,also affects other factors of marketing combination.Mapping out the price system scientifically,and adjusting the price according to the market,the enterprise will get the best economic benefits.After analyzing the existing problem in the price system,this article gives approach to apply the price system to the marketing of railway freight transport.

title: A Tendency Analysis on the Market Share of China Railway Freight Transport

title: Analysis of the Railway Freight Transport Developing the Third Party Logistics
abstract: That the railroad freight transport develop the third party logistics is the main thinking of our railroad development. Through understanding of the railroad inner, management, concept system, puts forward the way of thinking. On this foundation, puts forward how to realize the turn of the traditional railway freight transport to the third party logistics.

title: Study on Railway Freight Transport Delay and the Legal Remedial Measures
abstract: In view of the legal matters concerning railway freight transport delay,the paper first clarifies the concept of delay when transporting goods by rail,its varieties and respective causes as well as its legal nature,then,introduces the current legal provisions on its remedy,placing emphasis on the remedial measures endorsed by the current legal system of China and its legislative defects,and,at the end,proposes suggestions for the improvement of the concerned legal systems.

title: Shipper-driven Analysis on Railway Freight Transport Balance
abstract: Transport is a major and essential part of logistic activities. The impact of transport on enterprise logistics cost is discussed and it is suggested to realize balanced transport for shipper’s cargo. Meanwhile factors that influence railway freight transport balance are analyzed and some evaluation indexes are proposed.

title: How to Develop Modern Logistics from Railway Freight Transport Agency
abstract: Under the new situation of the economy development in China,the paper discusses the urgency for developing modern logistics from railway freight transport agent industry,analyzes opportunity and the superiority and puts forward the countermeasures to speed up modern logistics from railway freight transport agency.

title: Influence and Countermeasures on Railway Freight Transport Enterprises after Entering WTO
journal: Journal of Zhengzhou Institute of Aeronautical Industry Management
abstract: Using theory and technology of strategy management, this paper discusses the changes of external environment and market structure in railway freight transport business after entering WTO in China, believing that the external environment condition will be improved, meanwhile, the competition will become intense after entering WTO. So railway freight transport enterprises should deepen the structure reform, build up core competence, and improve the level of HRM and financial management to adapt to the changed situation.

title: Reflections upon the Reform of Railway Freight Transport Price
abstract: Regarding the current problems existed in railway freight transportprice, such as inflexible management, complicated calculation and freight category,etc., this paper suggests to reform the railway transport price. The main contentsof reform concern consummating the range of pricing by government, enhancingthe right of MOR as rater, awarding the legal person of railway enterprise certainright to fix a floating price, etc. The paper also suggests consummating theregulating mechanism and macro-control system for railway transport price.

title: Exploration on the Railway Freight Transport Intensification Strategy
abstract: Based on the distribution and traffic volume status of freight stations of Beijing Railway Administration,the essay expounds the advantages of intensive railway freight transportation,analyzes the problems existing in intensive transport,puts forward the guideline and principle of Beijing Railway Administration to establish freight transport intensification strategy,as well as proposals on optimizing the distribution adjustment of freight stations and establishing intensively-operated loading bases,etc.

title: Exploration on the Time Limit of Delivery of the Railway Freight Transport
abstract: The paper analyzes the implications of the various links of the railway freight transport on the time limit of delivery andputs forward the measures of solution to raise the management level and the operating efficiency of the various links and departmentsin the entire process of the freight transport, make perfect the various methods of assessment, enhance the coordination and thejoint labor cooperation, increase the input in science and technology and the hardware construction, raise the running speeds andexpand the capacity, step up the construction of the TMIS and DMIS systems and realize the dynamic real-time follow-up of thewagons.

title: Studying the Legal Problems on Access to Railway Freight Transport Market
abstract: The definition of railway carrier was analyzed from the legal aspect. It was pointed out that defining carrier was important to make clear the legal responsibility that the operation entity should bear. Meanwhile, the characteristics and the qualifications of railway carriers were also explained. The Necessity of applying the system of railway freight transport licence was emphasized. The procedures for applying, examining and approving the operation licence of railway freight transport were also introduced.

title: Development of the Railway Freight Transport System – Evolutions and Perspectives regarding the Transport Corridors
journal: Ovidius University Annals Economic Sciences Series
abstract: Promoting the railway freight transport is a priority in the policies and laws of the European Union. This is due to the fact that railway transport is cleaner and more efficient than the other ways of transport, producing less carbon dioxide emissions as compared to road transport. At the same time, it is a safer way of transport, with an rate of accidents significantly lower than road transport. By this paper, the author aims at outlining the new tendencies shown in the railway transport against the approaches of the European Union towards creating of a unified trans-European transport network (TEN-T).

title: Design project of calculating railway freight transport price distanceby COM component
abstract: It was analyzed the data structure of freight transport price distance object, introduced the designing project ofcalculating railway freight transport price distance by COM component, the implementation of the shortest path algorithmin calculating railway freight transport price distance, main technical parameter and operation condition of COM component.

title: Study in Creating Seasonal Forecast Model for Railway Freight Transport Volume
abstract: Railway freight transport volume forecast isthe base for establishing transportation plan. The currentforecast method couldn't reflect the internal structure andthe complicity of data in a complete and scientific way.When carrying out the forecast at annual basis, thedeficiency is ok; however, it becomes obvious when atmonthly basis. Benefiting from the periodicity character oftrigonometric function, assisting by linear tendency change,the paper establishes a seasonal forecast model that is fitfor different forecast period with different accuracy. Theactual application of this model shows that it can accuratelyforecast monthly transport volume.

title: MARKETING STRATEGY OF CROATIAN RAILWAY FREIGHT TRANSPORT UNDER CONDITIONS OF LIBERALISATION
journal: Poslovna izvrsnost : znanstveni časopis za promicanje kulture kvalitete i poslovne izvrsnosti
abstract: This paper describes the Croatian railway freight transport market and its adjustment to the oncoming process of liberalisation. Primary and secondary research has been carried out for the purpose of shaping a marketing strategy for rail freight transport in the process of liberalising the railway industry. The hypothesis that Porter's model of five competitive forces can be successfully implemented in the Croatian transportation market has been confirmed. The Croatian railway transport market is not saturated, and there is space for its dynamic development in the near future when railway liberalisation process starts in Croatia. Research results have confirmed that a commercial market orientation of Croatian Railways Cargo and its collaboration with ports, suppliers and sub- suppliers, can place them at the leading position on the Croatian and Central and Southeast European freight transport markets. It is reasonable to expect that rail freight transport will play a more significant role on the liberalised transportation market than today. It can also be expected that foreign railway operators will take up a certain amount of the Croatian transport market (via X and V Pan-European corridors) and that they will try to impose themselves as competitive rail freight transport operators.

title: Analysis on the Trend of E-commerce Development of the Railway Freight Transport Agency
abstract: The article analyzes the current situation and the existing problems of the railway freight transport and the freight agency in China, elaborates the necessity and feasibility to develop the railway freight transport agency by means of the e-commerce, introduces the envisages and the implementing scheme to create the e-commerce and analyzes the opportunities and advantages brought about to the railway freight transport agency by the e-commerce.

title: Macroeconomic model of demand estimate for railway freight transport in Croatia
abstract: The main goal of this scientific debate is to identify a function that describe, the relationship between Gross Domestic Product (GDP) as independent variable and demand for rail freight transport as dependent variable. We use regression analysis to estimate this function and use them to make prediction the demand for rail freight traffic until the year 2020. Forecasts of demand for rail freight traffic point to the doubling of demand by 2020. Despite this Croatian railways will continue to operate below the level of existing capacity.

title: International Groups in the Function of Organizing Railway Freight Transport
abstract: HŽ-cargo na međunarodnom tržistu predstavlja profitno najveci potencijal u okviru cjelokupne organizacije ili u samostalnom djelovanju na tržistu željeznickog teretnog prijevoza. Svojom dugorocnom poslovnom orijentacijom u prijevozu robe međunarodnim koridorskim pravcima kvalitetnim partnerskim pristupom u međunarodnim grupacijama, na podrsku i platformu manjim nacionalnim prijevoznicima te na organizaciju konvencionalnog i kombiniranog prijevoza te prijevoza na lokalnim prugama ostvaruje svoju viziju stvaranja nacionalnog željeznickog prijevoznika i regionalno prepoznatljivog partnera osposobljenog za organizaciju i logistiku željeznickog teretnog prijevoza. Uz strucni kadar, te pouzdanost i sigurnost koji su rezultirali dobrim odnosima na domacem tržistu, ali i tradicijom u međunarodnom okruženju, nema razloga da se stecene prednosti ne iskoriste na najbolji moguci nacin. Opredijeljenost organizacije HŽ-Carga za planiranje i prilagodbu promjenama na tržistu teretnog prijevoza, a pod tim se misli na novi Zakon o željeznici, na rast tehnickih, sigurnosnih i ekoloskih standarda, na dinamicno tržiste roba i konkurentskih prijevoza, osnovni je uvjet za stvaranje nacionalnog željeznickog prijevoznika. U radu se obrazlaže svođenje elemenata na trenutnu djelatnost HŽ-Carga kao prijevoznika i organizatora prijevoza kroz razne usluge. Buduci da se HŽ-Cargo planira razviti za dugorocno funkcioniranje na tržistu, ne samo kao prijevoznik, vec i kao prepoznatljiv organizator prijevoza u međunarodnom okruženju, nužno je repozicionirati postojecu ulogu organizatora prijevoza i poslova kojima se bavi, imajuci u vidu vlastiti l core businessr , odnosno osnovnu djelatnost. Isto tako, detaljno se obrazlažu poslovi koji se trenutno u HŽ-Cargu obavljaju kao i postojana mogucnost ukljucivanja i dodatnih usluga iz drugih djelatnosti koje su vezane za osnovno poslovanje i djelatnost HŽ-Carga. Novim Zakonom o željeznici koji stupa na snagu 01. 01. 2005. definirane su ovlasti davatelja usluga u željeznickom prijevozu kao i ovlasti kod upravljanja infrastrukturom. Po njemu se ozakonjuje mogucnost da svi željeznicki prijevoznici koriste željeznicku infrastrukturu pod jednakim uvjetima, uz pretpostavku dobivanja dozvole za obavljanje usluga javnog prijevoza u željeznickom prijevozu te rjesenje o sigurnosti. Ova zakonska regulativa usklađena je sa pravnim okvirom Europske unije u podrucju željeznickog prijevoza. Stupanjem na snagu novog Zakona, HŽ-Cargo se u startu nalazi u povoljnoj poziciji, jer osim niza opcih zakonskih odredbi, Zakon od željeznickog prijevoznika traži strucne djelatnike koji mogu osigurati plan i analizu prijevoza te kvalitetan vozni park i drugu odgovarajucu tehnicku opremljenost. Definiranjem obima poslova HŽ-Carga te poslovanja speditera i drugih organizatora prijevoza, odnosno njihovom specijalizacijom, ostvarit ce se određena podjela uloga i stvoriti jasnija situacija na podrucju prijevoza, a time i mogucnost jasnog strateskog razvoja svakog od tih cimbenika. Međunarodna grupacija je svaka udruga koju cine najmanje dva željeznicka prijevoznika osnovana u razlicitim državama radi pružanja usluga u međunarodnom željeznickom prijevozu. Razlozi udruživanja u grupacije su financijski i logisticki. Financijski razlozi odnose se na zajednicko definiranje cijene određene trase koja se proteže kroz vise zemalja ili na uzajamno odobrenje cijena trasa na pojedinim nacionalnim prugama. Time se, uz ekonomicnije iskoristenje vagonskog parka, postiže cjenovna konkurentnost, transparentnost i brzina rada u svim segmentima. Logisticki razlozi mogu se podijeliti na organizaciju voznog reda, na upravljanje teretnim vagonskim parkom te uslugama u centrima prodaje HŽ-Carga. Pri organizaciji voznog reda međusobna suradnja unutar grupacija bit ce jaca i podređena strateskim l proizvodimar . Organizaciju teretnog vagonskog parka potrebno je postaviti na nivou grupacije temeljem baze podataka postojeceg voznog parka, rezultata analize eksploatacije vagona, voznog reda i planiranja velikih prijevoza. Pravne, organizacijske i financijske osnove međunarodne grupacije tek treba utemeljiti. Da bi bio atraktivan kao clan međunarodne grupacije i kao davatelj usluga krajnjim korisnicima prijevoza u okviru te ili tih grupacija, HŽ-Cargo stranim željeznickim prijevoznicima može ponuditi definirane cijene trasa na hrvatskim prugama, organizaciju voznog reda na prugama HŽ-a, kontrolu i pratnju kretanja vlakova, nakupljanje bruta u Hrvatskoj, dodatne usluge u logistickim centrima i centrima prodaje (djelatnosti speditera), traženje roba za povratne vožnje vagona i dr.. Opci trendovi globalizacije reflektiraju se i na željeznicki prijevoz u smislu potrebe za rastom investicija, sirenja mreže pruga velikih brzina, harmoniziranja razlicitih sustava, informacijskih tehnologija, logistiku, sirenje lepeze usluga, pritiska konkurencije itd.. Iako malim željeznickim poduzecima globalizacija predstavlja ulazak u tržisnu bitku sa velikim l kompanijamar , upravo je u tome mogucnost vece fleksibilnosti i potrebe za aktivnim i promisljenim nastupom na tržistu. Pojedine međunarodne grupacije mogu se naci u poziciji konkurenata, no ostvarenje tog cilja nece imati negativne efekte jer ce rezultirati povecanjem kvalitete i vrsta usluga, povecanjem kolicine prijevoza, smanjenjem troskova radi optimalizacije voznog parka, smanjenjem troskova radi osiguranja povratnih vožnji, smanjenjem troskova radi formiranja distributivnih centara i dr.. Ucinci stvaranja pojedinih grupacija su kumulativni i za ocekivati je da ce doprinijeti opcem razvoju HŽ-Carga, a dugorocno i mijenjanju svijesti na prijevoznom tržistu u Hrvatskoj i njenom okruženju.

title: Railway Freight Transport Key Account Marketing and Customer Churn Early Warning Countermeasures
abstract: The concept and category of railway freight transport key account are defined,and the marketing programs for key account are proposed.Then the reasons of railway freight transport key account run off are analyzed in detail,and the customer churn early warning countermeasures are discussed,they could provide theoretical support for railway freight marketing.

title: Construction of Railway Strategic Loading Point and Centralized Development of Railway Freight Transport
abstract: The construction of the railway strategic loading point embodies the centralized development of rail freight transport in terminal areas; it meets the requirement for deepening of railway managerial system reform. From such points as scientific site-election and reasonable layout of railway strategic loading point, optimization and reorganization of railway freight flow structure, as well as prompting supervision departments to sharing management, the paper gives a detailed explanation about how the railway is now centralizing the freight transportation to adapt itself to meet the new demand of railway development.

title: Research on the Construction of Logistics Information Platform for Railway Freight-Transport Stations
abstract: According to the actual situation in railway freight transport station, this paper discusses the necessity to construct logistics information platform. Through a systematic analysis and planning on this work, the paper puts forward the analysis about its basic functions and logistics mode. It also designs the code, data structure, database and data processing of the information platform to further improve the working profit of railway freight transport station.

title: Transformation of the Traditional Railway Freight Transport towards the Modern Logistics Industry
abstract: The article elaborates the differences and links between the modern logistics industry and the traditional railwayfreight transport, analyzes the advantages and disadvantages for the transformation of the traditional railway freight transport to themodern logistics industry, then puts forward some suggestions for the problems that need to be solved.

title: Analysis and Countermeasures for the Marketing of the Railway Freight Transport in Chenzhou City,Hunan Province
abstract: The article introduces the present situation of the communication and transport in Chenzhou City, Hunan Provinceand analyzes the contradictions existing in the work of railway freight transport. It further makes clear the main object for themarketing work of the railway freight transport based on the detailed division of the transport markets and puts forward somesuggestions for improving the marketing of the railway freight transport by unifying the thinking, fostering the sense of overallsituation and carrying out the overall marketing work.

title: Flow Optimization of Railway Freight Transport Operation under E-business Mode
abstract: This paper analyzes the flow of railway freight transport operation from 3 aspects including departure operation, en-route and arrival operation, and puts forward the main problems existing in the flow of railway freight transport operation and idea of the operation flow reengineering. According to the object of flow reengineering of railway freight transportation under E-business mode, the flow of railway freight transport operation was optimized by gradual reengineering method, and the optimization analysis of the flow under E-business mode was analyzed in the paper, so as to provide reference for further studying operation mode and flow refinement.

title: The Development of the Major Client Management Information System for Railway Freight Transport
abstract: Such technologies as the work flow management,datahouse and AJAX,etc.were employed to develop the major client management information system for railway freight transport.Based on the current railway management system,the management structure of the system was designed to be three levels,namely,the Ministry of Railways,the railway administration and the railway station and depot.The sys-tem was divided into parts,i.e.customer management,information service,freight transport organization,product design and analysis evaluation according to its functions,which included 12business modules.The five uniform management of the yearly traffic volume,monthly plan,daily wagon request,the accounts settlement of freight charge and the information service for major client were achieved.Three-lev-el structure of management information system,data processing platform and safety guarantee platform architecture structure of the system was adopted for the system structure.The centralized and the decentralized combination topological structure was adopted for the system network structure.The system was composed of 6subsystems,namely,major client information service,station information collection,statis-tical analysis,yearly traffic volume,contract management and registration management.The system has been widely promoted and applied in the whole railway.The results indicate that the system can optimize the business flow of the freight transport,simplify the handling procedures for major clients and improve both the service quality and the production efficiency.

title: Discussion on the Transform of Railway Freight Transport Station towards Modern Logistics
abstract: With the development of each transport means, the competition intransport market becomes even fierce. The traditional railway freight transportservice in Guangzhou region can no more meet the requirements of market andneeds to transform towards modern logistics enterprise. Thus, those railwayfreight transport stations in Guangzhou region need to reform both managementand operation mechanism, to resolve the weakness (such as layout of station,unsuitable division of labor, low technical level, etc.), to strengthen the training ofmodern logistics human resources and to improve the competence of railwayfreight transport.

title: The Study of Comprehensive Forecast Model for Railway Freight Transport Volume
abstract: The forecast of railway freight volume is one of fundamental work forrailway transportation production and the precondition for working out the suitablerailway transportation market strategy. However the traditional forecasting methodcan no longer accommodate the more and more complicated demand of thefreight volume forecasting. Referring to the forecast measures of freight volumeapplied in various domestic transportation means and combining with railwayfeatures, the paper brings forward the comprehensive model system and measurewhich is an integration of many forecasting methods and adapts to China railwayfreight volume forecasting. Put into practical application of calculation, it obtainsthe railway freight forecasting result from year 2003 to year 2005.

title: ANALYSIS OF TRANSPORTATION CRUDE OIL PRODUCTS BY RAILWAY FREIGHT TRANSPORT
abstract: Pri spracovaní ropy vznikajú viaceré ropné produkty, ktoré sa ďalej spracujú priamo v rafinérii alebo prostredníctvom vybraného druhu dopravy prepravia ku odberateľom. Preprava ropných produktov sa realizuje potrubnou dopravou, cestnou, vodnou a železničnou nákladnou dopravou. Výhodou železničnej nákladnej dopravy je preprava veľkých množstiev v relatívne krátkom čase, na dlhé vzdialenosti za primerané náklady.

title: Build up a Service Network of Railway Freight Transport Stations with Web Application Technology
abstract: Regarding the current problems existed in freight transport servicesat railway freight transport stations, relating to the development and applicationstatus of China computer network and to the situation of managementinformation system in railway freight transport stations, the paper raises theplan to build up a service network of railway freight transport stations with Webapplication technology so as to provide an interactive information platformbetween railway freight transport stations and consignees, to improve theservice quality and working efficiency of railway freight transport stations and toimprove the market competence of railway transport enterprises.

title: Decision-making problems of recipients of railway freight transport outsourcing services
abstract: Przetrwanie na rynku i zdobycie przewagi konkurencyjnej wymagają efektywnego zarządzania gwarantującego sukces przedsiębiorstwu. Jedną z metod jest outsourcing. Określenie outsourcingu pochodzi z języka angielskiego i jest skrótem wyrażenia outside resource using oznaczającego wykorzystanie zasobów zewnętrznych. Outsourcing powinien się koncentrować na optymalizacji kosztów i zatrudnienia. Główną korzyścią powinno być dążenie do zwiększonej elastyczności struktur, dostęp do wykwalifikowanej kadry pracowniczej oraz innych zasobów przedsiębiorstwa. Niepowodzenia outsourcingu mogą wynikać zarówno ze strony przedsiębiorstwa zlecającego i świadczącego usługi transportu kolejowego ładunków. Badania empiryczne dotyczące problemów decyzyjnych odbiorców usług outsourcingu transportu kolejowego ładunków pozwoliły zidentyfikować korzyści, ryzyko, sposób komunikacji oraz problemy we współpracy partnerskiej.

title: Analysis of Railway Freight Transport Safety Level Based on Fuzzy Cluster Method
abstract: Transportation safety is crucial for the freight transport system.It is indispensable to analyze the level of freight transport safety of every railway bureau.In this paper,the fuzzy cluster analysis method is adapted to classify the given railway bureau based on their safety quality,and analyze the management instance according to the ultimate result.The result of a numerical example validates that the method is in availability.

title: Design on structure of Great Client Management Information System of railway freight transport
abstract: With the fast development of national economy in our country,the demand of transport was rising continuously.To ensure the transport of important goods and materials,strengthen and expand the market of freight transport,it was needed to unified management and service for the great client.The Great Client Management Information System of railway freight tromsport was designed to implement this aim.It was described the system structure,the network structure,software and hardware.

title: Development Trends of the Railway Freight Transport in China during the Transition Period of Accessionto WTO
abstract: The article makes the forecast for the development trends of the railway foreign trade volume of freight transport and thetotal volume of freight transport based on the analysis for the internal and external development environment of the railway freighttransport during the transition period of accession to WTO, then puts forward some feasible suggestions for the vigorous developmentof the railway freight transport in China.

title: AN APPROACH TO THE FUTURE TRENDS OF THE ORIGIN-DESTINATION TABLE FOR THE RAILWAY FREIGHT TRANSPORT
abstract: An estimating method for railway freight traffic in the future under various conditions has been developed. The process is based on origin-destination tables and traffic matrix, which are now maintained on a continuing basis.

title: Study on Launching Logistics Services by Railway Freight Transport Stations under Supply Chain
abstract: Regarding the current organization and management mode,operation situation and development trend of railway freight transport stations,with the management theory of supply chain and modern logistics, the paperdiscusses the relevant issues on how to break through the existing productionorganization mode and implement actively modern logistics services undersupply chain.

title: Study on the Prediction of Railway Freight Transport Cost Based on Activity-based Costing and BP Neural Networks
abstract: By applying the activity-based costing (ABC) and combining the BP theory, the prediction model of railway freight transportation cost is established. The case study indicates that the BP neural networks could more exactly predict the railway freight transport cost.

title: Study on Development Trend of Railway Freight Transport Enterprises based on Client's Demand
abstract: This paper analyzes the client's demand under new circumstances,and puts forward the develop-ment strategies of railway transport enterprises such as establishing modern logistics concept,strengthening the coordination among different transport modes,improving the construction of railway infrastructure and transfer-ring into the third party logistics enterprise.

title: The Liberalization Process in Türkiye Railway Freight Transport: A Technical Efficiency Analysis Using the Simar-Wilson Bootstrap Method
abstract: Bu çalışma, Türkiye demiryolu yük taşımacılığının (2003-2024) teknik verimliliğini ve 2017 serbestleşme politikasının etkilerini ampirik olarak analiz etmektedir. Kısıtlı örneklem sapmalarını gidermek için Simar-Wilson (2007) çift bootstrap regresyon prosedürü kullanılmıştır. Analizde ana hat uzunluğu ve vagon sayısı girdi, net ton-kilometre ise çıktı olarak tanımlanırken; serbestleşme politikasının, elektrifikasyon oranının ve COVID-19 pandemisinin sistem üzerindeki etkileri test edilmiştir. Bulgular, altyapı yönetimi ile tren işletmeciliğinin birbirinden ayrılması ve serbestleşmeye hazırlık sürecinde gerçekleşen kurumsal yapılanmanın ilk aşamada verimliliği anlamlı biçimde artırdığını göstermektedir. Ancak bu pozitif ivme kısa sürmüş; 2023-2024 yıllarında verimlilik hızla daralarak belirgin bir âtıl kapasiteye dönüşmüştür. Bootstrap sonuçları, bu keskin düşüşün pandemi kaynaklı olmaktan ziyade, yeni inşa edilen elektrikli hatların yük talebiyle yeterince bütünleşememesiyle birlikte 2023-2024 döneminde yaşanan deprem, uzun süreli hat kapamaları, doğal afetler ve jeopolitik gelişmeler gibi fiziksel ve operasyonel kısıtların eşzamanlı etkilerinden kaynaklandığına işaret etmektedir. Bu yapısal altyapı-talep uyumsuzluğu ışığında çalışma; gelecekteki hat ve güzergâh yatırımlarında yük talebi ve filo uyumu kriterinin öncelikli olarak değerlendirilmesini, yeni hatların doğrudan yük üretim ve çekim merkezlerine bağlanmasını ve pazara yeni giren özel sektörü destekleyecek spesifik teşviklerin devreye alınmasını önermektedir.

title: Optimisation of High-Speed Railway Freight Transport Service Plan in Inter-Modal Transport Based on Extended Time-Space Network
abstract: The air-rail inter-modal transport is a feasible choice to enlarge the freight service scope of high-speed railway. Essentially, optimising the service plan for high-speed rail express under inter-modal mainly involves determining the train and flight trips, and space-time route selections for each batch of express shipment from the origin to the destination. We construct an extended space-time network to capture the transport and transfer space-time attributes of the serviced express shipments. A multi-commodity flow model is then established with a series of practical constraints. The Lagrangian relaxation algorithm is designed to decompose the original problem into a shortest path problem of a single-batch express shipment in a multi-dimensional network. The sub-problem is solved by the dynamic programming method, and a heuristic algorithm based on sub-gradient sorting is designed to ensure the feasibility of the dual solutions. In order to compare the performance of the traditional solver method with that of the LR algorithm, a nonlinear mixed-integer programming model was constructed in the appendix and solved by using the DICOPT solver. Taking the Shanghai-Kunming corridor as an example, the experimental results demonstrate that the LR algorithm can obtain high-quality solutions within a relatively short time, while the traditional solver method has certain limitations. Furthermore, the inter-modal transport is validated with a significant advantage in expanding the service scope of express demand. The research results are of great theoretical significance for the rational allocation of transportation resources and enhancement of the quality and efficiency of high-speed rail express services.

title: Analysis of freight railway transport in selected Eurasian transport corridors
abstract: The article presents an analysis of railway freight transport in selected Eurasian transport corridors. The role of railway transport in shaping the single European transport area and the benefits resulting from it have been defined. Technical barriers to the implementation of intercontinental traffic were presented and initiatives to activate international trade were discussed.

title: Study on the Increase of Freight Transport Volume in Yunnan Railways
abstract: Based on an analysis to the increasing model of railway freight transport demand in domestic and foreign countries, the paper puts forward a four-stage evolution theory for railway freight transport demand. Combining with the actual status of the lagging development in Yunnan railways, the paper establishes the freight transport increasing model that overcomes the limit of railway freight transport capacity. By calculating the freight transport volume as well as the demand, via MATLAB simulation technology, it validates the model and carries out the forecast to the freight transport volume and demand for Yunnan railways.

title: Investigating the Effects of Railway Freight Transport and Resource Efficiency on Greenhouse Gas Emissions: The Example of Some European Union Countries and Türkiye
abstract: Bu çalışma, Avrupa Birliği’nde en yüksek GSYİH’ye sahip Almanya, İspanya, Fransa, İtalya, Hollanda ve Türkiye’den oluşan ülkelerin demiryolu yük taşımacılığı, kaynak verimliliği ve sera gazı (SG) emisyonları arasındaki nedensellik ilişkileri incelemektedir. 2013–2023 yılları arasında kullanılan, araştırma verileri, “Eurostat” veri tabanından derlenmektedir. Veri setinin yapısı ve ülkeler arası karşılaştırma gerekliliği göz önünde bulundurularak, analizlerde panel veri yöntemi kullanılmıştır. Bazı araştırma sonuçlarına göre; panel düzeyinde demiryolu taşımacılığı ile SG emisyonları arasında anlamlı bir nedensellik tespit edilememiştir. Fakat kaynak verimliliğinin her iki değişkenle (demiryolu taşımacılığı ve SG) ilişkilerde belirleyici bir kanal olduğunu belirlenmiştir. Ülke bazında elde edilen sonuçlar heterojen durumdadır. Türkiye’de, SG’den kaynak verimliliğine doğru nedensellik bulunurken, Almanya ve İspanya’da kaynak verimliliğinden SG’ye doğru tek yönlü bir ilişki belirlenmiştir. İtalya ve Hollanda’da ise demiryolu taşımacılığından kaynak verimliliğine doğru nedensellik ilişki tespit edilememiştir. Bu sonuçlar, demiryolunun düşük karbon avantajının ülkeye özgü enerji altyapısı, elektrik kullanma düzeyi ve operasyonel verimlilik gibi faktörlere bağlı olarak değiştiğini ortaya koymaktadır. Çalışma, kaynak verimliliğinin hem çevresel performansı hem de ulaşım türlerinin dönüşümünü etkileyen stratejik bir değişken olduğunu ortaya koymaktadır. Bu alandaki karar vericilerin, genel anlamda bir stratejiden ziyade ülkeye özgü düşük karbon çözümlerinin geliştirilmesi gerektiği anlamına gelmektedir. Bulgular ayrıca; sürdürülebilir demiryolu taşımacılığını gerçekleştirmede, verimlilik artırıcı çalışmaların da göz önünde bulundurularak SG emisyonlarını azaltılmasında daha etkili olacağını göstermektedir.

title: Market Analysis of the Railway Perishable Freight Transport
abstract: The paper gives a brief account about the production and market demands of the perishabie foodstuffs jn China, introduces the current situation of the railway perishabie freight transport and makes the analyses on the development trend of the perishabie freight transport market including the new requirements to the means and the traffic organization of the railway refrigerated transport from the transport market development space, the transport patterns, the freight structure and the transport market.

title: Development of Railway Refrigeration Transport Tools as Viewed from Modernization of Freight Transport
abstract: General conditions of the modernization of railway freight transport both in our country and abroad as well as its effect on the development of railway refrigeration transport tools are described. The opinions on the development of railway refrigeration transport tools in our country are expounded.

title: HOW THE RAILWAYS SHOULD SOLVE EUROPE'S FREIGHT TRANSPORT HEADACHES
abstract: In this paper a comparison is presented between the freight railways in Sweden, Germany and USA concerning technology as well as organisation. To solve the railways problem it is necessary to develop both the organisation and the technique. Further to making their existing transport systems more efficient and improving the quality of these, railways must also develop new products enabling them to handle efficiently both high-value goods and smaller consignments. This paper presents analyses about how to develop the products the railway can offer for different markets: Waggonload, Intermodal freight trains and Express freight. This is proved by an economic model where the different techniques can be tested and compared by competing modes. The railway is today being confronted with a potent wind of change, including a number of wholly new prerequisites. In order to ensure that the railways may assert themselves in the future European transport market, new organisational structures and administrative routines are required and an entirely new dimension of thinking and acting across traditional boundaries. Different ways to reform the railways organisation are described. For the covering abstract see ITRD E108433.

title: Improvement of mechanism of management of enterprises of railway transport on freight transportations
journal: ТРАНСПОРТНІ СИСТЕМИ ТА ТЕХНОЛОГІЇ ПЕРЕВЕЗЕНЬ (ЗБІРНИК НАУКОВИХ ПРАЦЬ ДНІПРОПЕТРОВСЬКОГО НАЦІОНАЛЬНОГО УНІВЕРСИТЕТУ ЗАЛІЗНИЧНОГО ТРАНСПОРТУ ІМЕНІ АКАДЕМІКА В. ЛАЗАРЯНА)
abstract: The situation of enterprises management of Ukrainian railway freight transportation for 2012-2013 was analyzed and long term system of program, legal, administrative and technical measures was considered. Also set of railway freight transportation enterprises incorporated hierarchically regarding their functions and their interaction for effective implementation of the mission under the modern market conditions was examined. The measures concerning all foregoing directions were executed by the Ukrainian Railway Transport Administration during 2012-2013. Effectiveness of their introduction was estimated. Technical and organizational arrangements were paid special attention to. The role of the management of formed structure by the railway transport reforming was shown as well. The world consulting companies and international specialists were engaged in its work. The structural and logical analysis was also accomplished by the comprehensive approach with the purpose of intermediate results obtaining of the reformation processes under the term changing condition during the first reforming stage.

title: STRATEGIC CHOICES FOR FREIGHT TRANSPORT CONFRONTING EUROPEAN RAILWAY COMPANIES
abstract: Economic growth has had a positive effect on the demand for freight transport in Europe. Road freight transport has increased, whilst rail's market share has declined. Carriers need to be flexible to meet the requirements of different companies. Major trends that influence the freight transport market are outlined: globalisation, sustainability, innovation, and shipper's requirements. Challenges to the rail freight business are discussed: growing open competition, cost aspects, the characteristics of the product, and marketing policy. The EU policy is aimed at reversing the decline in rail's market share by improving train path allocation and introducing more efficient charging for infrastructure use. The characteristics of the railway product of the future are discussed. For the covering abstract see ITRD E117504.

title: Study on Value Insurance and Transport Insurance in Railway Freight Transportation
abstract: Through comparing the provisions on value insurance and transport insurance in railway freight transportation,the paper concludes that there indeed are some similarities between the two but differences abound in aspects of purpose,excusable events,liability terms,ultimate liable party and applicable scope,etc.As a result of which,if a carrier incorporates both insurances,conflicts and contradictions are bound to happen,whose solution awaits the further polishing of the state legal system.

title: Inquiring into the Suitable Configuration of Freight Transport Resources in Nanchang Railway Administration
abstract: It is an important way for railway to improve transport capability andmarket competence with suitable configuration of railway freight transportresources and with better goods consigning conditions. Via a study to the suitableconfiguration of freight transport resources in Nanchang railway administration,the paper analyzes the demand to adjust productivity, highlights the problems laidbefore the resource configuration of freight transport and comes up with theprinciples and suggestions for Nanchang railway administration to adjust freighttransport resources.

title: Discussion on Development Trend of Railway Freight Transportation and Adjustment of Transport Resources
abstract: The essay studies the development laws of railway freight transportation in America, analyzes the development trend of Chinese freight transportation along with the influential factors upon it, and puts forward that railway freight transportation should put more emphases on intermodal transportation, high value-added freight transportation and take more effective marketing strategy. Targeting the current supply and demand status of railway freight transportation, the essay also suggests adjusting the soft and hardware transport resources in the railway sector.

title: RAILWAY IMPACT ON FREIGHT TRANSPORT IN PORT OF PLOČE
abstract: Already in the late nineteenth century, during the Austro-Hungarian government there was the need for the construction of railway lines to link with the Adriatic ports. The construction of the Metkovic - Sarajevo railway line (completed in 1891) with a capacity of 600,000 tons per year, connected the South Adriatic ports (especially the Port of Metkovic) with the interior of Bosnia and Herzegovina. The Port of Ploce realizes most of its business with customers in Bosnia and Herzegovina. In terms of companies with headquarters in Bosnia and Herzegovina it is certainly important to draw attention to the fact that the activities of such companies that are focused on business cooperation with the Port of Ploce, depend to a large extent on the railway infrastructure. By its location, the Port of Ploce has a large catchment area and it is irreplaceable as the final destination of the flow of goods in the railway corridor Vc. In the north-south railway connection there is the Sarajevo - Ploce railway line (195km), which is part of the railway branch of route C (Budapest - Osijek - B. Samac - Sarajevo - Ploce in the length of 809km) of the Pan-European Corridor V (Venice - Trieste - Budapest - Uzhhorod - Lviv) and thus makes the Port of Ploce the seaport of this branch. The paper will show the structure of freight at the Port of Ploce, with the analysis of traffic at the given Port with regard to trends. The role of railways in the transport and development of the Port of Ploce will be defined, and a comparative analysis of the rail and road transport in relation to the competing ports will be carried out.

title: ANALYSIS OF FREIGHT TARIFFS ON RAILWAY TRANSPORT
abstract: Мазкур мақолада темир йўл транспортида юк ташиш тарифлари ва уларнинг хусусиятлари тўғрисида қисқача таҳлил келтирилган. Келгусида “Ўзбекистон темир йўллари” АЖ тариф тизимининг бошланғич ўзгаришларига таъриф бериб ўтилган.

title: A simulation model of cooperative consolidation of smallbatch freight on railway transport
journal: Вестник Ростовского государственного университета путей сообщения
abstract: Under the conditions of growing small-batch freight flows and the shortage of terminal infrastructure, traditional hub models of combined rail transportation lose their economic efficiency. This paper proposes a simulation model of cooperative consolidation (freight pooling) developed by the authors which is based on direct interaction among geographically proximate shippers without intermediaries. The model accounts for the stochastic nature of cargo volumes and the number of cooperators, employs an empirical Weibull distribution, and applies the Monte Carlo method to estimate the probability of economic feasibility of pooling. The results enable determination of the threshold values of the minimum volume of the anchor shipper and the tariff for cooperators, providing a 95% probability of operational profitability.

title: Transport support and prospects for the development of the freight frame on the Moscow Railway
