abstract: This paper illustrates the design concepts such as people-oriented,flow-based streamlined convenient,functional reasonable of the Nanchang east station in detail,makes a specific description on the total station graphic design,graphic functional arrangement,visitors streamline design,profile analysis and architectural model of this station,then points out that the design fully reflects the function of the city integration.Meanwhile, it accumulates some experiences for similar architectural design.

title: Graphic Standards for the Design of Spaces in High-Speed Railway Stations
abstract: The liberalisation of passenger transport by rail on high-speed lines has produced a turning point in this mode of transport. The access of new private railway companies has led to an increase in the number of passengers using this means of transport. This situation has repercussions on the existing stations because the spaces initially designed are not capable of absorbing this new increase and the future demand. This problem can be seen in the València Joaquín Sorolla station. The station was conceived as a provisional station until the construction of the tunnel under the city, but the provisional nature of the station has been prolonged, creating the need to extend the station to absorb the demand for new passengers until the works are completed. However, this increase in demand has had a negative impact on the initial design of the station and on the planned extension, which has been overwhelmed by this growth. In this article, the aim is to graphically clarify the state of deterioration of quality and safety for users of this type of public service as a preliminary step for the study and definition of standards capable of guaranteeing the design in terms of safety and comfort to respond to the new demand.

title: BARRIER-FREE DESIGN FOR THE HANDICAPPED IN STATIONS OF JAPANESE NATIONAL RAILWAYS
abstract: In 1974, Japanese National Railways (JNR) began to study barrier-free design for handicapped people. After three years, Committee presented the barrier-free design standard for handicapped in stations. Since then, based on this standard, facilities and equipment have been gradully improved. In April 1980, JNR had 57 stations which were equipped with bathrooms with handrails, 127 stations with improved fare collection gates, 13 stations with elevators for handicapped, 290 stations with warning and guiding pavers, stations with signs for tactile reading on ticket vendors. Facilities for wheelchair users cost much. Therefore, JNR has concentrated its efforts preferentially on large stations which are highly utilized.

title: Performance based design for the Binyanei Ha'uma Railway Station and Tunnel
abstract: The Binyanei Ha'uma Railway Station and Tunnel is the 1.6 kilometer underground portion of a proposed commuter subway system that will connect Tel Aviv to Jerusalem, Israel. This paper describes the detailed fire modeling analysis that was performed on the entire underground railway station and tunnel system to assess the impact of a train fire developing in either the station or the tunnel on the proposed emergency ventilation system. The performance-based design criteria from the 2003 edition of NFPA 130, Standard for Fixed Guideway Transit and Passenger Rail Systems, were used in the analysis. The purpose of the analysis was to quantify the impact on the station from a train fire developing in the tunnel, and vice-versa, so it was necessary to develop a fire model that encompassed the entire underground portion of the subway system. The complexity and physical size and shape of the tunnel and station presented a number of challenges during the development of the fire model (A). For the covering abstract of the conference se ITRD E216860.

title: FIRE SAFETY DESIGN OF AN INTERNATIONAL RAILWAY STATION(Fire Safety)
journal: AIJ Journal of Technology and Design
abstract: A case study was carried out on fire safety design of an international railway station. The whole facility consists of railway platforms on underground level, main terminal building and bus terminal building on ground. Due to the characteristics of the facility, railway platform is secured for border control, which has only one daily route via main terminal building. In case of fire in terminal building, passengers in platform area may be trapped in railway platform. To solve the safety problems, the whole facility was split into three blocks to confine fire effect within each block. Fire separation zone was designed so as to make three blocks free from fire and smoke each other. Safety checking was made on evacutation safety, firefighters' operation and structural fire resistance.

title: Steel Structure Design of Entrance Bridge of Nanjing Railway Station
journal: Journal of Huazhong University of Science and Technology
abstract: The overview of the entrance bridge of Nanjing Railway Station is given.The designing process of the steel bridge is introduced,including the finite element analysis of the whole bridge structure,and the design of members and joints.Based on the architectural conception,the problem of choosing structural style and strengthening longitudinal structure rigidity are discussed.

title: Design management of Interchange Station in Shanghai Urban Railway Network
abstract: Starting from a single-line type of construction,the urban railways in Shanghai has now entered into a networker When it comes to the design of interchange or hub stations shaped through various rails under construction concurrently,variou issues would inevitably surface,such as the large amount of specialized systems,complicated alignments or connection and different administrative and design units,etc.To ensure that the design of the interchange stations reach the technic requirements,and as well in line with the principal of sharing resources between the civil construction and electric-machiner systems,we must build comprehensive approaches for design management.Only through effective design management coul we achieve such goals as standardization of network construction,humanity of system configuration,optimization of networ functionality,and maximization of network effectiveness.

title: Design and Construction on the Roof Systems of Guangzhou South Railway Station
abstract: The roof structures of Guangzhou South Railway Station are long-span spatial steel structures, The form and structure system are complicated. Prestress cable-arch structure, cable-shell structure and tri-directional truss-string spatial structure are applied. It recommend the construction and design process of roof structure, and also give an analysis of roof structure's working principle on prestress cable-arch structure , cable-shell structure, and the tri-directional truss-string structures. The results show that working stability of the roof structures is good.

title: Design Scheme of Suburban Railway Hub Station in the Context of Station-city Integration—A Case Study of Jiashan Station
journal: DOAJ (DOAJ: Directory of Open Access Journals)
abstract: ObjectiveUrban agglomeration development relies on close transportation connectivity. In recent years，with the progressive improvement of the high-speed railway network and the emergence of suburban railways，comprehensive hubs integrating multiple networks—'high-speed railway-suburban railway-metro'—have continuously emerged within the Yangtze River Delta integrated region. The large passenger flows brought by rail transit have created significant development opportunities for areas surrounding stations，profoundly influencing functional demands and spatial forms in station precincts. As a catalyst for urban growth，high-speed railway can invigorate adjacent districts through station-led functionality improvement and enhance urban vitality. Effective station-area planning should not only emphasize transportation value，but also fully release the development dividends brought by rail transit through coordinated station-city development，thereby creating and enhancing urban value. Guided by the concept of station-city integration，an in-depth design investigation of the suburban railway hub station—Jiashan Station is carried out. MethodAn innovative station-city integration analysis framework centered on the synergy of 'transport efficiency，economic benefit，and social benefit' （hereinafter referred to as the 'three benefits'） is constructed. By analyzing international cases such as Shibuya Station in Tokyo and La Défense Station in Paris，as well as domestic cases including Shanghai Hongqiao Station and Chongqing Shapingba Station，the experiences and shortcomings of different models in the practice of the three benefits are systematically summarized. On this basis，focusing on Jiashan Station of the Jiaxing–Fengnan Suburban Railway，the advantages and disadvantages of different models at the level of the three benefits are clarified，a differentiated optimization path for Jiashan Station is identified，and an in-depth design scheme aimed at maximizing the synergy of the three benefits is proposed.Result & Conclusion The study shows that the design scheme for Jiashan Station，based on a critical assimilation of domestic and international experience，achieves integrated innovation featuring more efficient and intelligent transportation，more diversified and robust economic performance，and a more inclusive ad people-oriented social dimension. Through multi-dimensional collaborative innovation，the station can be effectively upgraded from a transportation hub into a core driver of urban development.

title: A Study on Universal Design Guideline of the Urban Railway Station: Transit Zone
journal: Journal of The Korea Institute of Healthcare Architecture
abstract: Purpose: Recently, Universal design has been applied to a variety of concepts of social integration in the national legislation and institutions, however, the applying to urban railway station is not satisfied. Most of cases, the handicapped can not work continuously, universal design must be provided. Methods: This study derives the detailed criteria through comparing and analyzing an national and international universal design-related system in transit zone. And the status is investigated in transit zone of domestic urban railway station. Improved national standard requirements are derived considering the type of the handicapped and universal design principles. Result: The domestic status shows that the most lacking entry criteria is not specified in national standards or the design is a lowest-level required by criteria through comparing detailed criteria drawn into domestic analysis. Therefore, in order to provide a pedestrian environment to meet the universal design principles and requirements for the handicapped, there is a need to re-establish with a specific national standards. Implications: This study will draw on universal design standards for seamless transfer in transit zone of urban railway station. The next studies are needed to target the overall paths ranging from outside to landing in urban railway station.

title: Research on Design of Flow Line for Underground Entrance into Railway Passenger Station
abstract: Research purposes:As the designs of a number of new railway passenger station to be in service are required for departing the larger number of the passengers in daily mean hour and peak hour,the more attention is paid to the flow line design of the railway passenger station.The flow line for the underground entrance into the station of the the transfer passengers from metro is the best way for shortening the transfer flow line.Therefore,it is necessary to research the design of the flow line for underground entrance into the station. Research conclusions:(1) The flow line mode of the railway passenger station is changed into the Through Type.(2) The design of the underground entrance of the railway passenger station should shorten the transfer distance of the passenger as much as possible.(3) The flow line for the underground entrance into the station should consider the pre-remaining conditions and make reasonable use of the limited underground space of the railway passenger station.

title: Process Design of Rainwater Pumping Station of Wuxi East Station for Beijing-Shanghai Express Railway
abstract: As a key part of municipal supporting project in Wuxi East Station for Beijing-Shanghai Express Railway,the rainwater pumping stations are used for pumping rainwater from the southern and northern subsided squares and the railway awning to rivers outside the station.There are four pumping stations totally.Through rational design,the pumping stations achieve the functions of lifting and discharge of rainwater from the subsided squares,separation and reuse of groundwater,first flush diversion and end use of the awning rainwater.From the overall layout,the pumping stations,ramp bridges,subsided squares,roads and other facilities are integrated perfectly,the land use is maximized in the three-dimensional space and the concealed pumping stations are designed.

title: Prestressed concrete structure design for railway floor of Harbin West Railway Station
abstract: Focus on the problem that the prestressed stress loss due to friction is great,for the reason that the prestressed concrete structures are super long in length and the force is complicated,in the paper,the hybrid reinforcement by both bonded and unbonded strands,the scheme of sectional stretching of the strands and straight bonded strands are proposed to reduce the loss of prestressed stress due to friction.Calculation result shows that the hybrid reinforcement by both bonded and unbonded strands and the scheme of sectional stretching of the strands can reduce prestressed loss,crack width and deflection.In order to determine the area of non-prestressed steel bar and prestressed steel bar,the crack width control method using improved nominal tensile stress is applied.Taking the ratio of prestressed strength as known condition to ensure total reicforcement ratio not exceed the limit.Compression reinforcements are set in compression zones in the ends of beams to meet the requirement relative of the heights equivalent compression zones for taking the dimendions of beams cross sections as constant.

title: Summary of Main Structure Design for Renhe Station of Guangzhou Underground Railway
abstract: On the basis of Renhe railway station project of Guangzhou No.3 underground railway line,the paper makes discussions on the design principle,design load,material selection,consturction method and waterproofing of main structure of the standard two-story underground railway station.

title: Research on Styles and Design Motivations of Architectural Heritage of Railway Stations in Japan
abstract: The architectural heritage of railway stations is an important part of modern industrial heritage, and it is an important physical evidence to study the development history of modern architecture, industry and railway construction. There are some similarities in the history of modern industrial development between Japan and China, and the railway development of Japan has a certain influence on northeast China, which has important reference value for the study of the railway development history of China. This study took the architectural heritage of railway stations in Japan as the research object, sorted out the historical development context of the architectural heritage of railways and railway stations in Japan, collected and sorted out the basic information of all architectural heritage of railway stations in Japan, and investigated the style characteristics of each architectural heritage of railway stations. Based on the development of Japanese architectural thought and the cultural, technological, economic and other social factors when architectural heritage of railway stations were built, the paper analyzed and studied the design motivations of various types of architectural heritage of railway stations. The results are conducive to strengthening the research on the protection and regeneration of railway industrial heritage in China and Japan.

title: Steel Structure Design for the Roof Truss of One Railway Station
abstract: Research purposes: This paper researches the design of a roof truss without columns according to the requirement,such as astylar,clearer,more comfortable and so on in the rebuilding engineering of one railway station. Research methods:Combined with the situation of the construction plot,the major structure,whose plane size is 41 m×400 m in the single-span complete coverage structure style,has no supporting column inside and only has 28 down-to-ground bracings at both sides.And space structure analysis software is adopted to do structure calculation. Research results:By the practice of a new spatial structure system of latticed shell with bolt spherical joints and down-to-ground pipe truss,this paper provides some successful design experiences and special detail construction measures. Research conclusions:The latticed shell with bolt spherical joints and down-to-ground pipe truss of the roof truss without columns can rationally embody the member efficiency and sufficiently display the architectonic effect.For structure in a massive figure,the influence of the temperature stress is remarkable.The structural stress performance under temperature stress can be significantly improved by the corresponding measures.The detail construction design was accomplished with the rational analysis methods,which ensures the structural safety and applicability.

title: Design Research of Rainwater Drainage System Solution for Railway Passenger Station
abstract: In recent years,the frequent extreme rainfalls have posed a severe challenge to the designs of drainage facilities of railway construction projects. In order to ensure the safety of railway passenger transportation,this paper,focusing on the design characteristics of railway passenger station rainwater drainage system,and combined with the problems in actual projects,analyzed and discussed relevant issues,including the station site selection which has influence on drainage,the station drainage system design and discharge outlet design. Finally,a proposal solution was put forward in this paper.

title: Lightning Protection Design System of Shanghai Hongqiao Railway Station in Beijing-Shanghai High-Speed Railway
abstract: This paper introduced the lightn protection design system of Shanghai Hongqiao Railway station in Beijing-Shanghai High-Speed Railway,described the building structure and lightning protection design which is beyond the national technical norms.As the structure of the building project is more special and has diversification,a variety of lightning protection measures were integrated and adopted.The design can provide reference for electrical designer in the similar projects.

title: Design and implementation on Remote Disaster Recovery System for railway station TRS
abstract: The present status of the backup and disaster recovery methods of Railway Ticketing and Reservation System (TRS) were firstly analyzed. The TRS Remote Disaster Recovery System for railway station based on warmstandby technology of Sybase and whole database replication were proposed. The structure of hardware and software, design idea, research methods, replication strategy, performance optimization of Remote Disaster Recovery System for railway station TRS were discussed.

title: The Design of Drawing Platform for Railway Station Electronic Map based on GIS
abstract: Aiming at the demand for drawing electronic map of railway station under the railway train simulation system,the authors research and design a uniform and standard platform for drawing the electronic map of railway stations.After analyzing the functional requirements of Station Electronic Map Drawing Platform,the Data Flow Diagram(DFD) is been obtained.On the basis of things mentioned above,the overall structure,the properties database and the space database of the platform are designed.And this platform is developed base on GIS Software MapX,and successfully utilized in the train simulation project of Beijing-Tianjin inter-city railway.

title: Design of Broadcasting Sound Field for Waiting Hall of LanzhouXi Railway Station
abstract: It is rather difficult to design and control the sound field of reinforcement system for oversize space with long reverberation,especially for articulation,which is common in the waiting hall of railway station. Based on previous research,the building decorative features as well as simulation reverberation time of the waiting hall in LanzhouXi Railway Station,PA sound pressure distribution data,speech transmission index and articulation loss of consonants created by different methods such as linear array concentrated block projection,traditional small-scale sound source( or sound column) distributed projection and selected point sound source distributed projection are analyzed and compared. The results calculated by the EASE software indicate that both large linear array concentrated block projection and selected point sound source distributed projection can meet the design requirements. The conclusion is only effective for the waiting hall in LanzhouXi Rail-way station,but the design method provides an example for the similar design case. Furthermore,based on the scale of the waiting hall in LanzhouXi Railway Station,the code and foundation for sound field design are proposed.

title: A Design of Fuming Rd.Cross Railway Ningbo East Station Main Bridge
abstract: Fuming Rd.cross railway Ningbo East Station main bridge is designed as a twin towers cable planes composite main beam cable-stayed bridge with(55 + 45 + 220 + 45 + 55) m and half-floating system.The designed side span is adopting concrete main beam for lower cost,and the steel beam of mid span is adopting jacking construction plan to resolve the problem of cross railway station and yard,which can provide references for similar projects in the future.

title: Exploration of Urban Renewal Design of Railway Heritage Station Areas from a Perspective of Catalysts： a Case Study of Yiliang Station on the Yunnan-Vietnam Railway
abstract: The Yunnan-Vietnam Railway has played a significant role in Yunnan’s modern development. Its remaining railway stations are not only witnesses to the modern development history of Yunnan but also an important part of industrial civilization. Renewing and utilizing the railway stations along the line is not only of great significance to current urban stock planning but also achieves the protection and revitalization of railway heritage on the material level as well as on the spiritual level. This paper takes Yiliang Station of the Yunnan-Vietnam Railway as the research object. Focusing on the problems such as deserted railway stations，cut-off traffic of railway， and the lack of railway cultural heritage， this study introduces the catalytic theory to leverage its point-line-plane synergistic effects. The aim is to construct an integrated urban framework that connects rural areas， railways， and urban spaces， optimizing functional layout， traffic organization， and spatial configuration， etc.Through a development path that integrates railways with parks， tourism， cultural creativity， and other elements， this study explores the renewal design required for the development of related railways and other industrial heritage， and provides insights for the renewal and transformation design of similar railway industrial heritage sites.

title: Fire Safety Design for Harbin West Railway Station Transportation Junction
abstract: Railway station transportation junction usually combines several transportations such as railway,subway,bus,and so on.Spaces should be attached to each other at transportation hall for convenient transfer,so fire compartment and escape distance usually exceed what the code requires.Performance-based evaluation is applied as a solution which can help designer complete the fire design.In this paper,Harbin West Railway Station fire safety design is studied,and the procedure and key solutions for transfer hall are expounded.These can be used for reference for other similar projects.

title: DESIGN DETERMINANTS FOR PEDESTRIAN CIRCULATION FOR EGYPTIAN RAILWAY STATIONS
journal: Journal of Al-Azhar University Engineering Sector
abstract: The acceleration of the implementation of development plans (Urban) (1) in themodern era stressed the importance and development of rail ways systems in thehorizontal urban spread and decentralization, which was as well as publictransport systems of land is characterized by ease of operation and relatively lowcost used to transport volumes and large quantities of goods for long distances Aswell as passenger transport at high speeds, full comfort, safety and environmentalemission control (2) It should be noted that the four models initiated by theRailways as an element for the models In 2007, the design determinants of thepassenger circulation and the impact of space per person (3) within these modelswere re-evaluated of the recent social, economic and technological developmentsin the country, in order to comfort pedestrian and encourage the use of publictransportation systems and railways in particular. By studying the designdeterminants of some global experiments, we can propose after the designdeterminants of Egypt. إن تسارع تنفيذ خطط التنمية (العمرانية ) ( ١) في العصر الحديث أکد أھمية الاھتمام والتطوير لنظم السککالحديدية في الانتشار العمراني الأفقي واللامرکز ية الشديدة التي کانت فضلا عن نظ م النقل العام البريوتتميز ب سھولة التشغيل وقلة التکلفة نسًبيا حيث يستعمل لنقل حجوم وکميات ضخمة من البضائع لمسافات. ( طويلة وکذلک نقل الرکاب بسرعات عالية وراحة کاملة وأمان تام وإمکانية التحکم في الانبعاثات البيئية ( ٢ويخدر بالإشارة إلي المحطات التي بادرت ھيئة السکک الحديدية بوضعھا کعنصر مبدئي لأربعة نماذج وفي عام ٢٠٠٧ م تم إعادة تقييم المحددات التصميمية لمسارات حرکة المشاة وتأثير نصيب الفرد ( ٣) داخلتلک النماذج في ظل التطورات الاجتماعية والاقتصادية والتکنولوجية التي تشھدھا البلاد في الآونة الأخيرةوبما يحقق الراحة للمسافرين ويشجع علي استخدام نظم النقل العام والسکک الحديدية علي وجھة الخصوصومن دراسة النماذج المصرية وعدم وجود محددات تصميمية وا ضحة لمسارات حرکة المشاة . ومن خلالدراسة المحددات التصميمية لبعضالتجارب العالمية نتمکن من اقتراح بعد المحددات التصميمية لمصر .

title: Design and implementation of Railway Wagon Sheet Information Management System in stations
abstract: It was introduced the software design,the development circumstance and detailed functions of Railway Freight Wagon Sheet Information Management System in the stations,explained the technology approach,actsual effects and appliction perspective.

title: THE DESIGN OF THE REGGIO CALABRIA STATION : A study on Italian architect Angiolo Mazzoni's railway station buildings
journal: Journal of Architecture and Planning (Transactions of AIJ)
abstract: Angiolo Mazzoni's Reggio Calabria Station Building, constructed in 1938, is one of the latest works of a series of railway station buildings that Mazzoni had designed in Italy. One explanation for Reggio Calabria Station Building characteristic would be that it achieved the total design by systematic rule in each level from architecture to furniture. It was based on "The principle of architecture" that Mazzoni suggested in the magazine Architettura e Arti Decorative, in 1927. The rules adopt the following logic. First, a grid system is set for fixing the ground plan and the elevation of the architecture. Next, the same grid is divided equally as a layout of stones to finish the surface inside and outside of architecture; the built-in furniture also follows the layout of stones as a part of the architecture. In addition, shelves are also designed by the systematic way, determination of the proportion by the combination of contents inside and the division of the front of shelves.

title: PRELIMINARY DESIGN OF RECONSTRUCTING THE PASSENGER RAILWAY STATION RIJEKA
abstract: Passenger railway station Rijeka is 132 years old, located in the western part of the today's city centre and physically covering a limited space. In the future, the passenger railway station Rijeka needs to change its role, i.e. a second track should pass through it, thus providing new conditions for efficient urban – suburban railway traffic. Rijeka will be connected with Zagreb by a double track railway line, and then with Istria and Slovenia, the electrification system will be changed, and new trains of high-quality service will be introduced. All this requires also new solutions for the passenger railway station. Therefore, apart from evaluating the current situation at the passenger railway station, the paper deals with the future conditions, traffic forecasts, technical-technological parameters, the capacity dimensioning and offers new preliminary solutions incorporated in the possible space and on the whole into the terminal of the long-distance passenger traffic in Rijeka.

title: The Landscape Design of Railway Station Square in Rui′an City
abstract: Based on the landscape planning of Rui'an Railway Station Square,the paper put forward new ideas of enhancing the landscape features,layout of the station′s facilities,traffic organization.Through the introduction of the program,we hoped it would be helpful for other transport hub in landscape planning.

title: Design of Stationary Vacuum Ground Sewage Discharge System for Railway Station
abstract: In order to collect the sewage from passenger trains stopping at the Hankou Railway Station,the stationary vacuum ground sewage discharge system is utilized.The process flow and main facilities of the system are introduced.Selection of concerned parameters and calculation methods are given.Some key techniques for design of the sewage discharge terminal,the pipe network and the vacuum station, etc.are introduced in detail.

title: The relation of railway sub-station design to its operation
journal: Proceedings of the American Institute of Electrical Engineers
abstract: This paper is limited to a consideration of sub-stations in which high-tension alternating current is received and converted into low-tension direct current. In the operation of a modern railway converter sub-station, reliability of service is of paramount importance, being more important than considerations of first cost, of depreciation, and of maintenance; and in turn the reliability of service is affected to a marked degree by the length of time required to manipulate the various combinations of sub-station apparatus. The following factors will be noticed in this connection: 1. The best method of starting converters. 2. The protection of converters; 3. The use of oil-switches when synchronizing; 4. The regulation of load; 5. The best arrangement of switch-gear; 6. The operation of re verse-current relays; 7. The adjustment of load between the sub-stations which feed the same circuit; 8. The noiseless operation of synchronous converters.

title: A STUDY ON THE RAILWAY STATION ARCHITECTURE AND ITS SURROUNDINGS' URBAN DESIGN IN FRANCE
journal: Journal of Architecture and Planning (Transactions of AIJ)
abstract: This is a study on the measures taken by French authorities to improve railway station architecture and its surroundings' urban design. Mainly forced by EU directives for opening railway market and development of ecological transport modes, the center government, following propositions of a Senator, puts in place policies and organizations and local governments make the most of urban planning measures. Based on the principles of visibility and urban continuity, a specialized think tank (AREP), subsidiary of the French National Railway Corporation (SNCF), also contributes for that and some manuals have been elaborated to generalize their integrated realization.

title: Design of Underpass Bridge of Xiamen North Station on Fuzhou-Xiamen Railway
abstract: Xiamen North Railway Station is a modern integrated transport hub on Fuzhou-Xiamen railway,the underpass bridge in the station underneath crosses the subway,in the middle is the cross aisle,and on the top surface is the traffic lane and platform,the building structural columns are arranged on the underpass bridge too,the structure relationship is very complex. In the cases of conventional frame underpass cannot satisfy the requirement of building layout or traffic planning or other aspects,the underpass bridge design adopts the way of eight rigid frame bridges in combination with platform boards and subgrade retaining structures innovatively to achieve its function demand; and makes building structural columns and rigid frame bridge pier into one,namely the  combining bridge and buitding construction together in structural design to achieve the harmonization of building layout; at the same time,through the ways such as separating the beam and column,setting hinged middle pier,vertical prestress in side pier,tie beams between the pile caps and other methods,solves some problems in the structure stress cleverly; and some thinking and applications are also blended in landscape design. Taking the underpass bridge design as an example,this paper introduces the underpass bridge design factors to be considered under the conditions of station,subway and other complex boundary,as well as innovation in the structure selection and structural design.

title: Design of an Off-Street Parking - A Case Study of Vadodara Railway Station
journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
abstract: Parking is one of the major problems that is created by the increasing road traffic. It is an important development. The availability of less space in urban areas has increased the demand for off-street parking space in area like railway station. In this focused on analyzing the existing condition of parking by "registration number survey" to collect parking data. Such as parking demand, parking accumulation, rate of turnover and to know level of service and after analyzed give better parking design and facilities. In the context above parking facility at railway station of vadodara, have been studied in this project work. The parking surveys undertaken parking supply and demand assessment which is informed about the proper parking, planning and its strategy. The parking assessment policy and strategy is one of the most complex areas of transport planning as parking interfaces with economic development of public transport and traffic issues.

title: Design of an Off-Street Parking - A Case Study of Vadodara Railway Station
journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
abstract: Parking is one of the major problems that is created by the increasing road traffic. It is an important development. The availability of less space in urban areas has increased the demand for off-street parking space in area like railway station. In this focused on analyzing the existing condition of parking by "registration number survey" to collect parking data. Such as parking demand, parking accumulation, rate of turnover and to know level of service and after analyzed give better parking design and facilities. In the context above parking facility at railway station of vadodara, have been studied in this project work. The parking surveys undertaken parking supply and demand assessment which is informed about the proper parking, planning and its strategy. The parking assessment policy and strategy is one of the most complex areas of transport planning as parking interfaces with economic development of public transport and traffic issues.

title: The optimization design of mine railway loading station under constrained condition
abstract: Combining with the reorganization and expansion project example of Zhongping energy mine area railway station,this paper introduced the optimization design scheme of yard plane layout under constrained condition,so that the reorganization and expansion project not affected the using of existing buildings facilities,and could achieve or increase and decrease yard condition.

title: The application of passive design strategies on green railway passenger station building program
abstract: Green railway station architectural design is based on passive design strategies. This article analyzes two strategies-active and passive in green railway station architectural design, and discusses the current situation of application and the particularity of strategies selection by studying the cases, to expect passive design strategies to have a proper application in the green railway station architectural schematic design.

title: Research on the Evaluation of Design Scheme for Railway Station Square Based on 3D Cartoon
abstract: In order to improve the unharmonious condition of urban railway station square,the improvement scheme for the traffic facilities near railway station,such as bus station,parking lots and pedestrians’ square are comprehensively discussed.Using 3D cartoon technique,it brings forth the whole visual effect that will be achieved after the completeness of the railway station square,and supplies strong and obvious evidence for assessing the scheme from aesthetic aspect.According to this,the design scheme can be selected,and the railway station square can obtain the best effect after completeness.At last,some rendering pictures of design schemes are given.

title: Research on Design of Power Supply and Distribution System for Beijing South Railway Station
abstract: Research purposes:The Beijing South Railway Station is the largest railway passenger station in Asia and its open design thought and boldness of concept thoroughly changed the traditional design style of station building and the building structure,so it brought about new requirement for design of power supply and distribution system.This paper gives an introduction to the research on the design of power system and presents a feasible design scheme.Research conclusions:The power supply chiefly depends on national power supply network,the 10 kV power distribution station and substation were installed in the station area for meeting the requirement of power supply to Beijing-Jianjin Intercity Railway and Beijing-Shanghai High-speed Railway,and the 10 kV power distribution station was installed for the station building.The diesel generator sets were installed as the emergency power supply along with the EPS.All these were composes of the power supply and distribution system for Beijing South Railway Station.In addition,the triple power supply and solar photovoltaic generating system were installed and they could supply power for some customers when the outside power failed.

title: The thoughts on the planning design of the comprehensive transport hub at Hangzhou East Railway Station
abstract: Planning and design of the comprehensive transport hub at Hangzhou East Railway Station has strong guidance and reference value for the construction of comprehensive transport hubs with the same type in the country. Started from the concept of comprehensive transportation hub, combined with the current development and the background of comprehensive transport hubs and based on the basis of literature research and practical research, the article introduces the research and design of Hangzhou East Railway Station integrated transport hub, analyzes planning, design and construction characteristics of Hangzhou East Railway Station integrated transport hub, and puts forward suggestions on how to build well railway comprehensive transport hubs in the future, making stations integrated into cities in the planning design and function layout, realized harmonious development of traffic and city functions.

title: Recent developments in the design of cut and cover construction for railway tunnels and stations
abstract: As we move into the next millenium the demand for mass transit railways to be built in urban locations is increasing and this inevitably means that long lengths of track have to be constructed below ground. The design of cut and cover tunnels needs to consider many factors including resistance to flotation, soil lateral loads, water pressure, overburden, superimposed loads, construction loads, de-watering, effects on adjacent structures, settlement, sequence of construction, water tightness, drainage, ventilation, piston effects, rolling stock clearances, fire and passenger evacuation etc. Constructability, maximising overhead development potential and minimising project cost, environmental effects, and traffic congestion due to construction are also critical factors. This paper describes these issues and how they may be addressed. This paper also describes the design of cut and cover stations at North Greenwich and Canada Water as part of the Jubilee Line Extension on the London Underground and the design of cut and cover tunnels on the New Airport Line in Hong Kong.

title: On railway passenger transport center in south station in Fuzhou and its architectural design
abstract: The paper introduces the current situation of the station building of the south railway station in Fuzhou,analyzes a representative planning and the scheme for the single design,points out some design ideas for some optimized outlay structure,the protection of forestation elements and the adoption of hi-tech,and accumulates experience for the design of the railway passenger transport centers.

title: Discussion on the Expression of Regional Culture of Small and Medium Railway Stations——Taking the Design of Liaocheng Station as Example
abstract: The architectural culture is the sum of architectural substances and spiritual wealth in the process of human social practice.It forms the architectural styles by the impact of the history,culture and environment in different regions.The small and medium passenger stations are distributed in various places all over the country with the construction of the railway,so the architectural design of the stations should better express the local culture.This paper discusses the historical and cultural identity in the locations of the stations,and applies the design techniques of the shape,color and architectural symbols,which enable them own the regional characteristics.With the design example of Liaocheng Station,this paper analyzes the cultural and historical background in its region,and introduces how to fully reflect the regionalism of local architectural and culture in the interior and exterior design of stations.It makes a useful attempt for the regional expression.

title: Urban Planning and Design Approaches for Redevelopment: Case of Indian Railway Stations Redevelopment
journal: International Journal of Urban Design and Development
abstract: Urban society’s spatial and functional needs are reflected in the theories that revolve around planning and design. These theories evolve and shape urban policies that are the frameworks for the future. The practice of these theories differs across the world because of the unique history and geography of urban areas. However, theories encompass a wide range of subjects that occur repeatedly. It is important to understand and contextualise the theoretical discourse and to be pragmatic in it. Indian cities are undergoing redevelopment at an unprecedented pace and mode. Many central and state institutions are capitalising on their land. Indian Railways has undertaken the redevelopment of its railway stations. For this, guidelines as manuals have been formed to address aspects considered crucial for the station environment. This has been a novel initiative by the Railways as policies and strategies on redevelopment are far and few. The policy makers of redevelopment consider certain aspects crucial to address, and certain others are sidelined. What could be the reason for this? There are underrepresented sectors that fail to get into the mainstream policies on redevelopment. To understand this discrimination, a list of urban concerns was prepared through the discourse on urban issues in research Papers. The list was expanded by including concerns highlighted by theories on urban planning and urban design. This was considered as a list of factors with which Case studies of redeveloped Railway Stations were examined. It was concluded that some factors are not included in the policies or in the framework of guidelines. The reason could be difficulty in the proper understanding and articulation of these urban issues.

title: Scheme design of Shijiazhuang new railway station square and underground space engineering
abstract: This paper briefly introduced the service objects and scales of Shijiazhuang new railway station east-west square,emphatically elaborated the corresponding design principles and specific design scheme,pointed out the future new railway station square will be combined with rail traffic and city traffic and other functions into one,it not only meet the square functional requirements,but also create perfect ground landscape environment to passengers.

title: Study on application of CAD secondary development in railway station signal engineering design
abstract: Combined with the engineering design of CAD secondary development of all-electronic computer interlocking implementation unit module arrangement list and railway station interlocking tables,it was introduced the applications of Visual Lisp in engineering design of CAD secondary development of railway station signal including the whole ideas,benefits,data structures,processes of Visual Lisp in CAD secondary development.

title: MODELS AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGIES FOR FORMALIZATION OF DESIGN PROBLEMS AND RAILWAY STATIONS DEVELOPMENT AUTOMATION
abstract: The research topic is dedicated to planning technical support, developing automated control systems (ACS), and improving modeling methods for railway stations (RS) technological processes. Modern design engineers require a holistic and systematic understanding of models representing the research object. These models should reflect all operational aspects of future technical systems, including the structure and main processes of the object. The aim of the study is to improve the methodology for formalizing technological processes (TP) of railway stations based on the visual programming paradigm. Objectives include creating use case diagrams (UCD), state diagrams (DIS), and activity diagrams (DIA) in UML to visually represent TPs; describing each object, its executors, and works; formalizing the sequence of technological operations. The results show that using UML allows visualizing the interaction of RS objects and executors, parallel and synchronized processes, and the execution stages of each operation. DIS and DIA diagrams help determine the states of individual objects and the phases of operations. Automated modeling enhances TP efficiency and ensures mutual understanding between designers and operators. Furthermore, graphical-analytical models developed in Rational Rose and AutoCAD facilitate automation of TP planning and calculation of key performance indicators. In conclusion, the proposed methodology enables efficient design, documentation, formalization, and visualization of RS TPs, simplifying technical decision-making and improving the quality of ACS and IS development for railway stations.

title: Discussion on a Few Problems of Electrical Design of Large-scale Railway Passenger Station
abstract: In order to illustrate the reliability of power supply and distribution system,the paper analyzes the load characteristic of large railway station,the external power supply selection,the backup power settings,the system main connection scheme,the monitoring area of the SCADA system and the power supply method for communication signal. The new Shijiazhuang Railway Station,a station for the new passenger line from Beijing to Shijiazhuang,is given as an example in this paper. The analysis result shows that: the TB10008- 2006 Railway electric power design specification load classification,first class load power supply,large third-way power passenger stations and other content requirements are not suitable for the large railway station,especially in the importance and reliability. The paper presents a revised and improved view. The important load such as railway communication or signal is directly related to the safe operation of high-speed train. The railway line through automatic blocking circuit power has obvious advantages to the self-power diesel generator. In normal condition,the automatic blocking circuit power should be chosen preferentially to match the highly reliable requirement.

title: The Design of Integrated Transit Hub Superstructure——North Station and Subsidiary Management Building of Shanghai Railway Station
abstract: Two ground buildings,one auxiliary building management,another north station building in Shanghai Railway Station's North Square integrated transit hub project offers the square's interface and background,furthermore,they also decorate this city appearance.Based on the design tactics of relaxation and tightness,the two buildings show different characteristics.They provide a good practice which obeys the concept of design for the passenger,for the people.

title: Discussion on several issues encountering in the building design of urban railway traffic station
abstract: Taking partial stations of Shenyang subway No.1 line phase Ⅰ and prolonging engineering as the research object,this paper summarizes and analyzes matters needing attention in urban railway traffic station design for construction major,so as to guide practice and to achieve optimal design.

title: The Overall Design of Haihe Rd.(E) Underpass in Front of Tianjin Railway Station
abstract: With the rapid social and economic development in Tianjin, the infrastructural construction of the city is also at the stage of fast growth. For fast collection and dispersion of traffic flows at the Station and convenient shift between the railway and light rail traffic and all types of traffic means under and above the ground, it is necessary to build and update the municipal facilities. Introduced hereby is the overall design of Haihe Rd. (E) Underpass in front of Tianjin Railway Station, including the standards for the design, key control factors and the plane, profile and pavement structure designs.

title: Exterior illumination design for medium and small-sized stations in Jiaoxin Railway line
abstract: Combined with the features in exterior illumination design in medium and small sized stations along Jiaoxin Railway line the design principle and technical regulation are introduced from the design of platform, throat zone, lead track and so on. Optimum design plan is proposed as well as related experiences.

title: Box Girder Structure Selecting and Design of Viaduct in Front of Nanjing Railway Station
abstract: The viaduct in front of Nanjing Railway Station is an important part of the construction projects of the Nanjing railway station square. The viaduct is beside the famous Xuanwu lake scenery. The usual structure form of viaducts in city and the section shape of girder bridges were compared and discussed in this paper. The box girder's section was optimized and the original crescent shape section was chosen. The crescent shape section girder's structure calculating and design were also discussed in this paper. The appearance of the viaduct and the scenery of circumstance by the lake were harmonized, which has great value in applying and vision.

title: Design of Glass Curtain Wall of New Railway Station and Its Development Trend
abstract: Research purposes:Through reviewing several elevation designs of railway station,this paper studies the characteristics of the glass curtain wall for railway station,including the support styles for large space curtain wall and how to choose glass panels,and also prospects the new development trend of glass curtain wall in new railway station.Research conclusions:Using steel truss and tension bar truss is comparatively a good way to support the large space and big span curtain wall,and the application of Low-E glass on glass curtain wall is an effective way to reduce solar radiation.Light-volt power and dual-air circulation technologies are more and more adopted in design and construction of glass curtain wall for modern building.

title: The Hard Landscape Design of the front Square of New Zhuji Railway Passenger Station
abstract: By analyzing the hard landscape design of the front square of new Zhuji railway passenger station, we expound the using of human-oriented in general layout and traffic system. And it also introduces the way of combine with modern city landscape and traditional culture from 4 aspects which are ground pattern design, service architecture design, waterscape design and lighting design.

title: Research on Space Design of Hub-Type Railway Stations Based on Wayfinding Theory
abstract: The design of hub-type railway stations not only strengthens their connection with cities and transportation systems,but also results in passengers' difficulties in finding ways in the stations: the form makes passengers' spatial cognition more difficult;the huge scale widens the range for wayfinding;the intensified functions increases information processing;the three-dimensional travel brings more complex vertical positioning.So in design,simple and clear building plane and section plans,spatial organization according to the principle of section and level division,more indoor and outdoor site targets,and recognizable well-connected spaces should be considered,to help passengers positioning and increase humane standards of these stations.

title: Research on the Design of the Combined Pile-foundation of Wuhan Railway Station
abstract: Research purposes: The area of reinforcement pile cap of the combined pile-foundation of Wuhan Railway Station is large with the complicated reaction forces of the base and obvious eccentric effect.Most of the reinforcement pile caps bear the reaction force of inclined columns with huge horizontal pushing force.The mechanical behavior of combined pile foundation is analyzed in this paper according to rigid foundation and flexible foundation.Research conclusions:It is critical to determine the reasonable center of form in rigid calculation.The pile should be arranged according to the reasonable coincidence of the center of form of reaction force and the center of form of pile foundation.The bore force situation of the pile foundation should be calculated under different load combinations.If the center of form of reaction force can not coincide with the center of form of pile foundation,the bearing capacity of the pile foundation should be calculated according to the eccentric load.The reinforcement pile cap's stiffness,soil constraint and torsion moment should be considered in flexible calculation.The vertical and horizontal bore force situation,moment of piles and foundation displacement obtained with finite element method can be compared with those by rigid calculation,which can provide the data for crack calculation and upper frame structure of pile.

title: Design and Realization of Simulation System of Railway Station Signal Console
abstract: This paper offers an explanation about Simulation System of Railway Station Signal Console,including the system,s structure,constitution,general feature,working theory of the software,And designing methods in the process of the system development.The system has been successfully applied in the training and teaching of railway.

title: Lecture 3: Foundations of sustainable design: The time of railway stations
abstract: The third in a series of five lectures presented by Niklaus Kohler to the students in the UT School of Architecture Foundations of Sustainable Architecture class (ARC350R, Fall 2009). Video and accompanying slides.

title: Research on the Design of Index System of Green Railway Station Construction
abstract: As a response to the great expansion of the railway enterprise in China,an index system of green railway station is fairly essential to be built up,from where the green construction is a critical factor.Combining the features of the assessment on green construction in China with the index system of green railway station and the characteristics of railway station construction,a further research has been carried out on the aspect of the method and content for assessing the green railway station construction,and an index system of green railway station construction related to the current development of green building has been established,which forms a foundation for making evaluationstandards on green railway station construction.

title: Subgrade Design of Dali West Station on Dali-Ruili Railway
abstract: Dali West Station is located on the right bank of Xi'er River that belongs to the typical denuded ravine landform. The design of subgrade is strongly featured by high seismic intensity,extremely complicated landform and geology.This subgrade works in the range of only 1 km,where the seismic intensity reaches 8 degree,are impacted by a large regional fault and two branch faults. Unfavorable geology and special geotechnical development include mud-rock flow,landslide,talus,bedding,overhanging rock and rock fall,pothole and steep hill spoil. In view of such complex landform and geology,annular protecting net,lightweight and flexible reinforcement and protection technology of anchor( rockbolt),in-situ reinforcement technology of soil nailing wall,slab-pile wall with anchor and frame beam with anchor,weight balanced retaining wall on the supported beam of pile foundation and other new combined retaining structures are adopted for subgrade works to realize the engineering design ideas of diversity,combination,new type orientation,lightweight trend and flexibility. In the study of the technical proposals,we focus on the overall things and start with the specialties. Besides,systematic risk control of subgrade construction is highlighted,and open-cut tunnel is reasonably chosen for passing mud-rock flow gully,which greatly reduces the renovation construction of bridges by the side of mountains. Rationalization,integration and systematization of engineering choice are achieved.

title: General design of Office Automation System on railway station and depot
abstract: It was given the general, data flow and network design of OA System on the basis of the management model and data flow. discussed the operation method, environment and other problems appearing in the program of the System.

title: Unification of Urban Design Policies for TOD based on Railway Station
abstract: Even though the civic center community reorganized from the private car base to public transportation, it need to satisfy the factors as like the traffic safety, the crime prevention, the improvement of comfortable convenience, the cares for week person which are contributed to maintain the traffic function harmoniously and activate the local economy. Also these factors are included the transit oriented development factors and the common topics in contrast to the principles and the detailed targets. In this study, the plan of railway station based on the public transit is suggested which are arranged the developing factors of TOD and the various policies under implying to Korea.

title: From Origin to Image via Meaning Explorations of the Design of Large-scale Railway Station in China and its Path of Evolution
abstract: Drawing upon his personal involvement in the entire process of the new wave of railway station construction in China,the author of this article reflects the long and hard stories on gains and losses in the process and rethinks the basis on which good stations can be produced.It offers an analysis of the multiple properties,social values and sources of inspirations for design,and explores the general rules as well as exceptions of the production of architectural form based on analysis of the specific conditions of the country.It also tries to contribute to the future by offering useful advice and enduring appeal on building of excellent quality stations.

title: Electricity System Design for Both Nanjing South Railway Station and Related Project
abstract: Combined with the electricity system design for both Nanjing South Railway Station and its related projects,the author carried out technical and economic comparison combining with actual project situation,and then some key technologies of electricity system design were confirmed as below: share the 220 kV external power with the traction substation,and jointly-build the 220/10 kV distribution substation;adopt the high-pressure diesel generator unit as the emergency power supply of the extra-large station building;use the 20 kV power distribution system for local auxiliary projects;use the miniature RTU in 10/0.4 kV substation to achieve the remote dispatching of electrical equipment and meter display function;install the electromechanical devices and building environment automation system(BAS) in the station building so as to meet the requirements of process control,management and energy saving.

title: SEISMIC DESIGN STUDY OF HIGH SLOPE AT MAO STATION IN CHENGDU——LANZHOU RAILWAY
journal: Chinese journal of rock mechanics and engineering
abstract: In traditional seismic design of slope,the most commonly used method is the pseudo-static method.Because of its limitations,a new method of seismic design of the slope is proposed based on the strength reduction dynamic analysis.The proposed method takes into account the interaction between the supporting structure and rock soil under earthquake.It can satisfy the design requirements of earthquake and static stability of slope.The internal forces of supporting structure are obtained by the method.So,it ensures the safety and economics of engineering design.The seismic design of high slope of Mao railway station demonstrates the feasibility of the proposed method in practice,which provides a new idea for the seismic design of retaining the slope.

title: Specialized Lighting Design for Railway Station Buildings on Hefei-Bengbu Passenger Dedicated Line
abstract: A first-class railway station requires all-around implementation of every step such as planning,design,construction, equipment,apparatus,maintenance,management and so on.This paper makes a brief introduction to the lighting in its design idea,method and experience of major spaces in railway stations in combination with the actual specialized lighting design for the station buildings on Hefei-Bengbu passenger dedicated line.

title: Optimization design of deep excavation retaining of excavation group at Xining railway station
journal: Journal of Lanzhou University of Technology
abstract: Referencing to the experience of deep excavation retaining design adapted in the northwest region of this country and considering the factors such as its safety and cost etc,the original retaining design plan in the overall project of comprehensive reconstruction of Xining railway station was rationally optimized.The original plan and framework on a unique pile of prestressed anchor lattice beam plus a scheme was replaced by an upper soil nail wall plus a lower row pile anchor combined support system.By using soil nailed wall with maximum upper slope,the soil load was decreased and the active earth pressure reduced.The lower combined support system with local encryption reinforcement pars set at the location of maximum bending moment in pile body was used to effectively control the excavation process distortion, simplifying the construction process.

title: Research on Main Truss Design of NO-platform-column Canopy in Beijing Railway Station
abstract: Research purposes: After research on the main body of no-platform-column canopies(the first in China) with large span and long-suspending-extending structure in Beijing railway station,the key problem in the period of canopy construction is solved,and the safety and credibility of main body of canopies are guaranteed.Research methods:The optional computing data of structure is made certain by colligating analysis on the project and integrating the result researched by the others of this subject in China.3D3S software which is steel structural calculating system is used by calculating and checking.Research conclusions:Under the complicated existing condition in the station,the section size of supporting columns and the structure height being limited,the columns are located among the tracks for the first time and some innovated design and technology are adopted,such as large span over-passing two platforms,long-suspending-extending(structure) and so on.Thus,it is realized that there are no columns on all platforms.This research resolved many(difficulties) in engineering process.On the other hand,it is(indicated) that large span and steel structure is the same with construction of(no-platform-column) canopies.

title: A Study on Crime Prevention Through Environmental Design in Railway Station Facilities : An Empirical Study Based on Field Observations
abstract: This study analyzes challenges and best practices in the design and operation of railway station facilities by applying the five core principles of Crime Prevention Through Environmental Design (CPTED) — natural surveillance, access control, territorial reinforcement, activity support, and maintenance — to 13 spatial types defined in the Railway Station Design Standards (KR A-03021). The analysis revealed that natural surveillance was particularly critical in five spatial types, where ensuring visual openness played a key role. Access control was found to be necessary in three areas, requiring both physical and technological restrictions. Territorial reinforcement was needed in two spaces, emphasizing the importance of clearly defined spatial boundaries. In terms of activity support and maintenance, five spatial types each showed a high relevance, underscoring the importance of sustaining indirect surveillance and securing safety through preventive maintenance.

title: Design for Merger between High-speed Railway Station and Existing Station Based on Hangzhou-Changsha Passenger Dedicated Line
abstract: The design for merger between high-speed railway station and existing station on Hangzhou-Changsha passenger dedicated line is introduced in this paper.It discusses the merging features between high-speed railway and ordinary-speed railway including the deployment of high-speed railway yard and ordinary-speed railway yard,the number of arrival and departure tracks,cross-line facilities,setting of work areas and setting of crossovers etc.

title: User-Centered Inclusive Wayfinding Design for Improved Navigation at Minna Railway Station, Nigeria
journal: IIARD INTERNATIONAL JOURNAL OF GEOGRAPHY AND ENVIRONMENTAL MANAGEMENT
abstract: Efficient navigation within transportation facilities is essential for accessibility, safety, and user satisfaction. However, many railway stations in Nigeria lack inclusive wayfinding systems capable of supporting diverse user groups. This study examines user-centered and inclusive wayfinding strategies for improving navigation at Minna Railway Station in Niger State, Nigeria. Using a qualitative case study approach, systematic field observations were conducted to assess how passengers interact with the station’s spatial layout and existing wayfinding elements. Data were collected through repeated site visits, field notes, spatial sketches, and photographic documentation focusing on circulation patterns, signage visibility, accessibility features, and user navigation behaviour. The findings reveal several challenges, including poorly positioned signage, limited tactile and auditory navigation cues, obstructed accessible routes, and heavy reliance on informal assistance from staff or other passengers. These conditions create barriers for persons with disabilities, elderly users, and first-time travelers. The study therefore proposes design strategies that emphasize improved signage hierarchy, clearer spatial organization, and the integration of multi-sensory wayfinding cues based on universal design principles. The research contributes to the development of a user-centered framework for enhancing navigability and inclusive mobility in Nigerian railway stations and similar public transport environments.

title: Analysis on the railway station building architectural design of inter-city rapid rail transit
abstract: Combined with the examples of railway station buildingdesign along Guangzhou-Zhujiang line,it discusses the differences of passenger organization between inter-city rapid rail transit and common rail transit,illustrates the features of city light rail and the design requirements of the railway station building of inter-city rapid rail transit,so as to realize the function,system,advancement,culture and economy of inter-city rapid rail transit.

title: System Design and Implemental Methods of Railway Station Signal Equipments Management Based on GIS
abstract: This paper analyses the present situation of railway station signal equipment management,and discusses the possibility and necessity for applying the GIS to railway management.Based on the characteristics of signal equipment ,the fundamental structrue,model of detail design and implemental methods of the signal equipment management are put forward

title: The Station Is Located in the Loess Valley; the Bridge and the Road Merge into the City: Design of Xi’an East Railway Station Under the Concept of “Four Harmonies”
abstract: 西安东站是西安市规划高铁、普铁、城际、地铁、公交一体的特大型枢纽站，针对设计中面临的城市视觉通廊控制、城市与自然多层次融合、城市交通复合网络以及分期建设与形体控制等问题，采用“塬谷复合、杜白缝合、站城融合、桥路结合”的“四合”理念，结合特殊的城市区位、地理环境及交通条件，重点分析建筑功能分区与流线组织的关系，进而从平面布置、形体组合与立面设计等方面提出了设计要点与策略，并应用软件模拟验证了室内外光环境和风环境的舒适性。

title: Design of Railway Station Monitoring System on Automatic Blocking Lines(Continuous Transmission Lines)
abstract: This paper uses GPRS to design a railway station monitoring system on automatic blocking lines(continuous transmission lines)for the purpose of making real-time monitoring the electric signals of all railway stations,discovering and eliminating the troubles timely,and improving the safety and reliability of distribution networks,and through analyzing the applied technique of GPRS,solves the data transmutation between two communication parties,and establishes corresponding transmit protocols,implements the two way communication,and also implements the remote monitoring by the application of Web service.

title: Interface Design between Electrification Renovation Project and Platform Canopy at Wuyishan Railway Station
abstract: In the process of electrification renovation of existing line,the interface design between the overhead contact line system(OCS) and the platform canopy is an important content.Considering that Wuyishan Railway Station is located at landscape and famous scenery area,in combination with the patterns of existing platform canopy at Wuyishan Railway Station,various interface schemes were put into comparison,respectively from the aspects such as the OCS function,the visual effect and so on.After the jointly-built scheme was determined,several designs were carried out like the model selection design of OCS posts,the interface design with architecture and structure subjects.And then,on the premise of meeting the OCS function,by strengthening interface management,and by giving consideration to the demands of visual effect and the station utilization,some problems were avoided,such as rain leakage of the canopy after renovation,big appearance difference between OCS posts and canopy columns which cannot accord with aesthetic requirement.The appearances of canopy columns after the renovation can accord with that of existing canopy columns.

title: Structural and economic analysis of changes in design parameters of urban railway stations: a case study
abstract: Structural and economic analysis of changes in design and construction parameters of sections of urban railway stations is conducted. Station I2 of line 2 of Mashhad, Khorasan Razavi, Iran urban railway is considered as a sample station to be studied. Considering the existing condition of the station as a reference design, the effects of changes of concrete compressive strength, section height and type of rebar on load-bearing capacity of the structure are investigated. Further, economic analysis of the mentioned changes is conducted to obtain the most efficient design. The results indicate that bending members play more important roles; thus, an increase of concrete compressive strength could not substantially affect the decrease of area of reinforcement in those members. The minimum concrete compressive capacity that can be utilized in I2 station is C25 grade, so that the lower concrete grades could not meet the structural requirements. Furthermore, the results of parametrical analysis show that an increased concrete compressive strength as well as a decreased section height leads to a similar cost and load-bearing capacity to the reference design, while including better durability and lifetime characteristics. In this way, with the purpose of obtaining a similar load-bearing capacity to the reference design, utilization of rebar with increased strength grade (AIV instead of AIII rebar) can also result in decreasing the area of reinforcement, which can be followed by a 9% added value for the project.

title: Research on the Place Spirit and Landscape Reconstruction Design of the Shangrao Former Railway Station Square
abstract: The landscape reconstruction design of the Shangrao former railway station square was conducted in this paper.Some design ideas and methods on Inheritance and innovation of history,the local culture exhibition,ecological design and other aspects were discussed in order to offer reference to other landscape designation and lead more debate on this issue.

title: Optimization Design of Tri-directional Beam String Structure of New Guangzhou Railway Station
abstract: The APDL language was used to obtain the parameter model of tri-directional beam string structure(TBSS) of new Guangzhou Railway Station.Then design optimization was conducted for the effective cross-sections and geometry parameters of TBSS with the first-order method.And when the rise and sag were fixed,the proper structural cross-section was also discussed with graded and integrated optimization method respectively.The results show that the rise and sag are very important design parameters of TBSS.The optimum rise of upper arch of TBSS for new Guangzhou Railway Station is 9.189 m;the sag to span ratio of cable is not less than 0.034;the economical rise to sag ratio is about 0.22~0.23.It can also be found that the weight ratio of upper arch elements to the whole structure is large,so the amount of steel can be reduced by decreasing the thickness of upper arches.And the optimum rigidity ratio of beam to cable of TBSS of new Guangzhou Railway Station is 1.23×10-4 by integrated optimization.

title: Image Originated from Concept:The Design Concept of "Grand Circulation,Grand Space and Grand Surroundings" for Shanghai South Railway station
abstract: This article tries to explain and analyse the design concept, the spatial organization of Shanghai South Railway Station. Planned to be the overland transportation hub of Shanghai in the 21st century, this building, under the guideline of human-based, circulation- focused and environment fine, was designed to express the concept of communication, grand and grand virescence.The architects tried innovative ways on circulation organization, architectural image, environmental planning, new materials and techniques in the construction, among which the innovative organization of the circulation, the realization of the space concept, and the harmonization of the architecture with its green surroundings were the most prominent.

title: Innovation of Tradition and Heir of Covered Bridge——Appreciation of Ningde Railway Station Architecture Design
abstract: This passage introduces three covered bridges of state-level key heritage conservation units in Mindong,Pingnan County.They are Baixiang Bridge, Qiancheng Bridge, Wan’an Bridge. It also gives a general overview of the twisting process of Ningde railway station architecture design and analyzes how this building learns from ancient covered bridge’s structure elements,that is to make the past serve the present and find something new from the old so as to construct the modern railway traffic constructions which also reflect Mindong regional feature.

title: On the feasibility of revising current design standards regarding the placement of railway stations on reverse curves in the plan
journal: Вестник Ростовского государственного университета путей сообщения
abstract: This article examines the prohibition of placing railway stations on reverse curves in existing design standards. Previously applicable station and junction design standards on Russian railways, as well as international and domestic experience in operating railway stations on reverse curves, are analyzed. A comparative analysis of regulatory documentation establishes a cause-and-effect relationship between the presence of inverse curves and deterioration in visibility, and identifies the conditions under which the use of inverse curves was permitted.A brief overview of modern technical means for compensating for reduced visibility is provided.A conclusion is reached regarding the advisability of revising current design standards.

title: A landscape design for central core area of Jinan West Railway Station Prince scenery
journal: Hebei Journal of Forestry and Orchard Research
abstract: The central core area of Jinan West Railway Station Prince scenery on both sides of the Green Shaft and Landscape Design was a research project for transforming the people's impressions that 'incompatibility' and 'no landscape to view.According to the specific feature and functions it will have and the backbone of the China natural landscape garden combine with the Europe rule-style formal garden elements and local cultural characteristic,the conception of 'Four three-dimensional spaces' was used in the design including to cut apart apace vertically,meanwhile,to plan horizontally division in order to add functions and enhance rate of utilization.

title: Transportation Nodes Landscape Design——The Case of Nantong Railway Station Square
abstract: For landscape of communicating nodes, most important thing is to deal with relationship between image of landscape and traffic flow line, give passing visitors a warm, comfortable feeling, and also play role of city landmarks, reflecting city's unique cultural style and leaving visitors a deep impression. Nantong Railway Station Square landscape relies on its clear division of functions, smooth traffic organization, and unique carving landscape, as show of the door of city, Jianghai charm style window, to explore a new traffic node landscape creation pattern.

title: Reading the corridor space of urban design of the region of Suzhou railway station
abstract: The thesis has analysed the corridor space of urban design of the region of Suzhou railway station.The thesis has also expatiated how to use regional element to modern urban design and has summarized the principle of it,solves the problems existed in actual project design,offers reference for city designing job in the future.

title: Determination of Location and Design for Urban Railway Station (Case : Yogyakarta – Magelang)
