abstract: Yogyakarta and Magelang is one of the cities in Indonesia, which has huge potential economic development. The tourism sector that is highly favored in the city should be comparable with that provided transportation services as access to reach the desired tourism destination. Yogyakarta-Magelang railway along approximately 45 km is one of the oldest rail line. Because of the potential and the trips number from and two both cities, the reopening of the railway line and railway station is needed. The number of railway station building across Yogyakarta – Magelang are 18 units. 10 units building are as the station, while 8 units as train stop/shelter. In general, that building station and train stop has been switching their function. Some are used by citizens, businesses, as well as police station, Koramil office, public transport station, bus station, and also leased to PDAM. But on the other hand, there is a station building that is not there anymore, but razed to the ground. So that the rebuilding of the railway station should be based on the number of passenger demand which we know from the survey and could also be from the former station locations.

title: Design on Integrated Passenger Guidance Information System for railway passenger station
abstract: Integrated Passenger Guidance Information System for railay passenger station was designed based on analysis of characteristics of the Traditional Passenger Guidance Information Systems and Passenger Transport Service Information Systems.The design was adopted multi-client/sever structure,and could be provided better dispatch of guidance information,effective supported of the integration of Various Service Information Systems,and had high extensibility and flexibility.

title: Design and implementation of knowledge database for Diagnose Expert System of railway station signal equipment
abstract: According to the goal in the Diagnose Expert System for railway station signal equipment,it was adopted object-orient structural knowledge representation in the design and implementation of knowledge database for Diagnose Expert System.It was analyzed the constitution of object-orient knowledge representation and its features.Meanwhile,by the concrete example,it was also explained the designing and implementing method for original knowledge database.After the actual operation in this expert system,It was find that object-orient technique not only enhanced the representation in expert knowledge,but also benefited the organization for expert knowledge.

title: Innovative Design of Energy-saving Lamps Applied on Railway Station Field
abstract: Aiming at the current problem that no special lamps are adopted on the railway station field and the technological economics is bad, the paper simulate distribution of light, calculate illumination, and finally complete the development of the railway station field lamps. The energy-saving lamps effectually reduce the light-losing on the specific railway field, conquer the deficiency that general road lamps adopting bat-wing distribution of light, greatly improve the value of illumination and equality and the output efficiency, make the color light more even and more mild. The lighting effect is perfect. The application of the Energy-saving Lamps can save the cost and reduce the project expense, thereby having distinct economic and social benefit.

title: Design and implementation of Data Switch System between stations of railway administration
abstract: It was well-know that stations played a very important role in entire railway transportation activities. In this paper, the data exchange implementation methods between railway administration and stations were discussed in BDS(Bureau Dispatch System) . The data exchange was facilitated by using the Socket. Furthermore, some pivotal Java pseudocode was also given. It was proved that the System was satisfied the requirements of daily transportation works.

title: Bridge Design and Research on Elevated Station in Shanghai-Nanjing Intercity Railway
abstract: In the project of Shanghai-Nanjing Intercity Railway,5 elevated stations are all integrated building-bridge systems.The bridge structure which acts as the force-bearing system and the force-transferring system,is always under the condition of very heavy loads caused by the station buildings.Spatial finite element analysis results show that: The pier bottoms of the elevated stations suffer huge bending moment and shear fore;bending-shear-torsion combination effects are very obvious in π shaped platform beams with reserved stair hole;transverse force is relatively unfavorable in π shaped platform beam of 12 meters wide;local stresses in junction parts between steel and concrete are complex,involving the roof truss steel pipe column,steel canopy column and concrete pier,and the concrete platform beam.Through adding the ordinary reinforcing bars and the prestressed reinforcing bars,reducing the interval between the diaphragms,strengthening local concrete,setting shear studs and other measures,safety and reliability of integrated building-bridge systems are guaranteed.

title: Structure Design and Analysis on Platform Canopy of Hohhot East Railway Station
abstract: Taking the platform canopy at Hohhot East Station as a project case,this paper introduces the design process of a beam string structure(BSS).Using SAP 2000 and ANSYS finite element analysis software,the whole BSS and the BSS members were analyzed respectively,and both calculation results could accord well with each other.Combined with the characteristics of beam string structure,the feasible hoisting scheme were put forward which could ensure the safety of beam string structure in the processes of tensioning and hoisting.Finally the bearing joint of the beam string structure was analyzed,and a new type of bearing joint was designed.Through numerical simulation analysis on the joint,it is concluded that the design can meet the relevant requirements.

title: Rapid 1D Design Method for Energy-Efficient Air Filtration Systems in Railway Stations
abstract: Microscopic Particulate Matter (PM) below 10 µm can enter the respiratory system and affect human health in the short and long term. Railway enclosures are sites with high concentrations of fine PM and technical solutions like mechanical filtration exist to increase the air quality. However, several crucial factors must be evaluated and optimized like energy consumption, maintenance cost/interval, design and control. A fast and adaptable evaluation of decontamination solutions is required to find the optimal solution. To answer this, a 1D multizone model based on station discretization aligned with the track direction is proposed to precisely place decontamination systems along the station. In each zone, a set of ordinary differential equations is used to forecast the daily progression of PM concentrations, based on physical parameters (air and train velocities, and train traffic) used to describe the different physical phenomena (resuspension, deposition, ventilation and generation). Three-dimensional CFD (Computational Fluid Dynamics) simulations are used to characterize the efficiency and range of decontamination products and reproduce their effect in the 1D model. This approach allows for flexible optimization of local and global decontamination efficiencies with multiple parameter changes. PM10 and PM2.5 (below 10 and 2.5 µm) are studied here as they are often monitored.

title: Design of large-span steel structural no-platform-column canopy of Hankou Railway Station
abstract: The design of a no-platform-column canopy for Hankou Railway Station is introduced;especially the structural allocation and loading system are emphasized.With the computing and analyzing the structure under different loading combinations,the most reasonable curvature of canopy is received,which could decreases the cross-sectional height of steel beam effectively.Computational results show that the temperature loading leads to large internal forces in the rigid frame and foundation for the super large-span curved structure.By the buckling analyses of both the curve of characteristic values and the nonlinear values,the entire structural stability is studied.The results show that both stability and bearing capacity of the large span arch structure are outstanding.

title: Planung und Herstellung des Haupttragwerks des Lehrter Bahnhofs / Design and construction of Lehrte railway station main load-bearing system
abstract: Das Haupttragwerk des unterirdischen Bahnhofbauwerkes ist eine Stahlbeton-Rahmenkonstruktion, bestehend aus einem Ortbetontraegerrost, Verbundstuetzen und einer durchgehenden Gruendungsplatte. Im Kreuzungspunkt des Fernbahnhofs mit den Bruecken der querenden Stadtbahn stellen die Gabelstuetzen eine Besonderheit dar. Die Konstruktionselemente werden beschrieben, die Berechnungsverfahren erlaeutert, und es wird auf die Wechselwirkung der Bauteile untereinander eingegangen. Schwerpunkte bilden dabei der Stahlbetontraegerrost als Abfang- und lastverteilende Deckenkonstruktion und die Stahlverbundstuetzen zwischen den Gleisen des Fernbahnhofs. Besondere Belange der Herstellung und Montage werden aus Sicht der ausfuehrenden Arge Rohbau dargestellt. (A) ABTRACT IN ENGLISH: The main load-bearing system of the underground railway station is a reinforced-concrete frame structure consisting of an in-situ girder grille, composite columns, and a continuous foundation slab. Where the long-distance railway station crosses the urban railway bridges, the branched columns are a particular feature. The structural elements are described, the design procedures explained, and particular mention is made of the interaction between the various structural elements. Special emphasis is placed on the reinforced-concrete girder grille serving as a holding and load-distributing floor structure, and the steel composite columns between the tracks of the main railway station. Major aspects of construction and erection are given from the viewpoint of the joint venture carrying out the structural works. (A)

title: Research on Micro-Renewal and Optimization Design of Lanzhou Railway Station Area Under Catalyst Linkage
abstract: Under the general trend of stock renewal, the development bottleneck of the old city railway station area is becoming more and more prominent. How to promote the optimization and upgrading of the old city station area and revitalize the vitality of the area is an urgent problem to be solved in the current urban renewal. Taking Lanzhou Railway Station as an example, after defining the reasonable scope and combing the current situation of the area, the micro-renewal and optimization design of the railway station area was carried out through the concept of catalyst linkage. The station square was established as the point element, the road in front of the station and the commercial belt along the street as the line element, and the plot in front of the station as the surface element. The “multi-point aggregation, linear string point, point-line-surface linkage development” was taken as the renewal and optimization policy, and the current area optimization scheme was clarified to promote the renewal, optimization and upgrading of the old city area of Lanzhou Railway Station.

title: Research of Key Techniques for Bridge Design in Integrated Bridge and Building Structure of Wuhan Railway Station
abstract: Wuhan Railway Station is a large and fully elevated passenger railway station featuring an integrated bridge and building structure.Since the bridge and building are integrated,the design of the bridge structure will not only meet the railway load requirements,but also will be competent to carry the load from the building.Moreover,the configuration,size and scale of the bridge will be agreeable with those of the building in order to satisfy the global architectural effect as well as service function of the Station.In this paper,the key techniques for the design of the bridge in the integrated bridge and building structure are presented.

title: Memorial Design for Relocation Site of Steam Locomotive in Jangdan Station on Kyong-Eui Railway
journal: Journal of the Korean Institute of Landscape Architecture
abstract: 경의선 철도는 부산과 신의주를 오가던 한반도의 주요 종단 철도로서 한반도 물류, 교통의 중심이었으며, 동시에 분단국가의 하나됨을 염원하는 상징적 의미를 지니고 있다. 경의선 장단역에 멈춰선 증기기관차는 한국전쟁 당시 피폭되었다. 이 기관차는 녹슨 채 반세기 넘게 비무장지대 안에 방치되어 있었으며, 남북분단의 역사적 상징물이다. 본 연구는 등록문화재 제78호인 '경의선 장단역 증기기관차'의 이전에 따라 역사적 관점, 기념공원으로서의 역할 그리고 지역문화 관광적 측면에서 접근하였다. 설계의 주안점은 기본적으로 증기기관차라는 문화재의 정체성을 대변하는 3가지 이슈를 가지고 접근하였다. 첫째, 독개다리 지역은 경의선 상에 배치되는 장점을 가지고 있으나, 부지가 협소하여 기존 지형을 이용한 경사로와 계단 등을 설치하여 일정한 보행환경을 유지하였다. 둘째, 수직적 관람데크를 설치하여 전시물을 다양한 방식으로 관람하도록 하였으며, 관람공간은 관람객의 안전과 문화재의 보호를 고려하였다. 셋째, 증기기관차가 원래 있던 지역적 특성을 고려하여 기관차 내에 자생하던 뽕나무를 이식하였으며, 전시공간 주변으로는 통풍을 위해 초화류를 식재하여 문화재에 영향을 미치지 않도록 하였다. Kyong-Eui Railway used to be one of the major cross-country railways connecting Busan and Shineuiju. Being the central axis of logistics and transportation in Korea, it also signifies a symbolic meaning of the people's desire for the unification of divided Korean peninsula. A steam locomotive that had stopped in Jangdan Station was bombed out during the Korean War. The locomotive has been neglected and covered with rust in DMZ over a half century, and now is becoming a historic reminder of divided Korea. The initial design approach was based on the three main perspectives of the relocation plan of the steam locomotive in Jangdan Station which is designated as the registered cultural asset no. 78: historical significance, role of a monumental space, and influence on and from the local culture and tourism. Three design subjects were especially highlighted which would represent the identity of the cultural asset, the stream locomotive. First, a vertical watching deck was installed to provide various view points toward the locomotive while ensuring the security of visitors as well as the cultural asset. Second, the Dokgae bride area has good design potentials being on the railway. However, the site is too narrow. Thus, a new ramp and a stairway were placed responding to the existing topography so that the pedestrian environment could be secured last, to respect the local context where the locomotive was originally located, mulberry trees in the locomotive were transplanted as well. Flowering plants were planted around the display area for better ventilation to minimize the negative impact on the locomotive.

title: Design Characters of Water Supply & Drainage and Fire Protection of North Square of Shanghai Railway Station
abstract: North Square of Shanghai Railway Station is positioned and designed as a large integrated traffic hub of railway,rail transit,long distance bus,etc.Its water supply drainage design about the ground square and underground space is introduced in this paper,including the surrounding conditions of water supply,sewage,rainwater and wastewater system,design principle,equipment selection,etc.Moreover,fire protection design content of the project is also put forward such as fire hydrant system,automatic sprinkling fire extinguishing system,gas fire extinguishing system and fire extinguisher settings,etc.Finally,the design difficulties and the detailed resolution of the project are discussed with emphasis.

title: Design of a new retail format serving fish to be introduced for Dutch railway stations and exploited by Servex
abstract: The graduation assignment for Servex was to design a new food format which serves fish at the Dutch railway station. This format should attract travellers to eat fish at the railway station and function well within the retail environment. Therefore it is important to consider the unique context and the expectations of a fish format according to the customer. In order to find out what type of design has the preference of the target group, three different concepts were evaluated among customer panels. Within two different focus groups, the three concepts were presented by a short description, a front view, an interior view, packaging design and openly discussed. As a result the final concept ‘Dock’ has a sturdy and robust design, inspired by elements of the harbour and sea. The environment will be relatively relaxed, but still offer expeditious and efficient service. Fresh and high quality products should be guaranteed, therefore fish products are visibly prepared on site by skilled staff. The concept is ready to be tested with customer panels to continue further development and feasibility of the format.

title: Design of Radio Communication Dispatching System for passenger station of high speed railway
abstract: In view of the characteristics and the existing situation of high speed railway station in China,the Radio Communication Dispatching System was proposed.The article studied on the technologies of information sharing with Management System of arrival and sending in stations,mobile service,radio video surveillance and video phone,introduced the component and the operation principle of the System,main function,interface and key technology.The System was with the properties of friendly interface and easy to use,provided technology supporting for the daily operation and emergency dispatching in passenger station.

title: Image Schemata and Signage Design : Take Shanghai South Railway Station for Example
abstract: Image Schemata is an abstract structure of human cognition.Based on human way-finding behaviour and space cognition,this paper studies image schemata of human way-finding process in transportation junction and their relationship.The results will be applied to signage design in Shanghai South Railway Station.Image schemata are supposed to benefit signage design in following aspects:(1) define the crucial function space and make the analysis simple;(2) be helpful to define the decision point of way-finding and the location of signs;(3) be helpful for information hierarchy in signage design.

title: Design and implementation of Face Recognition System in safty area of railway passenger station
abstract: This paper introduced the archetecture and implementation of Face Recognition System in the safty area of railway passenger station,including video capture,algorithm processing,face matching,output alarming and so on,finally,described the practical application of the System.

title: Design on LED Video Display System in Passenger Guide System of Railway Station
abstract: VGA synchronization control technology was used to process VGA signal in computer CRT display monitor and external video signal digitally,implemented misalignment visual adjustment,data reorganization and gradation transformation by LED Video Display System.Distributional scanning technique was used to divide the display frame surface into different unit by video control circuit.It was strengthened the stability and reliability for display.

title: Design and Realization of Digital Management System on Railway "Station Operation Detailed Rules"
abstract: This article describes a new management mode to meet the requirements of editing system of the station operation detailed rules,introduces the database management method of station operation detailed rules in detail,as well as the solutions about ichnography drawing of stations and mutual browse based on the GIS technologies.In addition,it proposes a complete solution of digital encryption according to the security requirements of stations procedures.This thesis also presents the application of this management system in Haerbin in the end in accordance with the features above mentioned.

title: DESIGN AND CONSTRUCTION OF THE SUPER-LONG BASEMENT OF THE HANG ZHOU NEW RAILWAY STATION
abstract: To the super-long reinforced concrete structures, the usud method is to set entension joints at certain positions, Butthe aging of the waterproofs band at extension joints of the basement will cause leakage, If no extension joint is set in atransnormal length basement, other methods must be used to solve the problem. It is an economic and effectie way touse expansive concrete to build a transnormal length basement.

title: Design and implementation on Station Container Management Information System of China Railway Container
abstract: With the leaping development of railway industry,China railway container business increased year by year.China railway container business depended more and more Information System.In order to solve this dependence,it was developed the Railway Container Information System.The Information System fine managed railway container business’ s each link including goods’ arrival,delivery,acceptence and sending.

title: Discussion on Design of Vacuum Pipes for Vacuum Sewer Systems at Railway Stations and Depots
abstract: At present,vacuum sewer system is adopted as the sewage collection system for all the CRH trains in China.The type of vacuum pump and design of vacuum pipes are major factors which influence the vacuum sewer system.The design of vacuum pipes of Shanghai South Depot was analyzed.The effects of key nodes,pipe lift height,pressure loss and other parameters on the vacuum sewer system were discussed.The relevant technical parameters were verified by engineering projects,which provided reference for the design and application of vacuum sewer system.

title: The analysis of an information guide systems for railway stations from the perspective of universal design
abstract: 본 연구는 총인구 대비 교통약자 인구 비율이 증가하는 시점에서 장애의 유무, 성별, 연령, 국적 등에 상관없이 누구나 이용하기 편리한 유니버설디자인 관점의 철도역사 정보 안내체계에 대한 이용자 조사를 통한 문제점을 파악하여 개선점을 제시하고자 하였다. 이를 위해 한국철도공사의 추천에 따라 역사의 길찾기가 복잡하다고 판단되는 6개의 철도 역사를 선정하여 조사하였다. 이용자에게 각 역사별 길찾기 테스크를 부여하여 그에 대한 관찰조사, 설문, 인터뷰 등을 통해 정량적, 정성적 평가를 진행하였으며, 역사별 종사자를 대상으로 심층 인터뷰와 현장 탐방을 통한 이해관계자 조사를 병행하였다. 이를 통해 유니버설디자인 원칙에 바탕을 둔 인지성, 연속성, 통합성, 가독성, 보편성, 일관성, 적절성의 7가지의 평가기준으로 각 역사별 길찾기와 안내 정보의 현황을 정리하였으며, 현 철도역사의 정보 안내체계에 대한 개선방안을 제시하였다. 본 연구를 통해 철도역사의 길찾기와 안내 정보 체계에 대한 유니버설디자인 관점에서의 평가와 구축의 필요성을 제시한데 의미가 있다.

title: Design and Construction of an Underground Metro Railway Station in Rocky Strata with Hybrid Construction Methodology at New Delhi
abstract: This paper deals with the design construction aspect of a Metro Railway underground Station in Delhi under Delhi Metro Railway project - Phase III. Proposed station building is 250 m long, 20m wide and 16.5m deep. Station is placed 2.5m below road level. Building is having three levels of slabs, namely roof, concourse and base slab. Geological formation of the zone exhibits moderately weathered quartzite rock at a depth of 6 m to 17m below ground level with silty sand topping.

title: Research on the Design for Mountain Railway Station and Yard under Complicated Topographic and Geologic Conditions:Taking the Mountain Railways of Dali-Ruili,Dali-Lijiang and Lijiang-Shangrila as the Examples
abstract: Because the stations and yards in mountain railway are often restrained by complicated topographic and geologic conditions,the designs of stations,yards and buildings must be specially implemented in combination with the bridges,tunnels and subgrades.So this paper analyzed the features of mountain railways and the frequently asked questions on station and yard designs.Further,combined with actual design and consultation examples of stations and yards in southwest mountain railways,this paper researched the principles that should be followed in designs of mountain railway stations and yards, and put forward the optimized design schemes of mountain railway stations and yards under different topographic and geologic conditions.

title: Performance-characterized Assessment and Design of Fire Protection for Roofing Steel Structure of Fuzhou South Railway Station
abstract: Research purposes: The Fuzhou South Railway Station of Fuzhou-Xiamen Railway is complicated in architectural function with unique style in architectural structure.The large space architectural arrangement is adopted to the station hall and the waiting room,which goes beyond the regulation for fire protection stipulated in the relative design code in China.Using the method stipulated in the current Chinese code is difficult to meet the security and the economic requirement of the fire protection for the important steel roof system.Thus,based on the performance-characterized design thoughts,the security of fire protection is assessed to the main structure of steel roof.First,the target of fire protection of the steel structure is determined.Then the mechanical performance of the whole structure in the probable worst fire situation is analyzed.At last,the security of fire protection and necessary measure for fire protection are evaluated according to whether the security of fire protection can meet the performance target of the fire protection or not.Research conclusions:Through performance-characterized analysis,the reasonable and economical design of fire and the technical measures are determined for the station building.The research result is accepted by the experts of the fire protection and can be as reference to the fire protection design of the similar structure.

title: Low-carbon Design Idea of North Square (a Transportation Hub) Project of Tianjin West Railway Station
abstract: The idea of low-carbon design is reflected from many aspects in the project of North Square Project of Tianjin West Railway Station.There are specific points in the paper including using underground space fully to save ground,forming natural ventilation lighting through scattered layout,promoting public traffic by setting up public stations reasonably.Moreover,the low-carbon design is also showed from using fully and strengthening the thermal power characteristic of underground buildings,reducing the energy of ventilation lighting by setting up positions rationally and realizing the whole pollution-reducing by suitable roof greening.

title: From ‘Hanging Out’ to ‘Designed Out’: How Hostile Design is Used Against Young People in Suburban Railway Stations in Melbourne
abstract: Abstract This analysis of the redesigned Lilydale and Mooroolbark railway stations shows how the regulation and control of young peoples’ participation in public space is deeply ingrained within spatial design of new public transport spaces in Melbourne’s eastern suburbs. This study draws on Rosenberger’s (Philos City 1(1):49–70, 2023) framework for analysing hostile design, coupled with the approaches to youth exclusion developed by Wood (2015), to show the embeddedness of physical impositions, surveillance and regulation within new public transport spaces in suburban Melbourne. This analysis shows the interrelatedness of design features that aim to curb young peoples’ use of public space, and the wider media and policy discourses that criminalise young people and construct them as a threat to social order. The exclusion of marginalised young people from public spaces through stigma and discrimination occurs alongside hostile design measures that aim to ‘design out’ particular groups of young people. For some groups of young people, including young African Australian men, targeted policing strategies and intervention from Protective Services Officers (PSOs) in public transport spaces further signals their non-inclusion in those areas.

title: Design and realization of the integrated application software based on the information of the traffic label automatic identification system in the railway station
abstract: The integrated application software is created and developed based on the information of the traffic label automatic identification system and current trains management system in the railway station. This software can be applied in the railway station production. The system achieves two assignments: (1) to assist the traffic label staff pick up trains emphaticly; (2) to produce the form which is used for 18 o clock statistic report on the railway station automatically. The application software is applied to forecast trains through the information of traffic label automatic identifications then becomes integrated information database. In the integrated information database, it comes into a variety of the statistical report forms for vehicles in railway station by itself and accomplishes the integrated application of the information of the traffic label automatic identifications in the railway station. The system can resolve the complex arithmetic of the traffic label data and forecast of train, and it also expounds two reliable complex arithmetic methods for YB1 and YB2 in 18 o clock statistic exact report forms caculated by computer. In the module of uploading the data, it uses advanced . NET resolution project and the pragram is simple and equable. This paper especially introduces the function, architecture, design and resolution project of the system.

title: Design and implementation of Railway Station Freight Transportation Inspection Centralized Safety Monitoring System
abstract: To resolve the disadvantages in the railway freight transportation inspection stations, such as the old work pattern, the independency of various systems and detect equipments, based on analysis of actuality, data source and function requirement, the total project was proposed, and the implementation of two main functions was given in detail. It was implemented the informatization of the whole working process, optimized the working flow, improved the discover rate of problems in transportation, and upgraded the working efficiency and manage level.

title: Design of Large-span Purlin for Platform Canopy without Post of Beijing Railway Station
abstract: Research purposes: The posts of station platform will be installed between tracks,which can make the platform more open and bright and provide comforts to the passengers and reference to the similar works.Research conclusions:Adopting the H-beam light solid consecutive purlin and long cantilever purlin structure are the effective ways to lower the structure weight and roof thickness,reduce deflection and inter-bending and realize the large-span.Providing horizontal support to purlin is the effective measure for guaranteeing purlin plane stability.

title: Design and application on Management Information System for freight wagon flow analysis of railway stations
abstract: The purpose of the wagon flow analysis was monitoring the arriving and departing wagon flow of the marshalling station and the distract station and controlling the changment of the regulation of the wagon flow. The wagon flow analysis was to change this work into the computer operation mode. Automatic processing of the wagon flow analysis was implemented by the link with the Inventory Management Information System and establishing data warehouse and the electronic map diving the direction of the wagon flow.

title: Discussion on Several Issues for Reconstruction and Design of Railway 10 kV Power Distribution Station
abstract: Electric power distribution systems is one of the main part of the power supply system on railway.There are distinct difference between the old and the new electric power distribution systems.The new electric power distribution systems are provided with advanced technique,reliable facility,economical capability and could cope with questions in working.The questions about 10 kV electric power distribution systems on railway were analyzed and discussed,the optimal measures of design were pointed out in this paper.

title: Interoperable hydrogen refueling station interface for railway vehicles in the Rail4Earth project: design approach and new normative requirements
abstract: The RAIL4EARTH project, carried out under the Europe’s Rail Joint Undertaking (ERJU), focuses on the decarbonization and sustainable development of railway systems. One of its key areas is the development of interoperable and safe hydrogen refueling stations for rail applications. This paper presents the research and development activities conducted within Work Package WP9, including the analysis of technical interfaces (mechanical, electrical, communication, and safety) and ensuring compliance with SAE J2601, while being informed by the SAE J2601/5 Technical Information Report (TIR). The engineering challenges related to the design of hydrogen refueling connectors for trains are discussed, with particular attention to high mass flow rates, material requirements, and operational safety. The final outcome of the R&D work will be the demonstration of a universal refueling interface compliant with European and global standards, enabling the rapid deployment and commercialization of hydrogen technologies in the railway sector.

title: Create the Experience Commercial Space ——Design of the Commercial Centre Before the Fuxin Railway Station
abstract: Current commercial activities have not only confined to mere shopping, but will be shopping, leisure, dining and entertainment, a variety of acts into one, pay more attention to people's leisure experience. In the idea of this programme, the experience of the people on the basis of dynamic open space, so that customers shopping at the same time, to experience more comfortable and pleasant, stylish feel.

title: DESIGN AND CONSTRUCTION FOR CONSOLIDATION OF REINFORCED CONCRETE FRAME IN WAITING HALL AT CERTAIN RAILWAY STATION
abstract: The defects to varying degrees occurred commonly on the structural beams and columes of the integral assembled reinforced concrete frame in the waiting hall at certain railway station.There were serious faulty cracks on the frame's beams,which endangered the proper operation.The paper researches deeply the appearance of such structural faults and analyzes systematically the reasons of these faults.The calculation,design and construction for the consolidation are expounded also in detail in this paper.

title: The Hierarchical Management of Fire Resource of Shenzhen Futian Underground Railway Station and Its Optimizing Design
abstract: Research purposes: Shenzhen Futian Underground Railway Station has the characteristics of railway station and subway station and its underground space is not good for the person of suffering fire disaster to be relieved or escape.This paper studies the hierarchical management of the fire resource of underground railway station for the purposes of improving the safety management level and reducing the possibility of firing in underground railway station.Research conclusions:Combining with the characteristics of service functions and structural style of the Futian Underground Railway Station,the fire resource of the station is identified,and the fire load and scale are analyzed,that is to take 2MW as the scale of luggage firing and manual setting fire,10MW as the scale of shopping fire and 16MW as the scale of train fire.According to the characteristics of underground space structure,the fire dangers in the different areas and the difficulty of evacuating persons,the method for 3 hierarchical management of fire resource is offered on the base of the different fire dangers and adopting the different fire monitoring modes and different management methods for the he different areas.

title: A Study on Typology of a Railway Station
abstract: Scale plans in order to take into account wide variety of conditions, such as the station's location, pattern of passengers, service lever requirements should apply when planning to scale the current railway station design guidelines for sizing the expression dose not meet these various requirements. Therefore, this study calculates the optimal scale planning to derive an expression for the railway station, as part of a type designed to reflect this by the type of element for developing the guidelines and classification as type a railway station the mad skills to develop. Research methods include conventional research, literature review, a survey of the current situation and analysis of the results of this review to the railway passenger facilities space optimization calculation of the area of research and technological development research for the design of the railway station design techniques and will be able to be utilized as a resource.

title: Lecture 1, part 2: foundations of sustainable design: railway stations between place and node
abstract: The second part (of three parts) of the first of a series of five lectures presented by Niklaus Kohler to the students in the UT School of Architecture Foundations of Sustainable Architecture class (ARC350R, Fall 2009). Video and accompanying slides.

title: On attentive problems in design for gas fire extinguishing system at underground station building of national railway
abstract: The paper introduces the septenary-fluorine propane(FM200) in the large-scale underground comprehensive communication hubs by combining with the construction drawing design of Yujiabao intercity station building,illustrates some problems and precautious issues in the design process,and provides some reference for similar projects.

title: DESIGN OF HEAT EXCHANGE STATION FOR CENTRALIZED HEAT SUPPLY OF DAMINGGONG RESIDENTIAL DISTRICT BUILT BY XI'AN RAILWAY SUB-ADMINISTRATION
abstract: The paper introduces the design of heating system of the heat exchange station for the centralized heat supply of the Daminggong residential district built by the Xi'an Railway Sub Administration.Combined with the specialities of the engineering project and based on the principles of economy of investment and power supply and fulfilling the effect of heat supply,the contents concerned with following aspects are explored emphatically:the selection of equipments for the technological system of the heat exchange station,the defined pressure of the system,the regulation of heat supply for the system,the return of condensate water,etc.

title: Regional characteristics of the railway station
abstract: This thesis demonstrates the design points of the contemporary railway station and the interpretation of the regional characteristics from station square,station building and station yard three aspects.Taking Lasa railway station as an example,it studies the regional characteristics of passenger station from three perspectives of station square,station building and station yard,and points out that the station design process should combine form and function and demonstrate the city's character.

title: Design process and conservation values of the Eskişehir Railway Station as a modern architectural heritage in the 1950s modernism in Türkiye
journal: ITU Press Press of the Istanbul Technical University
abstract: The Eskişehir Train Station, designed and constructed in the 1950s by architects Orhan Safa and Muhittin Binan, is a valuable example of modernist architecture in Türkiye.The building, with its innovative design and construction techniques, reflects the architectural trends of the mid-twentieth century.Through extensive archival research and interviews, the study highlights the importance of preserving the modern architectural heritage.The research delves into the design process, construction methods, and conservation values of the Eskişehir Train Station, emphasizing its significance in the history of Turkish modern architecture.Located in the western part of Eskişehir, Türkiye, the station was conceived as a modern building and underwent a rich history, including a competitive design phase, its re-design and construction during the 1950s, and subsequent restoration in the 2000s.Drawing upon archival documents from Orhan Safa and Muhittin Binan-the architects responsible for the station's design and construction between 1952 and 1955-the study reveals how the architects adhered to modern architectural principles.Architects decided to design the train station building within modern architecture design parameters by using a new form and construction techniques and tried to construct the building with pure structure reference to mid-twentieth century architecture.The article provides a comparative debate on the preservation of the modern architectural heritage and by discussing the Eskişehir Train Station's historical and architectural significance.By exploring the station's evolution and contributions to the architectural landscape, the research aims to deepen understanding and appreciation of modernist heritage in Türkiye.

title: Design Proposal for Axle Counting Track Circuit within the Control Scope of Signal Relay Station on High-speed Railway
abstract: Aiming at the characteristic of the high-speed railway,the paper discusses the design proposal for axle counting track circuit superposed ZPW-2000 track circuit within the control scope of the signal relay station.The design proposal takes full advantage of train control center to transmit information relating to axle counter track circuit and accomplish the control of axle counting track circuit within jurisdiction scope of relay station,therefore,solve the problem of undesirable ZPW-2000A track circuit shunt under the circumstance of the ballast bed resistance0.5Ω?km.

title: Design Method and its Consensus-Building through Urban Redevelopment Project in front of The Railway Station Considered Linkage of Surrounding Area
journal: Journal of the City Planning Institute of Japan
abstract: LINKAGE OF SURROUNDING AREA IS VERY IMPORTANT FACTOR OF URBAN REDEVELOPMENT PROJECT IN FRONT OF THE RAILWAY STATION THE PURPOSE OF THIS ARTICLE IS TO CLARIFY DESIGN METHOD AND THE PROCESS OF ITS CONSENSUS-BUILDING THROUGH URBAN REDEVELOPMENT PROJECT IN FRONT OF THE RAILWAY STATION CONSIDERED LINKAGE OF SURROUNDING AREA. AS A RESULT, DESIGN METHODS ARE CAN BE CLASSIFIED INTO 6-TYPE AND ITS CONSENSUS-BUILDING CAN BE CLASSIFIED INTO 6-TYPE BY MUTUAL RELATIONSHIPS OF PARTICIPANTS WHO ARE PARTICIPATED IN PROJECT. ALSO,THE CONSENSUS-BUILDING CAN BE CLASSIFIED INTO 3-LEVEL BY DEMENDS OF THE PARTICIPANTS.

title: Railway station 2.0: a new pattern for the development of the digital railway
journal: International journal of open information technologies
abstract: The article addresses the aspects linked with the new concept of railway station, based on the smart technologies, and a significantly lower level of energy consumption. Railway station 2.0 is a part of digital railway concept in response to increasing level of urbanization, high population mobility and investment activity in developing countries and the growth of the middle class. The article discusses innovative technologies that improve energy efficiency and level of digitalization, applied by railway stations of Europe, USA, China and Japan. A set of noted innovations are at an early stage of implementation in Russia. Special attention is paid to commercial and financial aspects of modern railway stations. The article may be of interest to the design engineers of railway stations, the top management of rail companies, transport and railway authorities.

title: City Transportation Hub Region Planning Based on the Urban Design Integrating Strategy: A Case Study of Conceptual Reform Design of the Changchun Railway Station North Area
abstract: Abstract. With the rapid urbanization and development in China, reconstruction and construction for the comprehensive transportation hub of the railway station area is underway in most city. The paper used the conceptual reform design of Changchun railway station north area as example, to describe that how to improve integral image and environmental quality by urban design integrating strategy. The purpose is to maximize the function of the transport hub area and to reach reasonable evacuation traffic flow, thus create a transit-oriented composite development project with dynamic and sustainable by function and space integration.

title: Sensory Design-Driven: Spatial Assessment of Pedestrian Landscapes in Railway Station Areas of Greater Bay Area
journal: International Journal of New Developments in Engineering and Society
abstract: This study aims to enhance the walking experience in TOD projects by using landscape design to optimise the walking environment. It explores the use of the senses of sight, sound, smell, touch, and taste to create a more immersive and delightful experience for pedestrians. Focusing on three prominent Transit-Oriented Development (TOD) projects in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area: Hong Kong Central Station, Guangzhou East Station, and Shenzhen North Station, the study assesses the implementation and impact of five sensory designs in these three stations through on-site research. The study seeks to establish a comprehensive design framework for the initial and final sections of the rail transit pedestrian network in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area. Its objective is to improve the overall experience of pedestrians in the vicinity of rail transit stations and support the sustainable development of urban areas within the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay (GBA) Area, providing practical insights for urban planners and professionals in the fields of architecture, urban design, and transportation.

title: Study of the Structural Design Parameters of an Emergency Rescue Station between Continuous Tunnel Portals in a Single-Tube Railway Tunnel Group
journal: Transportation Research Record Journal of the Transportation Research Board
abstract: In China, emergency rescue stations between continuous tunnel portals have been newly designed and applied in extra-long single-tube mountain railway tunnel groups exceeding 20 km in length. Lower pass rates at emergency exits and slower evacuation speeds on evacuation routes are the major contributors to fire-related fatalities. Therefore, it is very important to use reasonable structural design parameters to ensure the effective evacuation of escapees. This study conducts on-site testing of a railway tunnel evacuation model for 457 people to determine the evacuation speeds. Based on coefficient adjustments, it provides the evacuation speeds of different groups of people in a smoke-filled emergency rescue station. Additionally, a series of simulation evacuation models for 1,500 people in emergency rescue stations between continuous tunnel portals were developed using the buildingEXODUS software. These models simulate the evacuation time under different structural parameters and aim to determine the optimal design parameters by analyzing the relationship between evacuation time and structural factors. The study also investigates the impact of structural design parameters on both evacuation time and evacuation density. The results indicate that, when the width and number of evacuation routes are not optimal, evacuation speed significantly decreases, and more people become stranded in the evacuation paths, which increases the overall risk. This paper recommends that emergency rescue stations between continuous tunnel portals should have at least four evacuation routes, each with a minimum width of 3 m. Additionally, the platform height should be 0.3 m, and the platform width should be 2.5 m.

title: A phased multi-scale framework integrating EnergyPlus and CFD for thermal comfort-oriented spatial design in high-speed railway stations
abstract: High-speed railway stations present significant challenges for indoor thermal comfort due to their complex, non-uniform environments. Existing studies predominantly prioritize energy efficiency over comfort-oriented spatial design. The limited comfort research addressing thermal non-uniformity is predominantly confined to vertical stratification. To address this, this study proposes a phased, multi-scale framework integrating EnergyPlus and computational fluid dynamics (CFD) for early-stage comfort-oriented design. It combines rapid annual-scale parametric screening with detailed spatial analysis. To capture horizontal heterogeneity, two novel indicators – a distributed temperature indicator (ΔTloc) and a spatially weighted indicator (Tsw) – are introduced. Applied to a case study, the framework identifies space height (H) and skylight-to-roof ratio (SRR) as the dominant variables. Seasonally balanced optimization determined optimal values of H = 16.667 m and SRR = 17.347%, improving these indicators by 14.4% and 39.3%. This framework offers a practical, systematic approach for integrating thermal comfort into the early-stage design of high-speed railway stations.

title: Design and techno-economic evaluation of a nanogrid system for a small-scale public railway station building in Thailand
abstract: In Thailand, numerous small-scale public facilities continue to rely on the electrical grid. The integration of renewable energy sources such as photovoltaic (PV) and wind power offers a sustainable alternative; however, their inherent intermittency necessitates advanced solutions such as nanogrid systems, which enable localized energy generation, storage, and management to enhance reliability and autonomy. This study develops a nanogrid-based energy management system for Hua Takhe train station, Thailand, by integrating photovoltaic (PV) panels, wind turbines, and battery energy storage systems (BESS). Using HOMER Pro, multiple configurations were simulated and evaluated across key financial indicators, including Payback Period (PB), Internal Rate of Return (IRR), Return on Investment (ROI), Net Present Value (NPV), and Levelized Cost of Electricity (LCOE). The analysis framework further incorporates economic feasibility evaluation, sensitivity and scenario analysis, and long-term performance and life cycle evaluation, thereby ensuring that both short-term financial viability and long-term sustainability are comprehensively assessed. Results show that PV-dominant nanogrid systems, particularly at larger scales, represent the most practical and cost-effective pathway for sustainable electrification of public facilities in Thailand. The 30PV Nanogrid achieves the most favorable balance between cost and performance, with a NPV of 23,925 USD, a LCOE of 0.04 USD/kWh, a PB of 7 years, an IRR of 13 %, and a ROI of 215 % under long-term life-cycle evaluation. In comparison, the 15PV Nanogrid proves economically marginal, with NPV falling to –9117 USD, PB extending beyond 20 years, IRR turning negative (–5 %), and ROI declining to –40 %, confirming that small-scale nanogrids cannot offset the costs of ESS and hybrid inverters.

title: Computer aided design of the operation and the track layout of the passenger railway stations: interactive—graphic model AFAIG
abstract: This paper presents a software model for the planning of passenger railway stations. The aim of this model is the elaboration of operation programs within stations, and the evaluation of projects for the track layout. This model allows the planner to elaborate interactively an operation program, through a man‐computer dialogue, in a way similar to the manual procedure with which he is familiar. On the other hand, the model includes an optimization algorithm which can be used to automatically set routes to the trains, through the station.

title: Conceptual design of rail link: Zagreb Main Railway Station - Zagreb International Airport (Velika Gorica)
abstract: Tracnicka veza između Međunarodne zracne luke Zagreb i sredista Grada Zagreba, a posredno i Velike Gorice, neophodna je za redovito odvijanje prometa između tih centara i buducu konkurentnost zracnog drugim granama prometa. Pitanje koje se postavlja jest kojim bi ih sustavom bilo ucinkovitije povezati – prosirenjem postojece tramvajske ili željeznicke mreže. U radu su opisana idejna rjesenja uspostave ovih sustava u dvije faze: u prvoj bi se povezao zagrebacki Glavni kolodvor i zracna luka, a u drugoj bi se mreža prosirila do sredista Velike Gorice. Prilikom odabira konacnog rjesenja, pored troskova ulaganja trebalo bi voditi racuna i o mogucim ostvarenjima prijevoznog kapaciteta te brzine tj. vremena, sigurnosti i udobnosti vožnje. Za obje su varijante, obzirom na navedene parametre, razrađene i međusobno uspoređene prve faze povezivanja.

title: Design and Analysis of Measured Shading Effects of Large Space Building Exterior Shading-A Case Study of Taiyuan South Railway Station
journal: Journal of Hubei University of Technology
abstract: In the construction of energy-saving design,the scientific and reasonable use of shading technology is significant in using natural light for the building,reducing heat and solar radiation and air-conditioning load.This paper,taking Taiyuan South Railway Station as an example,presented the ideas and methods of building exterior shading combining regional climate characteristics with architectural modeling design.The shading effect was also analyzed through actual measurement.

title: REINFORCING DESIGN OF STEEL SUPPORT TO WHEEL PLATFORM OF THE HEAVY-DUTY CRANE AT BEIJING SOUTHERN RAILWAY STATION
abstract: The construction of the steel support reinforcing system of the crane wheel platform had no impact on the the major construction schedule in the construction of the central building and canopy steel structures of the Station Project.Foundation boxes were equipped along with the erection of concrete formwork and the total weight of the steel supports is 5000 t,nearly 7.6% of the total steel consumption of the project,less than that of other similar steel structure project.Moreover,the system has ensured the safety of the concrete structure on the underground railway floor.

title: Design process and conservation values of the Eskişehir Railway Station as a modern architectural heritage in the 1950s modernism in Türkiye
journal: ITU Press Press of the Istanbul Technical University
abstract: The Eskişehir Train Station, designed and constructed in the 1950s by architects Orhan Safa and Muhittin Binan, is a valuable example of modernist architecture in Türkiye. The building, with its innovative design and construction techniques, reflects the architectural trends of the mid-twentieth century. Through extensive archival research and interviews, the study highlights the importance of preserving the modern architectural heritage. The research delves into the design process, construction methods, and conservation values of the Eskişehir Train Station, emphasizing its significance in the history of Turkish modern architecture. Located in the western part of Eskişehir, Türkiye, the station was conceived as a modern building and underwent a rich history, including a competitive design phase, its re-design and construction during the 1950s, and subsequent restoration in the 2000s. Drawing upon archival documents from Orhan Safa and Muhittin Binan—the architects responsible for the station’s design and construction between 1952 and 1955—the study reveals how the architects adhered to modern architectural principles. Architects decided to design the train station building within modern architecture design parameters by using a new form and construction techniques and tried to construct the building with pure structure reference to mid-twentieth century architecture. The article provides a comparative debate on the preservation of the modern architectural heritage and by discussing the Eskişehir Train Station’s historical and architectural significance. By exploring the station’s evolution and contributions to the architectural landscape, the research aims to deepen understanding and appreciation of modernist heritage in Türkiye.

title: DESIGN OF MADOERA STOOMTRAM MAATSCHAPPIJ (MdrSM) RAILWAY STATION IN BANGKALAN REGENCY PERANCANGAN STASIUN KERETA API MADOERA STOOMTRAM MAATSCHAPPIJ (MdrSM) DI KABUPATEN BANGKALAN
abstract: Perancangan stasiun kereta api ini berada di Pulau Madura khususnya di Kabupaten Bangkalan. Pergerakan transportasi yang ada di Kabupaten Bangkalan merupakan hal yang sangat melekat dan dibutuhkan karena termasuk kepentingan manusia untuk mencapai suatu tempat ketempat lainnya. Dengan adanya jembatan suramadu di perkirakan arus lalu lintas akan semakin padat dimasa yang akan datang. Salah satu alternatif untuk meningkatkan transportasi massal yang ada di Pulau Madura yaitu mengaktifkan kembali tansportasi kereta api di Pulau Madura. Stasiun kereta api Madoera Stroomtram Maatschappij (MdrSM) adalah salah satu perusahaan kereta api di hindia belanda yang beroperasi di Pulau Madura pada tahun 1897, dengan jalur kereta api sejauh 150 km. Dalam RIPNAS terdapat rencana pengembangan jaringan kereta api di Pulau Madura tahun 2030. Dengan di perkuat rencana tersebut maka perlu adanya perancangan stasiun yang ada di Kabupaten Bangkalan. Bangunan bekas stasiun yang ada di Kabupaten Bangkalan masih ada sehingga dapat memudahkan untuk dilakukan perancangan kembali stasiun yang sudah lama terbengkalai. Dalam perancangan ini menggunakan metode penelitian desktiptif dimana penelitian yang mengkaji suatu peristiwa yang terjadi (Objek Penelitian) secara spesifik, akan tetapi tidak untuk menyusun kesimpulan penelitian secara umum. Penelitian ini diartikan sebagai kegiatan pengumpulan dan pengkajian data yang dilakukan secara sistematis dan objektif untuk pemecahan suatu persoalan. Dalam perancangan ini menggunakan konsep arsitektur kontemporer yang mana merupakan konsep yang ada karena kebutuhan akan adanya gaya baru sehingga konsep ini mencirikan adanya kebebasan serta keinginan untuk menampilkan sesuatu yang berbeda.

title: Discussion on “the relation of railway sub-station design to its operation,” and “some considerations determining the location of electric railway substations,” at New York, December 15, 1905
journal: Proceedings of the American Institute of Electrical Engineers
abstract: H. A. Lardner: Among the disadvantages of the method of starting synchronous converters from the direct-current side not noted by Mr. Ashe may be included the fact that direct current is not always available. For instance, the converter sub-stations of the majority of interurban railways are shut down at night; and unless storage-batteries are included in their equipment direct current is not available for starting the converters in the morning. Therefore, it becomes necessary to include another method of starting them.

title: 5th International Urban Design Conference Opportunistic Urban Design - 2012 Opportunistic Destinations: Transforming Railway Stations into Sustainable Urban Centres
abstract: All over the world stations are changing to become new urban centres and destinations. Some flagship projects, like Atocha in Madrid or Grand Central in Manhattan, make great destinations with shops, restaurants, museums and exhibition spaces. The urban spaces around them have been redesigned to provide excellent public areas and rationalise functional needs. Suburban stations also have the potential to follow the same trend. After all, stations are places of high symbolic value, they are central to the life of many people and include all sections of society, while generating high footfall and stimulating the economy. For this reason, Station Master Planning must focus on ‘place’ as well as ‘product’ to respond to the multiple opportunities. Considering the need that designs of stations need to be sustainable and preserve and value the public spaces, this paper reflects on the case study of the station master plan of the Tottenham Hale Station in London where SKM Colin Buchanan applied opportunistic urban design principles and created a new, significant urban square for north London and a local destination for leisure and investment. The design methodology are transferred to the local context of Melbourne where the unique spatial circumstances of suburban stations along the New Regional Rail Link line are reviewed, highlighting how these stations possesses specific opportunistic and sustainable urban design answers.

title: BIM Model for Railway Intermediate Station: Transportation Perspective
journal: International Journal of BIM and Engineering Science
authors: Syrian Railways General Est., Ministry of Transportation, Syria
abstract: As a result of the imposed war on Syria since 2011 until now, most Syrian cities have been completely or partly devastated on multiple levels. This urge the needs for developing a comprehensive, balance and sustainable reconstruction strategy. Transportation sector in Syria was subjected to vandalism and systematic destruction. Therefore, the reconstruction strategy should take into account the need to rehabilitate, restore or create vital axes to connect all Syrian cities. Maintaining existed railway lines or constructing new lines require expanding railway stations to meet the expected traffic flow for both passengers and cargo. On the other hand, Building Information Modeling (BIM) has been crystallized as a new technological concept in the construction industry. It is considered a revolution that has transformed the way in which engineering facilities and infrastructures are designed, analyzed, constructed and managed. In such context, the author has applied BIM technology for modeling a real case of railway intermediate station called XiaMen railway station, China. When the modeling process was finished, the station model allows the author to have the needed documentation of station simultaneously. Besides, this model highlights any possible conflicts or design mistakes before the real construction starts. This study makes a novel contribution by providing a new method for 3D digital railway station that motivates designers and contractors to carry out BIM in this vital sector. It paves the way to support the reconstruction phase with modern technologies and its applications.

title: Prediction of Benefits of Special Taxi-Pooling Design for Large Transport Terminals: Case Study of Beijing West Railway Station
journal: Transportation Research Record Journal of the Transportation Research Board
abstract: Taxi-pooling is a newly suggested transport arrangement that may benefit the public in both cost and time. Large transport terminals, such as airports and railway stations, are ideal sites for taxi-pooling because of their large passenger volumes and limited taxi access. However, traditional taxi-pooling methods in these terminals may not be appropriate because of facility and policy restrictions. This study proposes a special taxi-pooling method based on an interactive smartphone application for large transport terminals. The benefits of the proposed method are evaluated through the use of real and simulated data from the Beijing West Railway Station. Three models that consider passengers’ acceptance of and preference for taxi-pooling were built to calculate the reduction in traffic, waiting time, and cost. The results show that the proposed method can effectively improve the travel efficiency and satisfaction of passengers and relieve traffic congestion.
